The Rise of Aila- Book Two: Heritage 遺產

Hobohaymaker13

Summary:

Almost three years since finding out she was the newest Avatar, Aila Makimura has finished mastering the elements of fire and air. Now, with her sister and allies, Aila's now set to travel to Zaofu to master earthbending, where they'll meet the faces of the past... all the while an aged Kuvira Beifong makes the choice to finally reveal the tragic truth of her connection to Aila and Honei. However, an ancient, dangerous and seemingly immortal killer has been unleashed by the Order of the Red Lotus for they share a common goal; The death of the Avatar. But soon, even this Hunter realizes something's amiss among his own quest.

Rewrite of the second part of the "Rise of Aila" fics/the Prime Universe fics, more to come...

Chapter 1: Chapter One- The Next Step

Notes:

And FINALLY, after enough time, we finally get to Book Two of the rewritten Rise of Aila fics. And this will be a full Book, it won’t be split into two like last time with plenty enough rewritten, edited and expanded on, as with some new stuff. As for what? Well, let’s find out together.

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, some nudity and a moment of brutal bloody violence and gore.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Years Before...

"... As she stood huddled against the corner, a knife of silver in hand like her grandmother told her, the little girl in green was prepared to defend herself, knowing the wolf spirit was close…"

The young child listening loved this story, having been read it so many times by the man reading from the storybook he held.

The father smiled as his daughter tried to stay awake.

Getting back to the words being read off the pages, the bearded man's words soothed his youngest ears as he sat next to her bed.

"... and as the door opened, there she saw the wolf spirit. It's fur white as its eyes looked hungry, entering as the moon spirit's light shined on it. That's when the little girl saw the eyes looked so familiar…"

The father heard a footstep or two stop near the doorway into the bedroom, knowing who was there.

"Realizing the truth, the little girl in green spoke, 'Nainai?'," he read, turning to see his beautiful wife stand at the doorway, her long black bangs framing her face as she watched this heartwarming moment. "And the wolf spirit stopped, realization forming in its green eyes as it began to back away, changing shape as the child found out the truth…"

Seeing his daughter close her eyes, yet still able to listen, the father closed the book and set it down, knowing the story by heart as he kept telling it.

"... she found out that it was her grandmother who was the wolf spirit. But the little girl in green wasn't scared as the grandmother cried for forgiveness." the father tucked the child in. "She wondered why her Nainai was so afraid to tell the truth, to which her grandmother admitted she was worried that her only living relative wouldn't love a monster if the truth of her curse was revealed, one who almost hurt her..."

He then smiled as her head rested on a pillow.

"... but then the little girl in green dropped her weapon and hugged her grandmother, saying it didn't matter what she was cursed with, she was her 'Nainai' and will always be…"

Laying a small kiss on his daughter's forehead, the father stood up, ready for another night's sleep. "And for the first time in a long while, the grandmother was not ashamed of what she was, knowing she had her granddaughter's love."

Ending the tale, he turned around and walked out of the child's bedroom, turning off the light before closing the door, seeing his wife smile at him.

"It's amazing, you read that story Raava knows how many times and Aila still loves it." Asuka Makimura whispered to which her husband gave a small chuckle, coming up to her near a slightly ajar window. "I mean, at least she does. Took until the third time for Honei to ask you to read a different story." she joked as she took notice of the storybook.

"You know, I always wondered. Where did you get that book?"

Hearing the question, not knowing whose father he was, Bachu looked at the old leather-bound cover, featuring the image of a Water Tribe boy looking up at a floating girl, framed around the moon.

"I've had this ever since I was born, it's the only thing I have that belonged to my mother." he spoke fondly, if sadly as he carefully put it away. "She left it with me and my dad before she went away."

Shaking his head, thoughts went through the man's mind, one most especially. "He never told me WHY exactly she left us. All he told me was that mom wouldn't have done it unless she had absolutely no choice left." he spoke in remembrance, closing his eyes.

"Not even after dad died did I meet her, so I guess either she didn't know, or…"

Before Bachu could finish, Asuka took him by the hand, understanding. "Maybe she is still alive, somewhere in the world and thinks of you. You don't know for sure."

Hearing his wife speak those kind words, the husband wanted to admit that perhaps his mother never wanted to be part of his life, but he knew that couldn't be true.

Not with the old storybook he still had.

"Maybe you're right." he said to which his wife kissed him on the cheek and led him away, both heading to their bedroom after shutting the window...

… never knowing that outside of it, under the moonlight, was someone up against the wall of their home, clad in all black attire, her hooded trench coat and wolf skull mask hiding her identity.

The sad fern green eyes, however, betrayed her frightening appearance as she had them closed, feeling them tear up upon hearing her son's words, having just watched him read to her granddaughter.

Kuvira Beifong kept quiet, to not raise any attention as she began to move away from the two story home in Goaling.

But the Avatar's grandmother wasn't alone as she took sight of a massive looking wolf waiting for her, his yellow eyes looking curious as she approached it, turning one last time at the house.

"I promise, you will meet your mother. And your children will meet their grandmother..."

Present day...

"BEGIN!"

Upon hearing those words leave from their higher up's mouths, three differently suited figures come towards their tan-skinned opponent under a pavilion as rain fell from the gloomy grey sky.

One, being a non-bender, fast and nimble, was the first to get close as they whipped and swung around their set of escrima sticks.

But their opponent was ready, having chosen not to directly fight back, instead only using defensive maneuvers to avoid and defect attacks, her blue eyes keeping focused.

Feeling how each swing in different directions affected the flow of air in front of her, the young woman, clad in an olive green tank top, black spandex exercise pants and sneakers, allowed herself to move along the current to avoid the attacks.

For those strikes she couldn't avoid, the girl raised her hands up, either using small gusts of air to move the escrima sticks away from her or bending the metal bracelets around her wrists to directly block each blow.

As she moved around, her long brunette fluffed hair tied into a braided ponytail with only a loose bang moving along, the girl sensed one of the other suited fighters coming from behind due to the movement of air.

Hearing the assortment of water tentacles coming towards her, the blue eyed girl grappled the escrima sticks of her one opponent with her metalbending.

As the non-bender had still been holding onto their weapons, the girl quickly used airbending to spin around in place, causing the non-bender to take the force of the waterbending.

"AUGH!"

As sounds of pain were heard, she used the distraction to loosen her metalbending on him and drew a large breath from her lungs before blowing as much air as she could.

In turn, the gust of wind from her lips knocked the non-bender into the waterbender, sending them off the pavilion and under the rain hard.

Smirking at her work, the sound of something swirling around got her attention, dodging and lowering her head quick enough to see what looked like liquid metal fly over her, in turn hitting the other two and trapping them in place.

Knowing what was up, the blue-eyed girl grinned as she turned around and saw before her was the last suited individual, the short and skinny older man getting into a stance himself as his beady green eyes watched her closely.

"Not bad, Avatar Aila. Certainly have defensive qualities down."

The White Lotus Master of metalbending known as Ka-Kui spoke, giving the Avatar credit as she stood prepared to keep fighting among the training area of Air Temple Island, "Need to show me more of your offense, do you think you can handle that?"

That question didn't phase the twenty-year old Aila Makimura, who glanced at the others watching her demonstrate what she had learned, then back at the older metalbender as he had reclaimed what he threw at the Avatar, watching it reform back into his own bracelets as she threw the sticks down to the ground.

"I don't know, do you think you can handle me?"

The response didn't seem to budge the master bender. "YEP, there's Korra in you, alright." he said with a flat tone...

... before he and Aila then came forth at each other, both using their specialized form of earthbending to attack and block.

Watching the display were those who made up most of the newest iteration of Team Avatar, all watching in silence as everyone held bated breaths.

Sitting side by side, holding each other's hands were Aila's big sister, Honei and her boyfriend of two and a half years, Yasunori.

The robot with a human spirit and soul, having recently had her long bouncy black hair recolored to just ebony black, watched in silent awe at the human she considered to be her little sister. She was able to keep up with the fast speed of both bender's attacks, seeing Aila switch switch gears and began to use firebending.

The now eighteen-year old boy also kept focusing as much attention as he could with his single good brown colored eye, his damaged one covered by an eye-patch that, in itself, was blocked by a messy mop of dark brown hair. Even though he was the lone non-bender of the group, Yasunori never got tired of seeing his friend train and bend.

On the other side of Honei was a girl just a few months older than Aila at the age of twenty one, watching with cornflower blue eyes of her own. The tall fire nun named Kallah watched proudly as her girlfriend was bending waves of fire and thick pieces of metal at Ka-Kui, her light brown hair now in a short curly perm framing her rosy, light cheeks.

While two other members of the group of friends-turned-makeshift-family were off busy with their own situations, two others watched nearby, keeping themselves afar while the Avatar kept at it with the White Lotus agent.

As Aila let forth an air punch, her left fist out, Ka-Kui took the chance and held his hands over her wrist, easily bending the metal bracelet apart to the Earth State born girl's surprise.

Yet, as he tried the same with the one on the left, the White Lotus agent's bending didn't affect the special petrified metal with pieces of sapphire in it.

At that, the look of surprise on Aila's face was revealed to be false as she quickly replaced it with a smug grin.

"Platinum."

Before everyone knew it, Aila quickly waved her hands about and formed a small air tornado underneath Kai-Kui's feet, sending him up and spinning in the air before falling down on his back before swiftly holding out her hand towards him, a flame aimed right at the master.

All with a friendly smile on her face.

"So, would you say I passed?"

The second the Avatar spoke those words, she heard a spark be made from behind before a loud crackle erupted!

Knowing what was coming, Aila turned around and held her hands out, the metal bracelets of Ka-Kui's coming off his wrists and into the air as they bended together into a long thin rod...

... that then JUST TOOK IN EVERY SINGLE BIT OF A BOLT OF RED LIGHTNING THAT FIRED OUT INTO THE AIR, crackling out through the raining sky!

The Avatar was thankful she was quick on her toes.

"That was close, you could have hurt her!" all heard an older woman's voice call out before another's laughter filled the air.

"Could have? She's pretty damn smart, remember?"

Both Aila and Ka-Kui, as with the others on the side, watched as the air and firebending teachers of the newest Avatar made their way to her.

The blind firebender Ryoko, former Fire Mother of the Fire Blossom Society, the one who had just used her special form of lightning generation, just grinned as she clapped her hands, her long hair now fully silver being the only real sign of her age, her father's red scarf around her neck.

"I say she's passed, she's a firebending master to me." The sunglasses-wearing woman smiled proudly at Aila, bowing to her student who did the same. "Jinora, what do you think?"

The Air Abbess, having started training the girl in front of her just two and a half years before, alongside Ryoko's training, stole a quick annoyed glance at her fellow and younger teacher.

But that didn't cloud her mind when it came to her decision, too giving a bow to the newest life of both her grandfather and old friend as she felt the most proud.

"It is an honor to deem you an airbending master as well, Aila."

Loud cheers rang from nearby as Aila's big sister, friend, and girlfriend all gave their approval as said Avatar couldn't hold it in and hugged both teachers of hers, having to tear up.

"Thank you, thank you both so much!"

"Don't just thank us, nor your training." Jinora said while patting her back as did Ryoko, who knew the others were preparing to come to them.

"Yeah, you got your friends and family to support you as well."

"Avatar Aila, it was an honor to spar with you. From me, to my fellow White Lotus." Ka-Kui said honorably as Aila turned to him, seeing the bald metalbender and his other two agents bow in response.

Of course, she herself returned the gesture as she heard the other three come by.

"Aila, THAT WAS SO WICKED!" Honei yelled out in happiness, hugging her little sister and making sure not to use her robot strength to hurt her. "Especially as you dodged the weapon attacks." she said as Yasunori grinned, watching Aila let go of the metal girl.

"Personally, I thought how you deflected the lightning was the best."

A response that made Ryoko herself just slyly smirk.

"What made you go for that trick? Thought you'd try redirecting it the old fashioned way." she observed, walking around the group.

"Aside from having not actually done that before?" Aila rhetorically questioned the obvious, which got an amused shrug from the blind woman.

"Still, you keep proving me right with that big, smart brain of yours."

"That's one reason why I love her!"

Hearing Kallah speak the truth, the Avatar saw her girlfriend come and give her a big hug before leaning down to kiss her on the lips. "You did AMAZING." she gushed over her girlfriend's training.

"Aw, you two keep getting cuter and cuter," Jinora couldn't help but gush herself, reminding her so much of those romantic novels she still reads. "Too bad Ikki's isn't back from her errands, she would die seeing you two! Oh, and also Honei and Yasunori, of course."

Hearing them words, the robot and non-bender laughed those off.

"Oh, hush, Jinora."

"Come on..."

When it came to their relationship, both Honei and Yasunori themselves had taken things slower in comparison to Aila and Kallah's relationship, but they were still loving and caring as they held each other's hands.

Though the Avatar herself took notice of her sister blushing.

"Still have no idea how that's possible, you being able to blush." Aila pointed out, to which the robot tried to think it over.

"Going over my CPU… I dunno."

It was true, since two and a half years before and she blushed for the first time, Honei still hadn't figured out how it was possible.

Eventually, she figured that some things in both worlds don't need answering…

… well, maybe.

Before the Avatar could comment, a noticeably loud meow was heard, one deeper than normal.

"Meeoooww..."

The group then saw a familiar furry and scaled animal come towards all of them, having grown pretty large in size.

In fact, the creature before them was no longer a crocokitten, but a crococat as it had increased to the size of a regular one, like the size of a polar bear dog cub, nudging his head against Aila's leg as he looked up with his blue eyes, the Avatar smiling at her spirit companion.

"Quy-Mo, mommy's halfway to becoming a fully fledged Avatar!" she said playfully, kneeling and petting her friend, to which the crococat made a happy sound at.

"MREOW!"

As her animal companion pawed himself up and rubbed her face with his head as everyone laughed, the Fire Mother was most amused.

"Alright, if you ask me, we should round everyone up and celebrate." Ryoko spoke up, breaking up the mood. "First up, where has my kid and our non-bi friend been?" she asked, to which Yasunori tried to remember.

"Jun mentioned they had some White Lotus meet-up and Bolin had to pick up the twins from school."

Elsewhere...

"Well, you two got A+'s on the test, your moms are gonna be pleased. Can certainly tell you two take after Narue in the smarts department."

As he had a day off from his duty as a police detective, Bolin Huynh offered to pick up both his son and daughter from school, so both Koha and Narue could get some errands done.

Presently driving along in his satomobile with Noh and Nue in the back seats, the firebender kept his eyes on the road while he drove, deciding to take a little detour.

"And normally, I try to be a good dad and not break some rules Koha enforces... BUT..." Bolin trailed off as he then pulled up along the sidewalk.

Something his children both noticed, wondering.

"Wait, why'd we pull over?" Noh himself wondered with Nue nodding as well.

"This isn't the way home."

"Look on the right." Bolin suggested as he saw his kids look to the side.

"No no, RIGHT."

Looking the other way, the twin siblings realized what their dad was suggesting, surprised.

"Tasty Treats?" Both spoke of the name of the ice cream parlor they were in front of, following their dad out of the car as he nodded along.

"Yeah, I figured since you two did so good, you both earned a little reward. Something neither of your mom's can't know about." Bolin insisted, knowing Koha would have him by the balls if he gave them dessert before dinner while Narue would laugh.

An offer neither brother and sister were going to deny, nodding along.

That pleased the firebender to see, waving them along. "Alright then, nothing too messy. Don't wanna leave evidence, so if you go for a cone, you only get one scoop."

"Okay!" Both Noh and Nue agreed to as they crossed the street, ready to go towards the front door when a voice caught the father's ear.

"So, catch you about?"

"Of course." another voice followed, with the firebender taken a bit by surprise to see coming out of a tea shop someone he knew quite well.

Agent of the White Lotus, Master Jun, dressed up in the order's usual suit and tie, using an umbrella...

... talking to some guy?

"Dad, are you having a stroke?" Nue had to ask him, tugging at his jacket as her brother noticed whom his dad was looking at.

"Hey, it's Jun!"

Having just said goodbye to their fellow agent who began heading down the street, Jun themselves heard what Noh said out loud, turning to see those they knew.

"OH, Bolin, Noh, Nue!" they welcomed, making their way over as the twins ran up to them with interest. "Hey there, you just got out of school?"

"Yeah, dad's getting us some ice cream because we did good on our math test." Noh revealed, getting the non-binary bender's approval.

"Neato. Did you know in certain parts of the world, it's called 'cold cream'?"

Though Bolin himself was a little more taken by the guy whom Jun had been with, able to tell the Earth State guy looked to be quite chummy with them from the brief moment of seeing them.

He was so stuck in his own little world, he hadn't processed that his children or Jun were speaking to him.

"Dad, quit blushing at Jun!"

THAT looked to get Bolin out of his funk as he looked down at his waterbending son. "I'm not blushing, Noh!"

"But I said that." Nue however corrected him as his firebending daughter, which only made Jun giggle at how silly the detective was acting.

Deciding to bypass this, Bolin grabbed out his wallet and took out some yuan bills to pass to his kids. "Ah, get what you want. Just remember what I told you." he reminded them, Noh and Nue taking the currency before entering the establishment.

All so he could be alone with the bemused White Lotus agent.

"Are they going to be fine alone?" Jun questioned, Bolin unbothered as he pocketed his wallet, glancing inside through the front window to see his kids.

"OH, yeah. If some perv tries anything, they'll just drown and burn his ass." the firebender had no problem with, waving and clapping his hands a bit before deciding to just ask.

"So... uh, who's tall, light and handsome?"

Realizing what was up, Jun nodded. "OH, Khan? He's an associate in the Order, we were going over a case he's been working on involving a cell of New Ozai Society punks. He needed my input." they explained.

That which sounded fine with Bolin...

... if he wasn't tempted to make the obvious joke.

"And by input, you mean inputing his- DAMMIT!"

"NO, not like that." the enby assured, already getting what was up with the firebender. "Never pegged you as the jealous type, Bo."

Hearing the nickname reserved only to few, Bolin did feel himself start blushing, his cheeks going red enough to be seen through his beard.

"I mean, never said I was..." he reluctantly admitted, only for Jun to lightly pat his shoulder with a smile.

"If it means anything, Khan's gay. Like, SUPER gay, he prefers Water Tribe guys with big dicks."

Hearing that got the detective to let out a sudden laugh, which got Jun going as well.

If because he wasn't used to his ex using such naughty words. "Wasn't asking for his sexual preferences, but good to know."

After what happened years prior with the airbender's older sister leading the group of spiritual extremists, having managed to find some form of attraction for each other after their drunken one-night stand, Bolin and Jun decided to give a relationship a shot.

Both did enjoy being a couple, liking all the perks that came with it...

... but about seven months in, it just didn't have the same flair both expected. Which among their chosen professions, provided plenty of reasons for the two to split-up.

But not on bad terms, far from it.

Even after breaking up, the two members of Team Avatar both agreed they worked better as close friends and would be there for each other if needed.

Though Bolin and Jun did have to agree the sex was perhaps the best part of their relationship, deciding that some benefits would stay a thing between them. Though that's only happened about five times within the past year, most recently two months before.

"So, can tell you have the day off. How's it been for you?" the airbender did ask, with the detective nodding along where he stood before them.

"Oh yeah, it's great. Able to relax, not have to worry about whenever some perp is causing shit in the station, all that." Bolin answered before looking them over. "And work for you?"

"Doing my duty, helped out over on Ember Island with boring White Lotus crap, you know."

"Neat. Hey, uh, you wanna continue inside the parlor? Maybe get a cone for yourself, talk to the kids?"

Hearing the offer, able to see why they fell for Bolin in the first place, Jun nodded and began walking to the door.

"I'd like that."

Deciding that if they were to celebrate Aila mastering two out of the four elements, it was Ryoko who insisted they do it in a way like how Korra, her wife, and their friends would have done it, by having some of Narook's.

To the shock of her and Jinora, none of those they knew had ever had noodles from the now world-famous restaurant before. Not even Ka-Kui, though he had the excuse of not being a local.

The two teachers made it their life's goal, at least this day as the rain looked to die down, to make sure they all had Narook's for the first time.

And to their happiness, everyone very much enjoyed not just the food and drinks, but the more home-style feel of the establishment, having kept its roots from since Korra first arrived in Republic City more than fifty years prior.

Sitting around a table were all of those who, within the past almost three years, had gotten closer in a way that made each think of each other as a makeshift family.

Aila didn't need to speak of her training, as it was obvious, instead revealing that she and Honei were in the process of working with Future Industries, Asami Sato's influence still being felt even with the new owner, of possibly having them jump-starting a scholarship program named after their mother.

It was public knowledge that Dr. Asuka Makimura was an engineer at the company, and in recent years, what she learned from building Honei in private would help her work on robotic prosthetic limbs for those who lost their limbs or were born without them.

Both of her daughters wanted it so that she wasn't remembered in death as only 'The Avatar's Mom', but as a brilliant and kind-hearted woman who wanted to help those who needed it with her work.

It was a sentiment that everyone thought was such a caring and kind tribute to the woman who gave her life to save Aila.

Honei herself then brought up that when not helping Aila with her training, she had been reading up on many books and scrolls on bending, including those considered older than the ages of all of those at the table combined.

The robot hoped that with what she could hold in her still expanding CPU, she can help make sure every bit of info she learned would not be lost to time.

Naturally, the element that easily got Honei's attention the more she read about was airbending. Not just due to her love of animals that could fly, but the culture and history of Air Nomads, as well.

There were no objections when the human-looking gynoid claimed that if she was human and a bender, she'd be an airbender for sure.

Yasunori then brought up how he and Honei had recently made plans to ride their sky-bison, named after their late friend, to the Fire Nation to meet up with his mother Sasami and step-father Gon, along with his newborn half-brother, Eiji.

Since both began their relationship, the non-bender had informed his father, step-mom and sister of his girlfriend's true robotic nature and creation. While the three were surprised, with Toru having to make a joke at his son's expense, he, Kenna and Olla all still welcomed Honei with open arms, which made her plenty happy.

For Kallah, she had just moved in with the Makimura's, to be closer to her girlfriend while also having started going to the local university for medical studies. Though she still took the time to stay in contact with her parents in the Fire Nation and her fellow Fire Sisters.

And during this nice meal, Honei rose her glass.

"Alright, a toast to Aila! For not just being an awesome Avatar-in-training, but a great sister, friend, student, and girlfriend!"

All clanged their drinks together and the talking once more went on, all ready for whatever would come next...

Elsewhere, later that night...

"Are you SURE it's happening?!"

"Yes, the ground shook around the lab before it spread."

"Why now?"

"We don't know, Ms. Deka!" A member of the Red Lotus answered the best way he could as the order's leader followed.

Both were rushing down the hallways of their hidden base, heading to a laboratory area.

"The only clues we had was that more and more cracks kept forming around the seal."

"And none of you noticed them until now, let alone informed me?!" Deka questioned, calculating and knowing grey eyes under her square rimmed glasses making sure the underling knew she wasn't happy, purse in hand.

Before he could answer, a loud vibration rumbled out from behind the door they were prepared to enter, getting the both of them to refocus as Deka opened the door to enter.

All to see, surrounded by so many different guards, scientists, and underlings, all members of the order, was the Obsidian sarcophagus the group found years prior in a village near Omashu, now sitting in the middle of a massive lab.

Much monitoring and equipment had been keeping study and watch of the large stone capsule, able to read what energy radiated from it.

Barely any updates had been made known, other than what they had found out.

But it was clear whatever was within it, it was the only being able to break through or even damage it from the inside.

Not even the most powerful of earthbenders or those with special techniques within the Red Lotus were able to even make a single scratch.

But now, movement was heard and felt from inside the sarcophagus, with its power causing the room to shake as the marking on top of it began glowing redder and redder…

… until it glowed no more, confusing most around.

All except Deka, who began to slowly back up.

She wasn't dumb, she knew what was to happen next, one female member taking keen notice.

But before any questions could be made, a human hand burst up from within the sarcophagus, EASILY breaking a hole through the obsidian with ease before it lowered down back in the hole…

… and then another hand did the same, no sounds from whatever was inside being made.

All members of the order held their breath as more and more of the mineral broke apart like Styrofoam. Like a ferocious animal was trying to break itself free.

Finally, the last piece of the black rock fell onto the floor, every single member of the Red Lotus watched in awe and surprise at what was within the now broken sarcophagus…

… it looked like a middle aged man lying down on an altar.

A regular looking fair skinned one who had been asleep for so long, the black scraggly looking long locks of hair on top of his head and his massive brush of a beard being a prime example.

Yet, the figure, who looked to be from the Fire Nation, arose naked from his position, looking to be in decent physical shape with the big body he had, a big scar across his throat.

But everyone, from those spiritually inclined or not, focused more on being able to sense the power that came from the human looking thing.

Just as it was clear the being who awoke had the same marking that was on the sarcophagus branded onto his chest, his eyes opened.

Eyes with no color to them, or even any whites.

Just all black. Like an empty void.

And those eyes seemed to scan the environment he found itself in, seeing so many different figures in different attires he was not familiar with in the slightest, breathing deeply.

For a brief moment, he actually thought to himself, wondering just how long he slept before slowly stepping off where he laid on his two feet, naked as the day it was born.

"That's it? THAT'S FUCKING IT?!"

A lone voice called out, getting everyone's attention as one of the lower tier members began to make his way through the crowd, looking to be someone from the North Pole, shaking his head.

"We waited almost three years to know what's under all that rock, and it's just some random asshole?!" he called out, not even caring he was speaking rudely before Deka.

Something which the one female Red Lotus member, who spotted her backing away earlier, took careful notice of, with her eyes an surprising bright yellow, all while the lower half of her tanned face was covered by a black and purple face mask.

Attention was focused on the ignorant Red Lotus who approached the nude figure who he actually loomed a few inches above, for the newly-awoken only stood around 5' 10''.

"Come on Deka, this guy is NOTHING!" he called out to the glasses-wearing woman, making sure to poke at the black-eyed man's chest as he looked at her, not impressed in the slightest.

"He looks like a freakin' pushover. What is he, five foot noth-"

His claims would be proven wrong as within a split second, he felt two powerful hands take him by the back of the head and his jaw before the marked figure SWIFTLY TWISTED HIS NECK WITH EASE!

A loud crunching snap rang out in the large room as the guy's head had been forcibly spun around in a hundred and eighty degrees!

The wide eyes of the boastful Red Lotus member were only able to stare down at, his mouth giving a silent gasp, his emotionless killer behind him who only just stood there…

… before poking a single finger against the dead man's back, causing the still standing corpse to fall to the ground as all were shocked at this display of violence.

"GET HIM RESTRAINED!" Another foolish soul called out as they and two others came at him, to which Deka, who wasn't surprised by what she saw, tried to call out an order.

"NO! WAIT!"

But while some didn't listen, she was quick enough to hold a hand and arm in the way of the face mask-wearing member, the shaking look on the older woman's face clearly telling her not to try joining in on what was about to go down.

The quiet girl was wise and decided to take heed, as the next three Red Lotus members who dared try attacking this vicious killer only fell as easily as the first one.

One tried to use firebending, only for the naked man to quickly grab him by the back of his head and slammed him face first into the edge of the altar it laid upon, EASILY bashing half of the man's face in like it was a rotting pumpkin hitting a wall!

The other two Red Lotus members, a female from the Earth States and a male airbender, instead of trying to fight, attempted to grab and restrain him.

For the female's troubles, the marked figure reacted by elbowing her across the face, or more specifically, the lower half which due to the force of the Hunter's elbow hitting her, her jaw had been literally TORN OFF IN THE PROCESS!

Her bloody tongue flopped around exposed torn flesh, blood pouring from it as it was a gruesome sight for everyone who saw it.

One that was mercifully short as she dropped dead from shock.

Not letting that stop him, the airbender grabbed the Hunter by the wrist and jerked it upwards.

Hard enough to break it, causing broken bone to tear through skin and muscle, getting the powerful man to stop...

... only to see him not flinch in pain, but look more confused as he tilted his head at the damage.

The airbender just looked on dumbfounded at what he saw.

"What in the- ACKK!"

He was left open for the unflinching injured TO STAB HIM IN THE JAW WITH HIS EXPOSED WRIST BONES, through the mouth and up enough to hit the brain!

This killer didn't like to be provoked, be disturbed, or mistreated. Those who did any of those unwise actions would suffer.

But these four fools got off easy, at least compared to his main target.

Dropping the dead bender to the ground, the silent man was prepared to fight and kill those around him, his heavy breathing loud enough for all to hear as he popped his wrist back into place...

... letting all see the flesh and bone heal up back to normal, like nothing happened.

"HUNTER!"

The ears of the silent killer caught his familiar title being spoken before looking to see an even more unfamiliar woman, one who didn't seem scared of it.

Trying to understand what this oddly dressed female with the glasses and grey eyes sought, the marked figure had to know something.

"Who are you? And WHERE am I?"

Hearing what this monstrous killer had to say with such a human voice, that made things easier for Deka.

"Relax, you're among friends." she spoke, trying to calm things down between her allies and their guest, glancing at the bodies. "Mostly. But we intend no harm, do you understand?"

"Perhaps."

"Good enough, let's try clearing the air."

All watched as Deka approached him, not being afraid of murder standing right in front of her.

"Me and my allies all know what you are. How you ended up in that sarcophagus… what you have done."

Even if his facial reactions didn't show it, the blackened-eyed man was just a bit curious as to how this lowly human knew about him, slowly walking around.

"We know WHAT you had managed to do in the past before your slumber." Deka explained, able to see she was making some progress. "All of us, the Order of The Red Lotus, seek to create a new world order. To get rid of the established governments, their corrupt figureheads…"

"That's none of my concern." The man simply stated.

But then, just close enough, Deka's grey eyes looked into those black pools where normal eyes should be with a smile on her face.

"You're correct. Only what the Father had ordered you to do. You're a sort of back up plan in case things with Raava didn't go as planned." she explained before nonchalantly shrugging.

"And sorry to disappoint, but things didn't go as planned."

It was just a small turn of the neck, but the leader of the Red Lotus wasn't dumb, Deka knew she had this killer's attention now.

"I believe we share a similar goal, and the Red Lotus can lend you a helping hand." she said before looking down at the purse with the red and black lotus flower on it in hand, opening it before taking a piece of paper out, unfolding it.

"Do give this a look."

With one last unfolding, Deka handed the naked man a photo.

One of Avatar Aila Makimura meeting the president of Republic City from weeks before, making sure to point a manicured finger at her smiling face.

"See this girl? Her name is Aila Makimura, the newest Avatar…"

Hearing the familiar moniker, those blackened eyes went wide, SOMETHING igniting a burning flame of rage and anger within his heart.

Something that Deka liked to see.

"It's time for you to do what Vaatu asked of you while trapped in that damn tree," she spoke, seeing him crumble the photo in hand tightly. "To let the hunt begin once more after all these years. Would you like to know WHERE she is?"

The blood covered man only nodded his head in response, the obvious response the mature woman knew she'd get.

"I'll tell you. But first, I think you're in need of a bath, some trimming, and a proper set of clothes." she pointed out, looking over the large powerful nude body that was in need of a wash. "Then we'll point you in the right direction, so you can hunt down the Avatar for us in any way you seek and slay her."

Stopping as she kept speaking, Deka bravely rested a hand on his shoulder from behind.

"Aila being in the Avatar State when you kill her is optional. But if you can manage that, that'd be nice. So, do we have a deal, Hunter?"

"Wolf..."

The man bearing the mark of the Hunter on his chest, known to some as the Avatar Hunter, didn't need to think over the offer as he spoke the name of the animal he was most like.

For he very much wanted to hunt down his prey and end Raava's host however he saw fit.

After all, he had managed to do so before in the past with Avatar Ho-Seok.

Closing his eyelids for a moment as he seemed to take a deep breath, the Hunter reopened them, showing his eyes now resembled those of a regular man's, the iris being amber colored as he turned to look at his newest temporary partner.

"Call me Wolf. And yes, we do."

Notes:

And, we have begun. All with a flashback to back when Aila’s father, Bachu, was still alive, reading her a bedtime story. One from a book that he’s always had, that had once belonged to his mother. And unknowing to him or anyone, Kuvira has been eavesdropping and watching them, still unsure of showing herself just yet as she leaves. But already, things look to have been since the time skip looking up. Our Avatar lead, Aila Makimura, has just finally completed and mastered fire AND air bending after two and a half years, as well as showing off her platinum bending, with her robotic big sister Honei, our Sokka/Asami non-bender of the group, Yasunori… and Aila’s girlfriend, Kallah there giving her mad props. As does Jinora, Ryoko and Ka-kui, all deciding to celebrate.

As that goes on, we do catch up with Bolin II with his son and daughter, about to have some ice cream… when they bump into the White Lotus agent, Jun! And it’s clear that YES, the two adults tried to be in a relationship, but they decided it’s just better to stay friends… with benefits. XD But the two are still on great terms, with Jun tagging along for some ice cream. And we do find out what each of the others have been up to, Aila making sure to get a scholarship started named after her late mother, Honei having been getting more into spirituality and bending, especially airbending. Yasunori is ready to take his girlfriend along to the Fire Nation to hang out with his mom and step-dad, as with his newest sibling. And Kallah has been studying at the local university in the medical field, while also now living with Aila and Honei, her and Aila’s relationship becoming more sweeter down the line…

… but of course, it can’t be all nice… for the Order of the Red Lotus has been up to no good. And as the leader, Deka, finds out, what they found at the end of Book One is… starting to awaken and break free. And as she, along with a mysterious face mask-wearing member with weird glowing eyes witness, it looks to be a man. One who violently kills those who provoke him with such power and strength no mortal human should hold. But Deka is brave, seeing the marking on his chest, KNOWING who he is and what he has done… for before all of them is the Avatar Hunter. A being created for one purpose, which is kind of obvious by the title… and she shows the unsure being a picture of Aila, wanting to unleash him on her to end her life AND hopefully end the Avatar Chain… to which, revealing the name given to him upon his creation, Wolf says he’ll do the job.

OH BOY…

Chapter 2: Chapter Two- Unleashed

Notes:

Hey hey gang, time we get into the next chapter of "Book Two" of "Rise of Aila"! And with our Hunter now awakened, as with Aila ready to continue after mastering two of the four elements, let us see where things go from here... sorry for the ending.

Also also, Paramount, after botching things up per usual, decided to move up the release of the new "Aang: The Last Airbender" film to later this month as of this chapter's release, July 2026... still streaming and not theaters, but I sadly made peace with that. (The fucks). Now will I include some references to the film after it comes out? Maybe. There is a fancasting I did go for from the ONE leaked clip I saw of it that made me go for the choice, you'll see down later in this fic.
