Chapter 10: Chapter Ten- Memories

Notes:

And hey hey, it's time for a new "Rise of Aila" chapter! So let's just get into things with our heroes and Wolf...

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, including some slurs, a brief moment of animal abuse and some harsh bloody violence and gore. (Don't worry, those who are killed deserved it)

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Honei took a deep breath, steadying herself. After trying multiple times, fruitlessly, to get into the spirit world, it was getting a little frustrating.

She thought that she should have gotten it by now, especially since everyone else had it down pretty easily.

To be fair, they were all humans, and not, well, a robot. But she had a spirit, a soul, the dark skinned girl knew she did!

So why couldn't she get it down?! It's not exactly something easy to do, but it wasn't exactly hard, either.

"Honei, I sense great stress coming from you…"

Those artificial green eyes of the robotic girl opened, seeing both airbending masters Yasuko and Opal looking at her curiously as they all sat in the beautiful gardens of Zaofu, the latter having spoken.

"Can you please share with us what's wrong?" The Sato woman politely asked, holding her hand as so much went through Honei's mind.

But it took a second for her to see the look on her little sister's face, too curious.

But she wasn't dumb, Honei knew when something was within Aila's mind.

Something that she had a good feeling about.

"I-uh, I guess I just, I don't know..." Honei responded, knowing she had to explain herself sooner or later.

"Aila, I know that you want to know why I kept it from you, so I guess I'll start there."

Aila, who had thought she was doing a rather good job of hiding it, was surprised. Honei wasn't wrong, but she hadn't thought it was quite that obvious.

"It was, uh, really that obvious?" Aila asked, feeling a little bad.

Honei just chuckled lightly before continuing. "Maybe not to others, but it was plain as day to me."

"Well, there's so much, I don't know where to start... like, I dunno, how come you never told me about Kuvira?" The Avatar asked, deciding to just go for the jugular.

It was a question that did seem to interest the other two, especially Opal, who scooted closer to the robot sibling.

"You said Kuvira told you back when the Spirited attacked the Western Air Temple?" she asked, at which Honei nodded innocently.

"Yes. She accidentally called me her granddaughter after that Spirited member hurt me and... well, she told me the truth there and then. I mean, it makes sense… someone hurt her granddaughter, and she wanted to protect me."

Looking over with her green eyes to Aila's blue, hearing her listen, Honei continued, her voice shaking with emotion.

"Grandma wanted to be the one to tell you, asked that I keep quiet. We pinky swore and I didn't want to disappoint her... please don't hate me."

"Why would I hate you?" Aila said, confused, "I mean, I'm a little upset and angry, but I don't hate you!"

That response, while well meaning, didn't make Honei feel any better, feeling more guilty.

"Then why are you upset and angry with me?"

"Because I... Spirits, where do I begin?" Aila admitted, the weight of everything bringing things apart. "Well, turns out dad is a Beifong, his parents are Kuvira and Baatar Jr., she's our grandma, we're both Beifongs-"

"You're a Beifong…"

The hurt in the robot's voice was evident to all in the room as Aila, Opal and Yasuko heard the sadness coming forth, Honei's mood starting to sour.

"I'm no Beifong, remember? I'm not human, I'm a robot, I just happen to look like a Beifong who died."

"What a crock of shit…"

Surprisingly, it was not Aila or even Yasuko who said that, but the one and only Opal Beifong.

All whipped their heads toward the white-haired airbender who shook her head.

"Honei, we've only really known each other at least five days and we all just found out what Kuvira told us. But if your sister and mother can and do see you as a Makimura, Kuvira and I, not to mention the rest of us, can see you as a Beifong," she spoke with kind words before shrugging a bit. "Although, not literally by blood because I doubt you have human blood in you."

"Nope, oil." Honei answered, still amazed by the elder airbender's words she heard.

"But, robot or human, original or not, you're still one of our clan. You will ALWAYS be a Beifong, even if you're not the first Honei. You hear me, Honei Beifong?"

Hearing her first name combined with the famous last name, her famous last name, did make her CPU work up an good feeling emotion.

"Honei Beifong. Not gonna lie, I like the sound of that." The robot admitted. "Not to mention, Aila Beifong." she said to her little sister, who gave it quick thought and smiled.

"Aila and Honei Makimura-Beifong."

"Even better!"

Both sisters laughed hearing all that before calming down, the Avatar speaking up first.

"Honei, while part of me does wish you actually told me, I understand why you never told me about Gra... Gran... Grann... WOW, it's a bit unusual to call Kuvira that."

Chuckling at what seemed to be Aila still trying to get a grasp of things, Honei wrapped her arms around her. "You'll get it down sooner or later, Aila. Like me trying to get meditation down..."

Both Opal and Yasuko were happy to see progress being made between the two, bonding over the new grandmother in their lives.

"Let's try to meditate one more time." Yasuko spoke up, in the same mental wavelength as Opal, watching the human and robotic duo get back into position. "If it doesn't work for Honei, perhaps we can try again tomorrow when we've all got clearer heads."

"Sounds perfect." the Makimura-Beifong sisters replied at the same time.

Roaluk sat on the chair, sipping his tea, taking all the info in as much as he could as with everyone else, a short, black haired female walking towards the table his age, with a fairly noticeable fancy ring on.

And, while being Fire Nation-born, she was certainly a local of the area, looking completely in her element.

"So, this is the legendary cousin-in-law of yours." The chef spoke, a single ear covered in multiple gold piercings as she looked down at her husband. "Must say, she's looking amazing for her nineties. I should borrow some tips."

"And much more, from the sounds of things, Aiko..." The waterbender agreed as all Kuvira herself could do was just snigger at the couple.

"And you finally found yourself someone to get you to stop being a stick in the mud, good on you!"

Hearing the good-humored snipe, Roaluk just took his wife Aiko's hand, covering it with the hand that had his own ring, smiling up at her.

"Twenty-two years on, no regrets."

"Well, except for that trip to the South Pole. That one was cold!"

"Oh, please, that's only because the weather was snowier than normal! Besides, you're a firebender, you're naturally warm."

"True, but it's beside the point! It's the South freakin' Pole, how was that even possible?!"

Watching the legendary former Great Uniter banter with both the doctor and his husband, the two young members of Team Avatar, along with Toph and Kaguya, were just watching in silence, almost as if it were like watching a comedy VB series.

"Just earlier, we were learning about an unstoppable killer of Avatar's coming for Aila…" Yasunori had to point out before Kallah finished for him.

"And now, we're watching the former leader of the Earth Empire chatting up with a couple acting like a bunch of wolfcatty bitches."

Everyone burst out laughing, none more than the two in question.

"My, that was a good one! I'll have to remember that for later." Aiko exclaimed.

"Feel like this is the Spirit's way of messing with us." Kaguya remarked, shaking her head.

Deciding to try bringing the attention to something else, Kallah politely raised her hand.

"Um, excuse me? Kuvira?"

That indeed did break up the conversation, the platinum bender looking at her.

But before she could ask, the large doors to the room opened up, yet to everyone's surprise, it was the large sand wolf making its way in, Quy-Mo riding on it's back.

"Sweet spirits, he's huge! Kuvira, you didn't mention he'd be that big!" Aiko jumped in surprise at how large Junior was, seeing the two animals make their way in.

"It's alright, Junior's a good boy, and he's careful, too." Kuvira insisted as she pet her animal friend under his chin, along with getting behind Quy-Mo's ears as well, finding the unlikely animal friendship adorable.

"Looks like he's getting along with Quy-Mo, too."

The mood between all was so lively...

... well, it was kind of the opposite that two not in the room with them were enduring.

Hearing those two BIG words, Bolin felt like he had just been kicked in the groin hard, eyes unable to blink as he just looked at the airbender before him.

"You're... YOU'RE..."

Jun only nodded in silence, keeping their sight out for anyone who may stumble upon them.

Something the firebender did as well, spotting a empty washroom nearby, to which he carefully grabbed his ex by the wrist and brought them inside before shutting it behind them.

Once done, he turned back around.

"Okay, first thing's first. Are you SURE you're... well, carrying?"

Able to collect their bearings enough, Jun nodded along to what he had to ask. "Yes, I mentioned that I'm-"

"Late, I know. But what about any other proof, you being late for a period could mean something else." Bolin retorted, getting only an annoyed look back.

"Bolin, you've never dealt with such things once a month because you're not a woman or were a woman."

"I mean I was raised by my mom. And a whole bunch of Fire Nuns more or- Alright, you get what I mean.

Sighing where they were, seeing themselves in the mirror, the enby just shook their head.

"All the times I've been throwing up in the morning, duh, morning sickness." they brought up before shaking their head. "I didn't think much of it until I noticed how delayed things were with my... you know. So I snuck into the medical wing this morning, before anyone woke up."

Revealing this, Jun wouldn't forget what else came next.

"I found where they kept the pregnancy tests, took a few to be safe. And they ALL came back positive." Jun insisted, still shocked to see it before their very eyes as they looked to see Bolin thinking something over.

He couldn't argue with proof like that, and he wasn't around for when Koha and Narue found out the insemination worked...

... which left him to ask something VERY important.

"So, am I the-"

"NO..."

It was so quick and sudden the way Jun answered, the White Lotus agent realizing how fast they answered, having to calm themselves down with a quick breath.

"N-No... You're not the father." they insisted, standing their ground. "Remember... Khan?"

The name was one Bolin wouldn't forget, remembering the co-agent he saw Jun with back home.

"Yeah, Mr. Super Gay, into Water Tribe guys with big-"

A reluctant laugh slipped out from Jun at hearing that, remembering they said that. "Y-Yeah, uh, turns out I... Uh, lied. I've been seeing him for a bit and... well, put two and two together."

Able to feel a sense of relief, Bolin did know he couldn't celebrate hearing that just yet, being careful to bring Jun in for a hug.

For ex-enbyfriend or not, he was ready to show his support.

"Don't you worry, green-eyes. You'll handle this."

"Will I?" he heard Jun asked of him, feeling them hug him back, having to nod in agreement.

"Yeah, of course. I've seen you with Noh and Nue, you'd be a great parent."

"Nommie."

"Non-binary term for parent?"

"Yes."

"Then you'll be a great nommie."

Hearing that, thankful to hear Bolin give support, Jun did smile, much thoughts going through their minds.

"Thanks, Bo." they smiled, thinking of one thought. "Don't tell the others, let me do it when I'm ready."

"Yeah, of course." the firebender promised.

"LET THEM GO! PLEASE, STOP!"

"The dark spirit will merge with the flesh…"

"No, please, don't… please, I'm begging you…"

"The heart of the pure soul is needed, as is the blood of innocence…"

For some reason, all Wolf could see, or, rather, lack thereof, was darkness, no color or shape remotely visible.

Only the voices were able to be heard, the voices that sounded quite the opposite. One that was sinister, vile, and malicious...

... yet the other one sounded like himself. Only he sounded distressed, crying out, and pleading.

There were also other voices that were hard to hear, like something was covering them up.

Wolf had no idea what was happening, but whatever it was, it was surely horrible to the one who had just heard the slash of a knife.

"AHH! NO! NOO… nooo, ahhhh… no…"

More piercing sounds of metal slicing and dicing into flesh were heard, the morbid sounds echoing, reverberating, in his mind.

Still, nothing was seen as his voice kept ringing out.

However, one thing it did register, albeit however vaguely, was a familiar mark, slowly gliding into view, glowing an ominous shade of blood red.

"Arise, oh arise, great hunter, for the Father has requested for you a great mission…"

Before he knew it, Wolf's eyes snapped open where he stood in the shower he was currently standing in, the water splashing on its skin.

It just came up while in the middle of washing himself, but now the Hunter found itself back into a rather confused reality.

Not only did he feel perplexed at what it was hearing, but he actually felt... fear?

Just what was he hearing, and why was he the one crying out?!

At that moment, loud barks and growls were heard outside, easily audible through the thin walls of the motel bathroom Wolf was in, where it stepped out and dried itself off with the towels, listening.

"AWRF! Urrghhh..."

It figured it must've been that one bear dogs those two morons talked about.

"HEY, I told ya' to shut up!"

The Avatar Hunter knew that was one of them, the one with the lazy eye. But it felt it wasn't it's personal business, putting on some clothes it had stolen from a basket from one of the rooms nicknamed a… laundromat?

It was some place that looked to clean up clothes, apparently.

However, despite being a widely visible place, the amber-eyed Hunter EASILY stole those belonging to a man.

As for how to clean and dry said clothes would be a matter for another time.

Slipping on the attire that was common these days, Wolf was prepared to rest up for the night, maybe try to figure out what exactly he saw in his mind, slowly closing his eyes…

"RWAGH! AAWF!"

At that moment, the violent being's eyes snapped back open, rising up from its bed that it had rented for the night, the sound emanating from the weird animals outside, garnering its attention.

"Errhhh!"

The Hunter wasn't an idiot, it was clearly a sound of pain.

"What'd he fucking tell you!"

It was that yellow-toothed idiot speaking, almost as if...

The Avatar Hunter quickly realized what had just happened, being reminded of the catdeer and the hunters, clenching hiss hand tightly, almost ripping the bedsheet in the process.

These fools just COULDN'T give him a good night's sleep…

Outside, there was a caged door, which was locked with metalbending, the two brothers looking at the three animals with brown fur locked behind it.

"Bad boys! No frockling around for the rest of the night!" Yellow Teeth said, demeaning, and somewhat manically, towards the rather large animals, as Lazy-Eye shook his head, menacingly.

"Damn near almost burnt myself with the torch 'cause of you, ya' furry bastard!"

"Urrhhh..."

The bear dog whimpered quietly, but still entirely audible to the welder's sharp ears.

"Oh, quit your whining, ya' little shit."

The bear dog, not wanting to upset its owner, attempted to quell the noise, but it was still somewhat discernible.

"Erhhh..."

"Hey, sounds like you after that out-of-towner whooped your ass." Yellow Teeth snickered, laughing at his brother, who wasn't happy with the comparison.

"Fuck you!"

"NO, FUCK YOU!"

The repeated use of expletives continued until the torch that Lazy-Eye held was noticeably starting to run out of fuel, getting both's attention, the animals behind the cage taking sight.

"Shit, running low on fuel." Yellow Teeth realized as his brother tried to turn the tank back on, to spark up a flame with a striker, but failing.

"We got another tank and torch somewhere, have to get work done tonight."

"I'll check the shed…"

Neither brother realized that, during all their yelling, a lone figure had snuck around the junkyard.

What the Hunter didn't notice when it grabbed some metal linking, scanning the area, was a large animal coming towards him.

Hearing the creature's foot steps, Wolf peered closer at the shape moving his way, before getting a good proper look at the bear dog.

That must have been the one that the Hunter had heard.

And, the Avatar Hunter had to admit, it was quite a large being, walking on its hind legs, seeming like a big, brown, hairy dog with the head of a bear, it's brown eyes peering into his own false ones.

Thankfully, Lazy-Eye was too distracted lighting up a smoke to notice as the Avatar Hunter realized the rather frightening looking animal wasn't snarling or sneering at it...

... it was curious, able to sense something different about the quiet man, who himself spotted odd markings on the animal.

To his surprise, Wolf being realized it had scars and burn marks, as well as large, missing, patches of fur. Some freshly made, some old.

In fact, so did the other bear dogs in the cage, all rather miserable in their current living conditions.

These two humans have been abusing these animals for perceived slights against them, an idea that Wolf did NOT like one single bit.

Even now, Lazy Eye still had no idea what was happening, or who was among their presence, coming his way.

Walking practically soundlessly towards the smoking man, the Avatar Hunter seethed, so many absolutely enraged and violent thoughts completely flooding through his mind…

... all while the other in the messy shed had no idea as what was going on.

"Where the fuck is it?"

Yellow Teeth muttered to himself, knowing there had been a torch and fuel in there somewhere.

He knew where he placed it, but maybe his brother was an idiot and moved it.

"I swear to the spirits, I'mma whoop his ass if it turns out-"

Before he finished, something thick and big hit against his back.

Not hard enough to hurt him, but it was like someone lobbied a kick ball against his back. But it was enough to scare him in place.

"AHH! SHIT! You dick!" he asked out loud, standing up to turn around to see what was just thrown at him, "Why the shit you throwing... huh?"

But it wasn't a ball that Yellow Teeth was now gawking at on the mud and grass covered ground...

... it was the severed head of his brother, the look on Lazy-Eye's face looking to be permanently screaming out where it laid!

Looking like someone tore it off his neck.

"YAAHHH! OH FUCK!"

Before he could call out to his mother as he looked back up, a powerful hand grasped all over his whole face, muffling any attempts of screaming.

"EERRMMMHH!"

Not letting go with his eyes pure black, Wolf kept his grip on the struggling junkyard worker, the look of anger once more on his face, forcing the target of his rage onto his knees as he began to slowly dig his fingers deep.

And like putty in its hands, upon closing in his hand, THE ENTIRE FRONT HALF OF YELLOW TEETH'S HEAD WAS COMPRESSED AND CRUSHED IN LIKE NOTHING, BLOOD, EYE AND BRAIN MATTER SQUIRTING OUT BETWEEN WOLF'S FINGERS!

Throwing the mutilated body onto the ground with a thud, Wolf breathed heavily at what he had done.

"WHAT THE FUCK IS GOING ON?!"

The motel clerk, those idiots' mother, called out, no doubt having heard the commotion.

"Is the stupid bear dogs acting out again?!"

It was not unnoticed by the Avatar Hunter, who turned her way.

Indeed, the Motel Clerk had come onto the scene a small moment later, being in the dark about what had just happened.

"I swear to the spirits, you dumb shits ought to–"

She trailed off upon seeing the ghastly scene, her own sons laying dead. One missing his head and the other who's face was destroyed, all while the bear dogs were barking loudly.

"AWF! AWWF! AWWF!"

Barely having enough time to even think of blinking or hear anything, what felt like a blunt object of metal cracked against the woman's head, sending her straight to the ground hard.

"Ughhh..."

A lone, loud whine came from the injured woman as she tried to get up, raising her head, the blood from the open head wound making it hard for her to see, as well as dripping onto her lips, where she coughed, weakly.

"Aghh... huh?"

Turning herself onto her back, the lone woman just now noticed Wolf standing over her, tilting his head with the one empty gas tank connected to the torches in both hands, what he just used to crack upside her head.

"Wha-"

Right as she struggled to speak, the otherwise still heavy gas tank was thrown down directly onto her face, completely OBLITERATING A THIRD OF HER HEAD INTO PIECES UPON IMPACT!

Giving a deep breath, knowing the woman had her part in allowing the abuse of those bear dogs to happen, Wolf had no qualms about killing her.

That settled, the Hunter quietly marched over to the cage door, taking hold of it before easily tearing the cheap metal off the hinges.

All to free the thankful animals who rushed out, past the corpses, running out into the nearby forest.

Such a sight did bring a weird, but welcoming feeling into Wolf's heart.

Panting filled then happened to fill his ears, looking to the side to see the one bear dog that first noticed him looking up, tilting its head just like it's savior with thankful eyes.

Perhaps, for the first time that wasn't meant to fool any humans around him, the hunter did something as his eyes turned from blackness to amber…

… the Avatar Hunter smiled as it reached out to pet the animal behind the ears, feeling the coarse fur on it's fingers.

It actually felt good to do so.

Still, Wolf knew he couldn't stay here any longer, he had to get away from the scene, taking his clothes from it's room.

But not without noticing an empty truck in the parking lot.

The Hunter knew it belonged to those two idiot welders, and, approaching it, noticed the keys were still in the ignition.

Remembering back when the truck driver, not to mention the satobus driver, had operated their vehicles, another idea formed in the Hunter's mind.

Well, it'd certainly make getting to the Avatar all the more easier, even if it had to get proper directions.

"Aila, Honei, you have no idea how long I've been wanting to share this with you two…"

Both sisters, having come back from their meditation with Yasuko and Opal after the robot once more failed to get it down, were back in the guest room where they sat next to their grandmother on the couch, seeing the scrapbook she held in hand.

One she had brought all the way from her current home.

"Me and your grandfather had started working on this once your father was born, putting in as many fond memories as we could of him." Kuvira spoke proudly as everyone else in the room stayed silent, to give the three their moment. Including Bolin and Jun who had come back from their private talk.

Opening the cover, the first image was of herself with Baatar Jr. on their wedding day, Kuvira herself wearing a beautiful green wedding dress, her baby bump showing.

"We had our wedding just after Anka, the Fertility spirit, and Korra helped me become pregnant. Quicker than planned, but it was still wonderful."

"Woah, you look so pretty Grandma Kuvi…" Honei cooed, upon seeing the picture of the younger Kuvira, who, in response, snickered.

"Me, in my prime as well. If I was that young and had all my bending as powerful as it is now..." she said in a wishful, playful manner as Aila herself touched the photo, able to sense from it just how elated and happy the newlywed was.

"I had seen through Korra's eyes her bringing you and… grandpa to the Spirit World, to meet Anka." the Avatar admitted to which Kuvira herself nodded.

"I remember that day. I was... pretty nervous, to be honest. It got easier as the time passed. Especially after all the other times we failed to have children, we weren't sure if Anka would help…"

At that second, Kuvira remembered the two words that made her relax at the time.

"But once she said she would help, it put us at ease."

Turning away from the scrapbook, Aila looked at her grandmother and saw her remember.

"Was it easy? Anka taking part of yours and Grandpa Baatar's spirits, combining it with her power and then putting it back in you?" she asked before seeing the look in Kuvira's eyes dimmer. "Kuvira?"

"Sorry, just… Well, it just, uh… there was a bit of a snag..." The elder woman admitted...

Years before...

"NO! Anka, that can't be! That can't be it!"

Korra had just seen the former Great Uniter drop down to her knees and begin crying out at what the fertility spirit revealed, all as Baatar Beifong Jr. held his love in his arms, trying to comfort her, even though he too was devastated to hear the news.

"I'm sorry, Avatar Korra, but there's nothing I can do. My spiritual abilities can't work on those who, biologically, can't bear children." The unique looking spirit tried to explain, coming down from her webbing and crawled up to the Avatar, peering at them with her many eyes.

"If I was able to, I would do so."

"Please, Anka..."

Attention was brought to Baatar Jr., who had to let go of Kuvira, so he could approach the spirit himself.

"There has to be some form of way for you to help Kuvira. I know this isn't due to what happened with the spirit vines years ago, but it isn't right to let her suffer like this. Kuvira's already been through so much pain in her life." he pleaded as the spirit looked at him.

"Mr. Beifong, I know exactly how she feels." Anka admitted, her multiple green eyes looking into his two with regret.

"Able to use my power for those who seek to have children, while unable to have those I could call my own, it is not lost on me. Hence why I consider those are born by my power children of my own."

Skittering her eight legs around, the spirit held up one of it's front limbs out to Kuvira, just below her chin to lift her head up, to show that she was not alone.

"If anyone knows your pain, it's me. If my abilities could work on you, I would do it in a heartbeat... but I just can't, not with what we know."

Kuvira, stopping her crying for a moment, was able to see that even the spirit looked saddened to be telling her this, feeling a special connection to her.

But an idea came into Korra's mind throughout all of this.

"What if I used energybending on Kuvira?"

Hearing her question, the couple and the spirit turned to the Avatar, surprised to hear such an idea.

"Energybending?" Baatar asked, at which Korra herself nodded, pointing to Kuvira.

"Yeah, my bending should work here since the three of us came through a Spirit Portal. If it's possible to restore and take away bending, then it should be possible to bend Kuvira's life energy in a way to possibly alter her body."

"Are you suggesting that if you're to energybend her..." Anka began to question to which the metalbender herself stood up and approached her friend.

"You could possibly heal up my reproductive system and-"

"Make you perfectly healthy enough for Anka's powers to work on you."

The idea sounded so crazy... and that's because it was, Baatar Jr. having to be the one to raise up his hand.

"I'm not trying to put things on a sour note, not in any way, but... has that ever been done with energybending?" he asked, not wanting to go in half-cocked and things going wrong. "Like, being able to heal up a person's body with it? Much more than water healing?"

"No, not that I know of." Korra replied before looking up at the large spirit. "Anka?"

The spirit rose one of her legs to where her chin would be, thinking.

"If there was any instance of it happening, it was way before my conception."

"Well, still, it's worth a shot, isn't it?" Korra asked before looking at the couple. "What will be the worst that'll happen, that it doesn't work? That shouldn't matter, you two could still adopt, raise and love another child as your own."

Hearing Korra give her speech, her words did seem to get through to the couple..

"Come on guys, it's a wild and crazy theory, I know, but what if it DOES work? There's a fifty-fifty chance, and it's better to go for broke than not going for it at all and wonder years later, when it's too late, if you should have gone for it."

Those words made so much sense, so hopeful, enough that Kuvira looked at the man she loved.

"Baatar, she's right." she admitted, seeing him look back at her. "We have to just try."

"And if it doesn't work?" Battar asked to which the metalbender just gave a faint smile.

"I… I wouldn't mind adoption, either. Like what your mother did for me, along with Lin and Kya raising Roaluk."

Hearing the hope once more visible in the voice of the woman he loved, Baatar knew his answer.

"Alright, Korra, do it."

With that, Korra glanced up at Anka, who simply nodded, crawling backwards, and watched the Avatar approach her friend.

"This... I don't know, maybe it will hurt, maybe not? I don't know."

They were words that didn't seem to worry the woman, who, unknown to anyone at the moment, would become the future grandmother of the next Avatar.

"You hurting me? Because that's never happened before."

That response did get an amused snicker from Korra as both closed their eyes, prepared as the Avatar reopened her eyes, now glowing white like the shape of Raava on her chest.

As she then held one hand on Kuvira's stomach, where her womb would be, and another on her forehead, focusing on her energy...

Explaining the events definitely put Kuvira in a better mood.

"... and thankfully, as it turns out, it worked, it actually worked. Because of Korra, I could finally be a mother." She spoke highly of her old friend, a thankful smile on her face as she looked at her two grandchildren.

"Anka, of course, verified that and did the process herself, just to play safe. And, months later, we finally got the good news, I was finally pregnant with your father. I never felt so happy in my life..."

Saying that, Kuvira flipped the page, showing a photo of just after her giving birth, holding her wrapped up baby in her arms, both Baatar's and Suyin at her side.

Little Baatar Bachu Beifong the Third.

"... it was only second to when Baatar finally came into our world. Or Bachu as you two knew of him."

Both Aila and Honei couldn't believe how rosy-cheeked their father looked in the photo, as well as the others they saw of him.

"Technically speaking, if I'm correct, not only am I your father's aunt, but my children were his cousins as well." Opal began to speak up proudly, getting the two sister's attention before looking at the detective named after her husband with a funny grin.

"And since I'm also your great aunt, Baatar the Third, and by extension Aila and Honei, are technically related to you as well through your mother, Bolin..."

A fact which caused the Avatar, the robot, and the firebender to instantly glance at each other as the realization kicked in like, for a lack of term, a son of a bitch for not just them, but everyone else.

"You gotta be fucking kidding..."

Of course, it was Bolin who let out the curse, the other two could only feel some form of awkwardness at the truth being revealed.

"Ahhh… let's let you two get back to the scrapbook." the firebender muttered, at a loss for words. The Makimura-Beifong siblings agreed, going back to Kuvira's book and turning the page, rather choosing to go deal with one realization at a time.

On the next one, they saw their father being fed by his grandmother, another of a infant Toph II playing metal blocks with him, him in a silly little scientist spiritween costume as he was held by Kuvira, she herself dressed up like a wolf-lady.

To both sisters' amazement, there was even a photo of their father being held by a very familiar elderly woman in green and yellow, her pale green eyes looking so proud.

"WOAH, our father knew the original Toph Beifong?" Aila asked to her surprise, something which Kuvira sniggered at, knowing the truth.

"Knew? Heck, Toph practically demanded she at least be able to hold onto her newest great-grandson before she keeled over, in her own words."

That made both sisters happy to hear, able to see even in her advanced age, the old friend of Aang softly held their father, a smile on her lips.

Another photo of their father in his spiritween costume was seen, now with Suyin who unlike the other pictures was sitting in her bed, a peaceful look in her eyes.

Some machines at her bedside.

It was one all those who knew Su at the time knew of it's important significance.

"This photo was actually one of the last taken of your great-grandmother before she passed away three months later. Suyin told me being a grandmother was the greatest thing she could be." Kuvira explained, remembering what that wonderful woman proudly told her and her husband.

She also remembered Su's final words to her the day before her death and took them to heart.

'No matter what happened in the past, I'm thankful for you, Kuvira. You are and always will be a Beifong...'

Kuvira knew Suyin would be proud of her own granddaughters.

Each other photo the sisters saw showed the love and care both grandparents gave their baby boy, how each member of the Beifong clan, and even those directly associated with the Avatar, all welcomed him...

... it just felt so amazing to Aila to know her father had such a loving, caring family. But as they finished the scrapbook, it did leave one big question needing to be asked.

"Gran... Grand... Gran..."

Aila once more felt herself finding it hard to call Kuvira her grandmother, wondering why it was so hard. "I'm trying Kuvira, I really am, but it's-" she tried to make it clear, only for the platinum bender herself to lightly take her by the hand.

"How about you just call me 'Nainai', alright?" she offered, at which the Avatar felt amazed to hear as it was just like the old story, seeing the kind smile as Honei certainly approved of the idea.

"Okay… Nainai Kuvira…" the Avatar said, realizing how nice it felt to call her that, despite the question that was to follow.

"How come you and grandpa... left Zaofu, then had to leave the both of them? I know I asked it already, but we do want to know."

At that moment, Kuvira could sense the uncertainty in the room as she looked over at Honei before seeing the others, noticing that Opal herself was remembering, as well as Yasuko, Toph, and Roaluk.

Honei herself was also curious as she raised a nervous finger.

"Did you... know our father and my first sister had died as well?"

"Just adding it on, aren't you?" The grandmother tried to joke by forcing a snigger before shaking her head, clear she was trying to hold back very obvious tears.

Something Honei herself realized may hurt Kuvira to remember.

"Grandma, are you... sure you want to continue? It's understandable if you don't wanna." she assured her human grandmother, holding her hand as did Aila, seeing her sniffle.

"I keep telling myself I'll tell you two, but... I swear, every time I'm about to, I just... choke... leading you on like this."

Able to get work up the will to admit something, Kuvira wiped tears from her eyes as she felt ready to speak.

"My past, with the Earth Empire, I thought it was buried, but... it came back..."

The bad memories filled her mind, all that led to this...

... Kuvira had to finally share what happened.

Notes:

And 'lo and behold, the chapter be done! So much fun sweet moments here, with Aila and Honei getting a good idea of being Beifong's, Kuvira able to properly interact with her family after so long as with more... OH and Bolin having to be there for Jun, who explains how they got knocked up and the awkwardness that the two former lovers have, though Jun is happy to know Bolin is there for them. Again, the edits is this time around are just some tightening and tweaking of dialog and the added bit of Bolin and Jun knowing the truth ahead of time. As with Kuvira finally being ready to tell Aila and Kuvira of how, with Korra's help, got her and Baatar Jr. in contact with Anka the Fertility Spirit and finally get the chance to be parents with Baatar the Third, or Bachu, as with... being ready to talk about THAT DAY...

And as for Wolf, the scene with him killing the Motel Clerk and her two sons, as with freeing the abused Bear Dogs, is about the same aside from some differences, mainly how all three were killed and some pacing. But Wolf does bond with one of the Bear Dogs, which is nice.

Chapter 11: Chapter Eleven- Kuvira Alone Part One

Notes:

Well... you can blame me for the delays here with the new "Rise of Aila" chapter. WELL, let's finally get into the first part of some Kuvira flashback focused targets! And there will be some wild action...

And yes, I saw the new Seven Havens trailer, while also writing up "LOK Book Seven- Eras"... an idea came to mind, which MAY change depending on how it goes, but we got a good while until you guys see that fic. XD

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, including some slurs and some brutal bloody violence and gore.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Sixty years before...

The explosion was sudden.

Loud enough to be heard from inside the kitchen where the platinum bender had been preparing the day's meal alongside Korra and Asami Sato.

Soon as the three got back up from kneeling down, the Avatar looked around.

"What was that?!" She demanded to know, neither knowing what it was before seeing Baatar Jr. come rushing into the room, holding Baatar III tightly in his arms as the eight year old Yasuko followed, having been shown around the Hall of Beifong's.

"Did any of you all hear that?" he questioned as Asami gave a worried nod of the head as she took her daughter in her arms.

"Hard to miss it, you alright sweetie?"

"Yes mommy." Yasuko, clad in her airglider suit, assured her before looking at her other mother. "Anaana, what's happening?"

Korra herself wasn't sure herself, about to ask about Baatar Sr.'s whereabouts when another explosion, one much closer shook the room, causing anything that wasn't held down to fall to the ground!

Inside Kuvira's head however, she recognized the pattern, how close the explosions were.

With that, she quickly turned her head to her husband, knowing fear in her eyes.

"Junior, you take Baatar and Yasuko to the safe room, this instant! Don't open it until one of us gives you the okay!" she ordered.

No one was used to seeing how scared the mother was, but it had to be for good reason as her husband agreed.

"Of course, you got this?" he asked, getting a sure nod back from his wife as well as a quick kiss.

"Yeah," Kuvira promised before seeing how confused and scared the year-old child was. "Daddy and Yasuko will protect you, mommy has business to deal with, okay?" she made sure to say, ruffling some of his brown patch of hair to make him laugh.

Doing so, she looked back at her husband.

"Go, NOW."

With that, Baatar Jr. took the baby and the young girl with him as both Korra and Asami weren't sure what was up, following Kuvira as she rushed out of the kitchen and down the hall.

"Kuvira, what's going on?!" The latter had to ask about their friend taking the lead, only for part of the walls ahead of them to be ripped open with metalbending.

They were taken aback to see armed figures with metal adorning their attire, on their chests being a metal symbol each knew.

A symbol Kuvira herself damned ever since the first fall of the empire.

"Son of a bitch, I KNEW IT..." she hissed as she got in fighting position, as did the Avatar and her wife. Something the four attackers saw, not worried as one called out, his face painted green and silver.

"FOR THE CONFEDERACY!"

Realizing Zaofu was under attack by those who still held onto the horrible ideas of the Earth Empire, the three women all rushed in, ready to defend Zaofu.

Both Korra and Asami worked as a unit, fighting side by side as the powerhouse married couple they were.

When the Avatar used her airbending to send one Earth Empire loyalist backwards into part of the broken wall, there the engineer was running along the more stable part of another one.

Able to wrap an arm around another's neck as she did, using her weight to drive him down to the ground, following that up with a punch to the face to knock him out.

Not one to stop where she was going, her wife then bended the water from her water skin and smacked up another one, the lone female, with quick lashes against the chest and face.

With the follower distracted, the non-bender ran up behind her and grabbed her by the arm, twisting the opponent' arm around in place.

Then in perfect harmony, Asami let go and jumped upwards for a spinning roundhouse kick to her face.

Right at the same time Korra did a quick sweeping kick in the opposite direction, a trail of flames following it.

Their combined attack easily put an end to their foes, the married couple giving each other a knowing smirk.

Luckily for them, they only had to deal with those Earth Empire soldiers who were non-benders as it was Kuvira who was dealing with the one actual bender of the group.

Not that the powerful metalbender had issues as for whatever fancy earthbending move this man she was facing off against had, she had a counter.

It shouldn't have been an issue to fight him, especially with Korra and Asami helping out, but their attention was brought in more loyalists who arrived and kept them busy.

What this opponent lacked in proper skill, he made up for stubbornness and an unwillingness to stay down, giving Kuvira more of a fight than expected.

And not that the former Great Uniter would admit it, but since giving birth to Baatar III, she hadn't felt the need to fight, despite keeping herself in fighting and bending shape.

That allowed the earthbending follower to have some form of chance as both went toe to toe, dodging and blocking each other's attacks.

No matter how much she fought back, using both of her platinum bracelets Zaofu's jewelry maker, and fellow platinum bender, Prisha made for her, the damn face painted man wouldn't stay down for he kept coming back for more.

"Look at you now, the so-called 'Great Uniter', a former shell of herself, no longer pure!" the earthbender called out, pushing Kuvira up against a pillar, using his strength to keep her pinned.

The metalbender couldn't believe how easy she was being pushed back, trying to bend part of the metal interior. But it wouldn't work upon feeling him suddenly grab her fist and begin gripping it down.

She couldn't help but scream in pain at some bones cracking at the compression.

"Gahh!"

"How the mighty fallen, poisoned by the mindset of that Beifong whore!" he sneered out, ignoring the bracelet-covered wrist of Kuvira's trying to push him away by the neck.

Before she could retort or try to fight back more, the buzzing hum came up below her and the earthbender.

"Squad A, have you found them yet?"

It came from a walkie talkie that was clipped onto the waist belt of the loyalist, its speaker working as the voice spoke more. "Have you found the targets?"

But even as she struggled, Kuvira knew WHO EXACTLY was speaking, never forgetting that damn voice.

Especially upon hearing what Guan had to say next.

"We already have Baatar's Sr. Have you found his son, Kuvira and their bastard?"

Just the mere mention of her father-in-law being captured already, presumably when he was with the merchant, caught her by surprise.

But upon hearing her own husband and son were being targeted...

... THAT did it for Kuvira.

"RAAGGHHH!"

Letting out a roar of restrained anger, she rose up her shoe, quickly bending the metal sole of it into a pointed spike and stomped it down onto the earthbender's FOOT!

"Oww! Aghh!"

The loud scream of pain that came out proved to only be the beginning as he felt his foot be stabbed into, causing him to let go of his grip.

Then, as if possessed by a dark spirit, it went by so quickly as the mother took complete control and swung the loyalist against the pillar, her wrist pinning him by the throat.

And before either Korra, Asami or even their opponents knew it, Kuvira clenched her fist, bending her platinum bracelet into a flat disc shape over her arm...

... right through the loyalist's neck, slicing the pillar behind him in two!

The sudden sound of flesh, bone and metal being cut stopped the others in place as they watched the platinum bender having just killed the man, beheading him as the rest of the body slumped down the pillar.

Both the Avatar and her wife couldn't believe what their ally and friend had done, watching her bend the bracelet back to the way it was, letting the open eyed head hit the ground.

Then as if on command, Kuvira thrust her hand out towards those Earth Empire loyalists that had been fighting Korra and Asami, three in total...

... and it was three in total she bended her platinum towards, a pointed spike being flung and shot through each of their chests, killing them with precise ease.

It was Asami herself who first spoke up in shock at what she just witnessed.

"Kuvira?"

"Senior's been captured, they're after Junior and Baatar." Kuvira coldly retorted, taking back her platinum over her wrist as Korra walked over to her.

"Wait, are you sure?" she asked, getting a sure nod back. That didn't mean the Water Tribe woman approved of this course of action. "But you didn't have to go and-"

"Squad A, do you read? Have you found them?!" Guan's voice once more echoed out through the walkie talkie of the headless follower, getting the three's attention.

"Guan? How did he get out?" Korra questioned out loud, none of the three knowing at the time how it happened.

Not that Kuvira herself cared as she took the device in hand and pressed the button in hand.

"Guan, WHERE are you?"

Her voice held a cold and deadly edge to it, waiting for a response as she let go of the button.

And it came.

"AHH, Kuvira, not surprised you're behind this small issue."

"Let me reiterate, where. THE FUCK. ARE YOU?!" she snarled out after pressing the button. Only to get herself a few clicks of the tongue.

"Now now, no need for foul language, Kuvira." Guan actually had the gall to chide her.

But before more threats could be made, Korra ripped the walkie talkie out of Kuvira's hand and spoke into it herself. "Guan, you better stop whatever insane plan you have in store and just surrender." she ordered.

To her surprise, said madman didn't seem bothered. "Avatar Korra, I wasn't aware you were visiting. How's the wife, her head feeling better? You know, after LAST TIME?"

The eyes of the Avatar went wide at the mere mention of the brainwashing Guan had forced upon Asami years before as with Mako and Bolin, the Sato woman's own mind going back to the brief period of time she had no memory of.

Even after all these years, it was still very much a subject that they tried to leave it behind, despite claims otherwise. But Korra wasn't going to give him the satisfaction.

"Where are you? So we can end this now." she demanded while refocusing on the subject, now wanting any more excuse to punch Guan out, maybe let her wife get a freebie hit in.

But a sinister laugh only came from the speaker after a bit, whirling back on.

"I will speak our demands, for the Earth Confederacy will need to take the place of this sad excuse of a state. Now that Suyin has been dead for the past few months, someone new has to be in charge."

"Guan, just tell us where you are." Asami demanded, which only got a sigh back.

"Fine fine, we're at the courtyard, looking quite lovely might I add. Some of us, including those true pure hearts who were so brave to help us get out, will be waiting." his voice answered, but not before having more to say. "But don't be rude and bring about any funny business..."

Suddenly a familiar voice grunted out in pain, one the three knew of with ease before Guan continued speaking his threat.

"... wouldn't want the in-law to be harmed, would you Kuvira? Let alone your husband or son whenever we find them."

"Don't give him-"

Baatar Sr.'s words were cut off by what certainly sounded like a punch to the face.

Without warning, Kuvira grabbed the walkie talkie before pushing through Korra and Asami, a woman on a mission as they realized what was going through her head.

"No, NO! Kuvira, get back here!" Korra called out, only for the platinum bender to turn around, already having a plan.

"I'll distract them, bring all the attention to me. Make sure Junior, Baatar and Yasuko are safe as with any other civilians you find. Then find a way around the courtyard, jump those bastards from behind." she ordered, ready to end things. "It's obvious that it's ME he wants, not you two."

Still, the idea was too crazy. "But it's so clearly a trap!" Asami called out, shaking her head. "He's not an idiot, he would be expecting this!"

That much was true, Guan got his position in the Earth Empire for a reason. "True, but there is one big mistake he made." Kuvira pointed out.

Hearing that, Korra was concerned about what said mistake was. "Which is?"

An almost grim smirk formed on the platinum bender's face.

"He made my family a target."

With that, Kuvira turned and left the two behind, beginning to make her trek to the courtyard, making sure to go the way near Huan's workshop.

She was thankful the artist was currently on vacation with Eska in the North Pole while Wing and Wei were preparing a charity power disc game over at the Fire Nation. Less to worry about when it came to their safety, even if they could defend themselves.

Entering the workshop, she was able to quickly grab only one little item from Huan's desk. A rubber band, a good sized one, just what she wanted.

As she exited out, she saw more of those Earth Confederacy loyalists or whatever they were calling themselves appear around the corner, spotting her.

EXACTLY what Kuvira was hoping for as she once more pressed the button of the device to speak to the man on the other line.

"Guan, I want your unaided attention, I WANT you to listen," she began, seeing the group of ten in front of her, a mixture of benders and non-benders all waiting for her to strike. "And as you do, I want you to ask yourself a question; If I'm capable of what I'm about to do to your confederates..."

And for the first time in a long while, the Kuvira of old glared without blinking towards her opponents.

"... then what can I do to you?"

Saying that, she began wrapping the rubber band around the walkie talkie, enough that it was tightly holding the button down to keep her line on as she clipped it onto her pants.

Seeing the fools before her make the first move and come towards, the platinum bender rushed at them, wanting her foe to hear every second of the slaughter...

... a slaughter that Kuvira herself actually had no idea she was capable of.

In fact, it was like once the first bit of blood was drawn, all she saw was red.

Slicing, stabbing, dicing, bludgeoning, snapping, breaking, strangulation.

Nothing was off the table for the downright cultist followers of the Confederacy who easily fell to the platinum bender.

One loyalist, after having his legs sliced off at the knees, tried to crawl away...

... only for a sharp piece of platinum was jammed deep into the ear, right into his brain!

Kuvira just looked down at the body, only giving a cold breath before ripping the piece out and rebending it as part of her bracelet.

Getting back to her feet, she resumed her journey to the courtyard, right where Guan and those bastards would be, holding Baatar Sr. hostage.

All the while leaving the hallway full of bloodied bodies behind, her lovely green and silver attire now stained in their blood as she discarded the walkie-talkie.

She knew that if Suyin was still alive, she'd more than likely call her out for the use of lethal force. Not that she'd blame her for doing so.

But these madmen had invaded their home, attacked and hurt so many people, let alone killed them.

That much was obvious from some of the bodies Kuvira saw were of guards and servants ruthlessly having been killed by those who followed a hateful ideology.

One that she gave inspiration for, something she still blamed herself for doing.

But Kuvira outgrew it, realized how wrong she was. Tried to better herself, make up for all the pain and suffering she brought forth.

Became a married woman and, most importantly, a mother.

And yet, here her past was, coming back.

She had to end it.

Finally, she saw her destination. The courtyard.

And among it were a massive group of those in green and silver in various ways. Some with their faces painted in the colors, waving flags of the empire that were either originals or homemade.

And there were three in the middle who Kuvira knew very much.

In the middle was Baatar Sr., looking a little worse for wear where he kneeled, arms restrained, but very much alive, which was good. It was easy to see him watch her come onto the scene, surprised at her current state.

Then, on the left was a familiar woman, one who currently didn't look like the scientist she remembered dismissing her brainwashing techniques as going too far.

Not that the now messy haired Dr. Sheng, still wearing those glasses of hers, believed in ethics in the first place, considering which group she supported.

And of course, the man himself, standing behind Baatar Sr., keeping close to him.

Sure, his hair and beard were no longer military standard, on the count of being locked up for so long.

But Kuvira KNEW that face of Guan's from anywhere.

"My my, look at you, Kuvira. Must be in such pain, from all the blood on you." Guan called out, almost finding this funny, only to take notice of something concerning his foe who began stepping closer onto the scene.

"It's NOT my blood..."

Hearing her cold response, Guan put it together with the sounds of pain and suffering he and the others listened to on his walkie talkie earlier.

"Senior, you okay?" she called out, to which her father-in-law just nodded along.

"Could be better!" he answered back, feeling Guan's grip on him tighten after he spoke.

"Don't you dare make a move, Kuvira." the leader of all of this threatened, keeping his eyes set on her.

"Us true, PROUD soldiers of the Earth aren't scared of you anymore. We will take what is ours and make the Earth Kingdom powerful again! First by starting with eradicating all of the disgusting figureheads of Zaofu off the map, most of all you and your disease of an adopted family."

Taking all of this in, keeping her anger in check, Kuvira had to make note of something.

"So, this is it, your new little club?" Kuvira spoke loudly, giving a look at all those who stood at Guan's side, all leering at her, having to shake her head. "Must I say, I am NOT impressed in the slightest."

Putting her arms behind her back, the green eyed woman had to shake her head. "I mean, I just don't see how any of these fools would be considered perfect choices to be part of YOUR empire, your so-called Earth Confederacy." she observed before pointing at one ugly member, then another.

"She looks like a human thumb, that one looks as thin as a toothpick. And him, where's his chin?!"

"Insults will get you nowhere, especially as you're too blind. As blind that the old whore who birthed Suyin." Sheng had decided to speak up, getting her former leader's attention.

"You don't see the weakness that was evident while you were in control, by your own doing. What Guan has planned, to allow those who are pure, brave and powerful, to rise up from the disgraceful defeats done unto us in Republic City and Gaoling. To do what it takes against Zaofu, who allowed it!"

Hearing how devoted the scientist sounded as she spoke...

... Kuvira couldn't help but be unable to hold in a laugh.

The extremists and even Baatar Sr. themselves were confused at this course of action, listening to the rather amused and loud laughter coming from her.

Certainly something out of character, but none of the confederates made a move to stop it, letting Kuvira calm down from it.

"I-I'm sorry, 'Pure, brave and POWERFUL', am I correct? That's what you just said?" she had to ask the disgraced doctor. "Aren't you supposed to be a scientist? You know, someone who's supposed to be smart? You're just repeating what Guan literally just said like an iguana-parrot!"

Having to shake her head in humored disbelief, the platinum bender looked at all of those standing at Guan and Sheng's side. "Also, I can already tell you, at least, ten flaws with what you just called these dented morons!" She mocked the doctor's words, holding up one finger before shaking her head.

"But let's be nice and only focus on ONE. You said powerful, like, in what measure? If you're talking about bending, all of you do me a quick favor, show of hands. Who here is powerful enough to bend metal?" she requested, raising her hand up. "Come on, don't be shy..."

Hearing this, not seeing anything wrong, a large amount of Confederates' rose their hands up, including Guan himself.

"Yes, even you Guan."

He only did so, wondering what her game was, still keeping Baatar Sr. in his grasp with his other hand.

Seeing the numbers, the woman had to nod as she counted with her free hand.

"Alright, not a bad number, not bad at all..."

... before holding out the counting hand, every bit of her platinum bracelets suddenly being shot towards the group!

She could only watch with a dark smirk as the purified metal she bended began flattening in mid-air as they spun, easily slicing through the raised wrists of almost every single metalbender who held their hands up!

"Yaahhh!"

"Oowww!"

"RAAGGH!"

It was Guan who was the only one left who hadn't had his hand sliced off as he, Sheng, Baatar Sr. and the other's who weren't metalbenders watched and listened to the loud screams of agony.

Around them were men and women crying out, trying to grasp and stop the constant bleeding of their bleeding stumps where their hands were.

Some even attempted in vain to place their severed hands back onto their wrists.

But all either passed out or died from blood loss and shock, all the while Kuvira bended the platinum back to herself, calmly rebending her bracelets.

"Now, show of hands again..." she began speaking once more, a smug smirk on her face.

"... who's powerful enough to bend platinum?"

At that moment, the first semblance of real worry formed on Guan and Sheng's faces as Baatar Sr. realized his daughter-in-law may have had this, violent as her method was.

Realizing how bad things were now, just how much things had fallen off course, Guan had to make some changes.

"All of you still standing, attack her..."

Those still at his side alive all turned to the mad commander caught by surprise by his order as even Sheng looked at him.

"Guan?"

"DID I STUTTER, SHE CAN'T FIGHT ALL OF US AT ONCE!" he yelled out in anger, pointing towards an awaiting Kuvira.

"KILL KUVIRA!"

Believing he was right, every single member of the Earth Confederacy aside from the leaders who could fight all rushed towards Kuvira...

... who was not scared in the slightest, ready to deal with them.

With the first one coming forth, the platinum bender lashed forth what metal she bended directly deeply across the neck before bending it into a thick shape.

One she then slammed down onto the top of another loyalist's skull like a large hammer.

The way Kuvira fought, she was like a well oiled machine.

Before, back inside the compound, she felt rusty, having trouble with just one earthbender.

But knowing her home, her friends and family, they were all in danger, something clicked in Kuvira's mind.

Now, she was fighting her way through whatever bender and non-bender trying to kill her.

Be it with earthbending, chi-based attacks, strikes or even weapons, she took and avoided whatever was coming at her and kept at it.

Kuvira wouldn't stop until they were all dead by their hands, the foot soldiers, the insane doctor, the mad commander.

These bastards were an offshoot of something she created and she was ready to kill her creation once and for all!

One soldier tried to shove a wooden spear towards her head, but she ducked out of the way, causing another to be accidentally skewed right through the side of his face!

The distraction was enough for Kuvira to bend up sharp spikes from her bracelets and thrust them repeatedly at his stomach and chest for he was too close.

Not one to stop, she slashed one spike across one soldier's throat, causing blood to spray out onto her chest and into the eyes of some others, blinding them.

That made things all too easy as the platinum bender lashed out a stream of the purified metal across at their waists, slicing them in two!

As she kept cutting and stabbing those who kept coming at the adrenaline and anger filled woman, the more thoughts of what would happen if she failed kept running through Kuvira's mind.

Her father-in-law would be killed.

Junior would be executed right in front of her eyes as she screamed.

And the idea of Guan ending her her son's life, or WORSE, using Sheng's technology to-

NO, NO!

Kuvira wouldn't stop, she couldn't stop! SHE HAD TO PROTECT HER HOME! HER FAMILY!

EVERY SINGLE FUCKING ONE OF THE EARTH CONFEDERACY WOULD DIE BY HER HANDS!

Just as she jumped forth onto the shoulders of one overweight loyalist and began to repeatedly stab the top of his head with her platinum spikes, the powerful bender saw something be thrown onto the ground a few feet away...

... even within the split second she and some of the others around her saw it, Kuvira knew a grenade when she saw it.

On instinct, she jumped off the still stumbling corpse and used her platinum bending to make floating platforms to escape the large blast!

But the force was enough to drop her to the ground, landing roughly on her feet.

As she did, Kuvira saw a scared Dr. Sheng was behind it, seeing her next to what had to be a box full of them.

Something she wasn't surprised to see, figuring they were behind the explosions earlier.

Same as watching some of the loyalists getting the same idea as the scared woman and began running towards the grenades.

But Kuvira wasn't worried as she saw Sheng go to reach for another and held her hand out towards her, moving her fingers in a slight manner.

Doing so allowed her to bend the metal pin out from the grenade that the glasses-wearing woman was close to touching.

Letting her see the panic of the scientist's face at the explosive being primed before her.

But rather cunningly, Sheng grabbed and hurried to unscrew the fuse assembly as quickly as she could, just managing to do so.

An action that the doctor had to give a nervous chuckle at as the other loyalists who ran close to her had to laugh as well...

... just as the fuse still zapped out a few tiny sparks, some right into the open explosive she still held close.

Dr. Sheng only could register such bad luck with one meek word.

"... ohh..."

The grenade went off right in her face, the explosion by proxy setting off the rest of the grenades, letting off a massive fireball that heated up all of the Beifong compound, incinerating those close enough!

Thankfully, Kuvira was far enough away, but it did catch her by surprise as she was flung back, hitting the ground hard.

Much as her ears were ringing, she was still slowly able to stand, standing over the bodies of so many of the Earth Confederacy.

Many were either killed by her own hands or the grenades, though some were struggling with whatever injuries they had or just tried to stay alive.

Still, with Sheng dead and currently laying about in multiple blown apart pieces, that left one other person left for Kuvira to deal with, bellowing out his name, ready to end his life.

"GUAN!"

But before she knew it, a sharp pain hit her leg, dropping her to her knees, calling her to yell out in pain.

One barely alive loyalist had stabbed her in the right leg with a knife, distracting her enough for another to quickly tap both her shoulders at their chi points.

Before she could deal with them, Kuvira watched both drop dead from whatever injuries they endured...

... but she couldn't move her arms, nor get up without feeling pain fill her leg.

That was when footsteps were heard walking, the injured platinum bender looking up to see a dinged up, but alive Guan approaching her, keeping Baatar Sr. at bay with what had to be a metal leash around his neck.

"AH, now there's the Kuvira I remembered and followed all those years ago, willing to do whatever it takes to complete her goal." he mocked her, grinning madly. "Like blowing away the building where even her future husband was in."

But the captive Baatar wasn't worried as he grunted out. "Kuvira, fight back... you have to-"

"HUSH UP!" Guan snarled, forcing his hostage to his knees, keeping his grip as he looked at his foe. "Back to what I was saying, I haven't seen this you in so long... but now, you're back to the sad pathetic woman you've become, poisoned by those whores, Suyin and Avatar Korra."

The insult towards his late wife began to enrage the captive man. "Don't you d-dare call my wife-"

But the response was cut short when the metal leash around Baatar Sr.'s neck began to tighten as it was clear what was happening now.

"ACK!"

"GUAN, STOP!" Kuvira yelled out, now watching the man who took her in along with Suyin start to be strangled by the mad commander with his metalbending.

"STOP IT GUAN, YOU'RE KILLING HIM!"

"GOOD! ONE MORE DISGUSTING BEIFONG OUT OF THE WAY THEN!" said metalbender yelled out, a sick vile smile on his face as Baatar struggled to break himself free, feebly unable to do so.

And Kuvira herself was unable to free him, forced to watch this happen and just look on in horror.

"Kuvira, I'll stop if you surrender."

All the woman could do was look up in the insane eyes of Guan as he kept going.

"Say you admit defeat, and I'll spare him." he offered in his sick way, increasing the tension as the struggles began to loosen, Baatar gasping out in pain.

"UGGHHH... Ugghhh..."

"DO YOU WANT HIM TO LIVE?! SAY IT!"

For a moment, Kuvira was stricken frozen, unable to speak. If she surrendered, Baatar Sr. would live, but then Zaofu would fall, among other things.

But if she didn't...

... and she could see, even with his life being choked out of him, the kind man just looked at her, almost like he was shaking his head 'No', telling her not to give in.

"Guan..." Kuvira felt herself begin to speak, as if not in control, preparing to talk more.

"... I... I-"

Before anyone knew it, two brown skinned hands ripped at both sides of Guan's head and yanked the leader of this invasion away, causing him to let go of his grip on Baatar Sr.!

The gasping man then fell in front of his daughter-in-law, who crawled her way over to him

Kuvira herself was caught by surprise to see all of this happen, but was thankful that her father-in-law was okay, if in pain.

Looking up, she saw a familiar ally assist in the only way she knew how, her eyes glowing as white as the markings on Raava on her chest.

"GUAN, you have repeatedly committed acts of extremism and poisoned the minds of others through vile means!" The voice of hundreds of Avatars spoke alongside Korra's own voice as she took the now frightened Guan by the forehead with one hand and pressed the other against his chest.

"And now you shall pay the ultimate price!"

At that moment, blue energy shot out from Korra's eyes and mouth as energy of red did the same from Guan's.

Watching the scene, both Kuvira and a still gasping Baatar Sr. saw as the blue energy took over the red and dispelled it, leaving the Avatar to let go of their foe, the glow of the Avatar state vanishing as she leered down at him.

"You no longer can bend... It's over, you lost." Korra made clear as Guan realized it himself, his entire body shaking, his mind broken now.

With the matter dealt with, she just looked at her allies, thankful to see the two were okay.

Moments later...

As the sun began to come down, guards and authorities were present on the scene.

Healers taught under Kya Beifong made sure to check up on those who needed it as White Lotus sentries were also there to help make sure things were settled.

Parts of the Beifong compound would have to be repaired and fixed up. But nothing some bending and plant growing couldn't fix.

All Kuvira could do was just sit alone, watching Korra and Asami speak to some White Lotus about what happened, making sure to defend their friend's actions. That much she was thankful for, especially after Korra used some spirit water she had on her to fix up her leg wound and she could move her arms again.

"Aunt Kuvira..."

The platinum bender turned to see the daughter of the Avatar come over to her, hoping to check on her with those wide cyan eyes. "Are you alright?" Yasuko asked.

An innocent question from the airbender-in-training, not knowing the full extent of what Kuvira did to protect her home, all the lives she took.

For the moment, Kuvira put on a thankful smile, ruffling the black locks of Yasuko with her hand, knowing the young girl saw her as like an aunt. She was happy to see some innocence still remained in the world.

"Yeah, just... had a rough day." she answered. "You made sure you protected my husband and Baatar?"

"In case any bad guys appeared, yep. But none did, Anaana and Mommy made sure of it." The young girl answered, both turning to see Baatar Jr. and Baatar III checking up on the former's father as he was being checked out, looking to be in good spirits considering what just happened.

Just at that moment, Bolin and Opal looked to be arriving on Juicy, the two bringing their triplets along. The looks of worry and concern on the parents' faces were expected as Korra and Asami went to meet up with them, as did Yasuko.

Overall, things were coming down, which was good...

... but just as Kuvira willed herself up, still feeling some pain from being stabbed, a loud voice rang out, one directed all over.

"You think this is it? THAT IT'S OVER!?"

All attention was brought to two White Lotus sentries who were leading away a ranting and raving Guan to a large prison van, having him in metal cuffs behind his back that he could no longer metalbend.

It was already decided that he was to be locked up for good in a place none of his followers would ever find him.

The man, his mind completely snapped in two like a chocolate-dipped cracker stick, was practically frothing at the mouth as he let out his insane rambles.

"THE EARTH CONFEDERACY WILL ALWAYS LIVE ON, OTHERS WILL BELIEVE MY WORD! NOT THE WORDS OF YOU BASTARDS, NOT AT ALL!" he screamed out, casting glares of hate towards Korra and Asami.

"You think because I can't bend anymore, that I won't be a problem?! FAR FROM IT!" Guan directed his words right towards the Avatar, nudging his head to the mother of her daughter. "I'VE GOTTEN INTO HER MIND, And it'd be EASY to get her to see you as the Water Tribe bitch YOU REALLY ARE!"

And then, the madman turned his attention towards Kuvira's way.

"OH, DON'T THINK I forgot about you, Kuvira. I SAW WHAT YOU REALLY ARE! You think you're changed, that you're better than me? LIES!" he screamed out, wanting her to hear what he had to say.

"You're nothing but a weak and scared child. You think if anyone knows the real you, you'll be abandoned, like what your parents did by dumping you on these fools' doorsteps!"

His voice cackling out in glee, Guan twisted his head with a manic grin as he watched the subject of his mockery silently take in his words.

Something Korra herself noticed before seeing something else that got her attention...

... something she knew she couldn't stop with her bending.

"You're no Beifong and you never will be! YOUR LITTLE BASTARD WILL NEVER LOVE YOU! YOU'LL ALWAYS BE ALONE!"

"KUVIRA, NO!"

But it was too late as the Avatar called out.

For before ANYONE knew it, Kuvira had tackled herself straight into the cuffed man, right onto the ground.

"SHUT UP!"

All before SLAMMING A PIECE OF PLATINUM SHE BENDED INTO A POINTED SPIKE RIGHT INTO HIS THROAT, BLOOD SQUIRTING ONTO HER ENRAGED FACE.

"SHUT UP!" she screamed out again, tearing the metal out of the newly made wound before driving it down AGAIN into where she just stabbed.

"UGHCK! ACK!"

All to silence the gagging defenseless criminal as the platinum bender began to repeatedly stab and drive that spike into his throat and neck, without end.

Just wanting to NEVER hear his voice again as more blood hit her face.

"SHUT UP! SHUT UP! SHUT THE FUCK UP!"

"KUVIRA, STOP!"

At that moment, Kuvira felt herself being pulled off the corpse by both Korra and Bolin, losing her weapon in the process.

Revealing to all that with how much she stabbed into Guan's neck, she had practically almost decapitated him with so much blood shed.

And within an instant, the platinum bender felt herself snap out of her enraged state, only able to just notice all the different reactions to what she had just done.

The violent murder she committed in front of everyone onto a dangerous, yet still defenseless man.

Suddenly, it came at her all at once, all her emotions.

She should have been happy to finally rid the world of a problem like Guan as she saw her friends and family rush to herself, some insisting for the guards and authorities to stay back...

... but upon seeing her own baby boy in her husband's arms have his eyes uncovered, looking confused at her in her blood-covered state, Guan's final words filled her mind and heart.

All Kuvira Beifong could do was just silently break down, as she began breathing heavily.

Reality sinking in for what she had just done.

After what had happened as Zaofu was in the midst of being rebuilt after the attempted uprising by the Earth Confedersacy, Kuvira and Baatar Beifong Jr. both had to tell those close to them a choice they had decided to make.

That, sometime during the middle of the night later on, they were to take their son, named after his father and grandfather...

... and leave their home, away from those they cared for.

Knowing it was their mistakes that brought such chaos and death to Zaofu, as with the public killing onto Guan, who despite being a criminal, was still defenseless.

It was a painful choice, but the wife and husband saw there being no other way, they needed to vanish.

Let people guess where they were, not knowing of the innocent child they sought no harm towards.

Much as their friends and family, such as Opal and Baatar Beifong Sr. as well as Avatar Korra and Asami Sato, tried to convince them otherwise, they already made their minds.

With it accepted, Kuvira and Junior both made their final goodbyes to those they were thankful for, along with letting the others say goodbye to Baatar III.

And like they promised, by the next morning, the family of three were gone.

Never to be seen again...

... so, what you all think? Just leave it be for now...
