Chapter 14: Chapter 14- Confrontation

Notes:

Alright gang, after enough time, the Avatar Hunter will FINALLY arrive in Zaofu, which means we'll finally get the fight between Aila and Wolf... right? WELL, FIND OUT THIS CHAPTER OF RISE OF AILA! (Also, we're getting closer to Seven Heavens!)

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, moments of bloody violence and gore, including references to child death and mentions of past animal abuse.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

The environment had come to a stop once more where the Avatar was, having been looking around the fabled hall she walked around.

The young woman saw all the trinkets, pieces and objects on display on podiums, the hanging paintings. There were even metal statues created in the images of past Beifong family members as well.

Family members that were Aila's, as well as Honei's, such as the statue of the co-founder of Zaofu before her.

Despite all she found out the day before, this still came as a shock to the metalbender as she looked at the statue made in the image of her great-grandmother.

"You know it's been twenty-three years since I've been here in this hall?"

Blue eyes looked to the side to see the glowing form standing next to her, eyeing the statue as well, a look of remembrance on the face of Korra's spirit.

"I was there when Suyin completed it, enough to deem it finished of course." she spoke fondly of her metalbending teacher. "She practically worked non-stop to make sure the entire Beifong family history was kept alive here. It was the last thing she completed before she passed away."

"No kidding." Aila commented, touching the statue with her finger tips, feeling the cold metal.

From what the Avatar knew, Suyin Beifong passed away after four years of battling some form of colon disease. Something that wasn't made public until after her death at her request.

Many had come to her funeral where she was cremated, her ashes scattered along her home.

There was even a small plaque at the base of her statue with a quote from hers.

'Blood or not, the bond of my family will always be stronger than any metal in the world.'

Aila had just turned away from the display holding the blackened blade forged by her great-grandmother's half-brother, the 'Hanzo-Beifong' original, when she saw the statue.

Still, looking at Suyin's statue, Aila noticed the way she smiled in her metal form did remind her of Honei's own.

"Why didn't you tell me about Kuvira and Baatar being my grandparents? That my father was a Beifong?"

The question was expected, Korra knew it was coming once her next life found out. All she could do was just nod, her hands behind her back as her spirit form began to pace around the area.

"How could I? Not so easy to just up and say." she answered calmly. "Just picture when we first met and I was like 'OH, by the way, you and Honei happen to be the grandchildren of the two who had led the Earth Empire attack on Republic City seventy years ago?'"

Stopping, the wise spirit just glanced at the glasses-wearing girl before her.

"Wouldn't be the best timing, yes?"

Aila didn't answer, instead just kept quiet as Korra sighed, turning her own attention to an old black and white picture on display.

It was of both Kuvira and Baatar Jr. back during Bolin and Opal's wedding weeks after the Universe War, laughing as they danced at the reception. They didn't realize the photo was taken until it was already developed.

Boy, was that a funny reveal at their own wedding.

"And Kuvira had to be the one to tell you."

The Avatar looked at the glowing spirit, conflicted with what she was hearing while seeing the older woman approach her with earnest eyes.

"She's been through so much in her life, both before and after her redemption. You have to understand that the choices Kuvira made in the past, each of them came with a cost." Korra described, trying to put it as best as she could. "Your grandmother's lost so much, but she now has the chance to get back the happiness she had to sacrifice oh so long ago."

Aila listened to all of Korra's words, able to tell she meant them.

"And being here for both you and Honei, to connect with you two, is her finding it. PLEASE, understand where she's coming from."

She knew the spirit's words were true, the Avatar knew Kuvira had plenty to make up for. But she was ready to give her a chance.

"Aila?"

Instantly, the Avatar realized she was back in the real world, back where she was standing in front of the statue of Suyin Beifong.

Turning, she saw Yasunori standing at the entrance way, looking concerned. "Ah, everyone's looking for you, including your grandma. Supposed to be doing your earthbending training." he noted, wondering if he interrupted anything.

Realizing more time had passed than she realized since she decided to check out the Hall of Beifong's on the way back from the restroom during breakfast, Aila just smiled.

"Duh, right. Sorry." she tried to wave off, walking over to her sister's boyfriend. "Just wanted to give the Hall a look, ending up spacing out."

That earned her a snicker from the eyepatch-wearing friend of hers.

"No shit." Yasunori commented before patting Aila's back. "Come on, don't want Toph to murder me."

Both friends walked away, making their way towards the training grounds while chatting up. Even as Korra's request kept ringing in the back of her mind.

Making their way to the training grounds out on the property, everyone aside from the two teens still inside the main building were there to witness the former Great Uniter train her granddaughter in the art of earthbending.

While it did take a bit for Opal and Yasuko to convince Toph to let Kuvira take over teaching Aila, the United Forces Commander decided to play ball.

"Alright, Aunt Kuvi, show us how you kicked Korra's ass." The lavabender jokingly said to her aunt, something that while serious the first time it had happened back during her Earth Empire days, it had become a running joke with both Kuvira and Korra.

Still, the ninety-one year old bender just smirked as she stood in her training attire, similar to the old white tanktop and olive green pants she wore in her younger years.

"Once Yasunori comes around with Aila, will do." she smirked while getting some stretches in.

As they waited, Kuvira did some poses she hadn't pulled out in years.

Yet it was almost like riding a bike, feeling her muscles and bones move and crack with ease.

While she did so, it was the detective who took notice as the elder metalbender as she let go of her foot while bending it backwards, feeling the quick need to pause her actions and give deep breathes.

Especially as she brought her hand briefly to her chest.

That was weird to say the least.

"Hey, Kuvira, you alright?"

Hearing Bolin call out to her, as well as bringing some attention, Kuvira herself just put on a smile for the others, shaking her head.

"Yeah, nothing to worry about. Haven't been this bendy in years." she insisted, which everyone seemed to accept.

All except for Yasuko who only kept her eyes on her just a little longer before turning away.

Giving a deeper breath, the grandmother mentally had a guess as to what was up. But whatever it was shouldn't interfere with what was today.

"Found her!"

The yell of Yasunori had caught all those attention on the training grounds, seeing him leading Aila with him, the Avatar rushing over to her girlfriend and getting a peck on the lips from her.

Kallah just smiled as she held some towels while Honei grabbed some water bottles.

"When you two need a quick breather, me and Honei got you both prepared."

"I can't sweat and even I can tell you're gonna sweat a lot." Honei piped in, making Aila snigger as she took off her glasses and handed them to her big sister.

"Thanks a bunch, my two favorite girls."

Hearing that, Kuvira could only watch proudly to see the three all hug each other. Such a sight almost brought a tear to her eye, even being reminded of Korra, Asami and Opal so many years before.

Seeing her granddaughter let them go and walk in front of her, the platinum bender knew it was time.

"You ready, Aila? Perhaps a friendly spar? Nothing extreme."

Hearing that, the Avatar nodded as she got in her fighting stance, her sapphire blue eyes shining at her grandmother, she herself getting in her own as well.

"Show you what I got? Course, Nainai."

Both benders were waiting for the cue, Yasuko standing with her hand clenched in the air. Once she let out a burst of air, that'd be the-

The sounds of hurried feet and chattering loudly into the sky suddenly broke the mood, all looking in the direction it came.

Somewhere near the walls of the compound, which wasn't too far out.

"Ahh, are we expecting any more White Lotus?" Roaluk had to ask out loud among those watching, something that concerned everyone, with Opal taking heed.

"Everyone keep close." she ordered before glancing at Kuvira, who nodded back. "Kuvi, stay closer to your grandkids, let's see what all the hubba's about."

The group of those native to the city-state and the visitors all made their way to the front gates of the compound, seeing many soldiers both on the ground and up in towers keeping their eyes out.

Toph marched over to one nearby soldier who saluted her upon seeing her.

"Status report."

"We're not sure, Commander. We got reports of an unknown truck currently making its way here through the local roads." The armored man answered, turning back around. "We had sent out one of our units to try intercepting it, see what's up... But..."

"But what?" The commander ordered her man to continue, only for she and the others to see the unsure look in his eyes, looking at a radio operator sitting nearby behind a booth with all his equipment.

"Junaid, play back what audio we recorded from the mics."

The technician did as he was told and pressed play on the console, the rolls of analog video tape spinning as it began to play through the speakers for all to hear.

To the group's surprise, the sounds of screaming and what was surely flesh being torn apart echoed into everyone's ears.

"Gaahhh!"

"Oh FUCK!"

"Yaahhh!"

"No! OH SPIRITS!"

All Honei and Kallah could do was take hold of their respective partners' hands, taken aback by the carnage that was recorded as Bolin and Jun were caught just as much by surprise.

Even Toph herself didn't know what to make of what she was hearing as she turned to her wife, seeing Yasuko's own eyes go wide as with Kaguya, Opal and Roaluk's.

"Come on, COME ON! WHY WON'T YOU DIE!? AHCCKKK!"

The cries of one soldier were then replaced by the sounds of someone being choked to death before the sound of something being grabbed was heard.

"How far is it to Zaofu?" a familiar voiced man spoke.

Within that moment, Aila instantly was aware who was responsible, knowing the voice of the Avatar Hunter from anywhere, feeling her whole body shake in fright as Kallah saw her.

Kuvira and Honei too both looked at the scared Avatar and the others as they heard the voice roar out.

"WHERE'S ZAOFU?!"

Following that came the sound of something important being snapped, like the bones of a finger, more screaming following from a patrolman.

"AHH! It's... It's another forty minute drive up ahead, just keep going straight! JUST STOP IT! DON'T KILL ME!"

The whimpers of the patrolman kept filling the audio as footsteps were heard walking away from the vehicle recording the audio for those in Zaofu to hear.

"Is that-" Opal tried to ask, only for her and everyone to hear more, starting with the sound of a patrol truck door opening.

"This is Private Zamo. Of Zaofu, please, anyone whose... Who's listening... He's coming to Zaofu, that... THING is on his way, prepare all forces... I... I hope that will be enough..."

The group of all those listening could hear the fear and pain in the patrolman's voice as he tried to give his warning. Never before had anyone heard such terror in a man's voice.

"I know Commander Toph, her wife and mother are there... and the Avatar, but that thing just ripped through us with ease, like we were just toilet paper." he described, not seeming to notice the increasing sound of crunching dirt under hard footsteps.

"And no matter what we threw at him, he just kept coming... I'm the-"

All then jumped at the Private being suddenly cut off, by something heard closing, quickly followed by a crunching sound!

Like the Avatar Hunter just swung the driver's side right against the private's head to crush it.

Once more silence, yet the radio tech held up a finger, quieting everyone.

"Whoever's listening, tell the Avatar that death is coming for her."

With Wolf's threat being made, the tech turned the recording off, leaving everyone aghast at what was just heard.

"That... That was thirty five minutes ago."

"He's coming, he's coming for me." Aila's voice cracked, feeling her entire body shake in fear as she began to back up, giving a loud gulp as she looked at her friends and family.

"And... AND..."

"Aila, it's okay." Yasuko was the first to come to her Anaana's next life's side, followed by Honei, Kallah and Kuvira while the others tried to picture what to do next.

But all the Avatar could do was look dumbfounded at the airbender.

"The fuck do you mean it's okay?! Did you NOT hear that recording!?"

"I did and we won't let you get hurt."

"And what about you guys?!"

The daughter of Korra and Asami had stopped briefly, watching the scared platinum bender shake her head, her eyes tearing up.

"You've heard what that thing did! You've never fought him, but I have!" Aila called out, shaking her head as she looked down at what power her hands felt. "He's worse than I thought, I'm sure he's even more pissed off as well!"

Looking back up at the others, Aila herself felt like she was going to crack.

"And if he's willing to kill Zaofu's soldiers, what about you guys? He'll fucking murder you all!"

Bolin was quick to come to the young girl's aid. "Hey, come on, you don't-"

"YOU HIT HIM IN THE FACE WITH FIRE AND IT DID NOTHING!"

Everyone could see how bad Aila was taking things, watching her get on her knees as she tried to have more to say.

But there was much more than worrying about a being made to kill her and other Avatar's that was going through the poor girl's mind.

"I... I won't be able to stop him, I'm not a full Avatar yet, I'm not ready. I don't have complete control over the Avatar State, I can't waterbend yet, I'm still learning earthbending," she teared up, thinking more to herself.

"And now that thing is coming here and I don't know if I can deal with losing more of those I care for and-"

Cutting off her rambling was three tight hugs, all from three women, one much older than the other two.

Honei, Kallah and Kuvira all hugged the scared girl who mattered to them the most, each wrapping their arms around her, to get her quiet down.

All Aila could do was just sniffle, blue eyes wanting to feel better, but the deep rooted fear was still there.

"Aila, you're the most important person in all our lives." The waterbender spoke kindly, trying to sooth her love's heart as Honei poked her little sister's nose.

"You're not just the Avatar, you're my little sister, Kallah's girlfriend."

"And my granddaughter." Kuvira chimed in, holding a thumb to Aila's check to wipe a lone tear from her cheek. "You're something to everyone here, even those you just met and we all made a vow that we'd stay by your side, no matter what comes our way."

Jun nodded, flowing their hand through Aila's hair. "Ever since Republic City two years ago, each of us all made that choice."

"Because we're Team Avatar. And if we go down protecting you, it'd be worth it." Yasunori spoke up, Bolin giving a smirk towards his friend.

"Long as we all give that Vaatu empowered motherfucker a fight he'll never forget."

Hearing all the words spoken with care and confidence, Aila herself looked to see Yasuko, Toph, Opal, Roaluk and Kaguya among them. The five adults didn't say anything, but she could see they too were set to help.

The Avatar, while still scared, did feel a small weight lifted off her shoulder as she began to rise up from her spot, the others letting go of her.

She gave the kind of smile those who knew Korra instantly recognized, a lopsided one.

"The Hunter wants me? Fine." she said, ready for what was next. "He'll have to work for-"

"COMMANDER! TRUCK COMING RIGHT FROM-"

The guard's warning was too late as from far off, the sound of metal being smashed apart was heard, everyone's attention brought to the gates.

Before them, some distance away was what looked like a satomobile truck that had crashed through the gate, looking worse for wear, sputtering in place.

No one made a move, waiting for whoever was inside to come out...

... finally, the door broke off the hinges, falling onto the dirt ground as a shape came out, looking to adjust his body.

No one was fooled by the bearded man who came out, looking to ignore what he just went through as his body healed, nor not care about the rush of soldiers coming it's way.

It was clear the Avatar Hunter had finally arrived in Zaofu.

"Where is she?" Wolf growled out before hearing a set of footsteps coming its way.

The others tried to hold her back, but Aila wanted to do this, choosing to step towards on her own, the wave of soldiers spreading apart. All to give her a look at her enemy.

Once he saw the target he had been tracking, the familiar rage that built up in Wolf's heart began to ignite, allowing his eyes to turn pure black once more.

He was about to step forth when Aila spoke loudly.

"BEFORE YOU COME FORTH…"

Hearing her words, the Hunter stopped in his tracks, taking sight of the calm and collective look in the Avatar's eyes. Even with the time in-between when they saw each other last, he distinctly remembered them back on the train.

And they were the same right now. Even resembled Ho-Seok to an extent.

As for what the Avatar wanted, Wolf decided to let her have the floor, just waiting...

"I know of your creation." He heard her speak, wondering where she was getting at.

"I know of those who were slain to make you, the father, the mother, children." Aila continued to speak, wanting to see if she could try getting into the unkillable's mind. "All murdered by a cult devoted to Vaatu, that much I know."

Both opponents began to pace around in a circle, the guards, all those of Team Avatar and their allies listening on as neither Aila nor the Hunter took their eyes off each other.

"I can tell you're not some mindless creature, you're smarter than you look, learn from whatever's around you... like me if you will. I'm sure it's how you were able to find, fight and kill Ho-Seok, correct?"

Off to the side, both Kuvira and Yasuko were curious as to the method the young Avatar was going, wanting to see this.

Wolf just wondered where the young woman was headed, though he remembered the brave man he slain all those years ago.

In turn, the Hunter just gave a nod as he spoke.

"Yes. You're correct about that, Avatar..."

Aila wasn't surprised to hear that.

Still, what she learned had her thinking as she stopped in place, as did it.

"So before we fight, answer me one question." The Avatar requested with a finger held up, to which Wolf nodded.

"Ask away."

"That family who was murdered to make you. Do you think they had any idea of what was going on?"

Before the Hunter could remark, he felt his chest begin to burn, where his heart was as something began to form in its mind, voices calling out to their ears.

"Ah, Ho-Seok, came to check our stand?"

Without warning, in its blackened eyes, The Avatar before it suddenly changed back to their past life, to the man the Hunter killed.

He saw Avatar Ho-Seok as the environment around them was different as well, like they were in a different point in the world. But it was certainly the Earth Kingdom, like a village.

Quickly, Wolf realized he was seeing through the eyes of someone he didn't know, or perhaps did. The man's voice was the one heard screaming for his family back at the motel.

The one who had his voice.

Yet now, all Wolf saw was the late Avatar approaching him like he was a friendly face, looking at all the fruit and vegetables for sale on a stand.

"Yes, me and Ming are getting ready for a family get-together. Need enough to feed six grown children and their own families as well." the large, but jolly gave a friendly laugh, that same voice of the Hunter's laughing along.

"If that's the case, going to make us run out of stock. None of us are plantbenders."

Ho-Seok sniggered, holding his hands up in mock defense. "Hey now, I'm a paying customer. I know you have three mouths to feed." he said before three others made their way over. "OH, speaking of which!"

"Avatar Ho-Seok!" Two of them, both fair skinned young children under the age of six, a boy and a girl, both ran up to the large man who easily popped them up with a burst of air below their feet he bended before grabbing and hugging them as the three laughed.

"Come on, it's Uncle Ho-Seok!"

The third person, a beautiful brown haired woman with lovely green eyes, smiled in a white and green dress while patting the large man's shoulder. "Always happy to have you visiting, Ho-Seok." she said before coming towards who the watcher assumed was her husband.

Yet to Wolf, each of the three's voices too sounded familiar...

... until the vision changed and he saw flashing before his eyes knives and axes being swung and stabbed down as the screams increased, all from the three, blood squirting from the flesh.

All while the Hunter heard the man scream out once more in his voice.

"STOP IT! PLEASE NO! AHH! NO!"

"Arise, great hunter, ARISE!"

Right on cue, Wolf's eyes reopened, revealing for everyone around it to see that it could emote from its amber eyes alone.

And it was clear whatever the Hunter saw troubled his mind, which even Aila noticed from her spot.

"Ahh, Avatar Hunter?" she calmly asked, wanting to know why it stopped to think. She had been surprised to see her opponent actually give her question some thought.

Aila had always remembered the advice given to her in the past about using what she learned and using it to her advantage, to try influencing matters to a different outcome.

But this was most certainly not what the Platinum Bender was planning on happening.

However, upon hearing his target's voice calling out, that was what made Wolf refocus himself, glaring at her. He chose to ignore what he saw in his mind for now.

Instead, the Avatar Hunter just sneered at her, amber eyes turning back into darkness once more.

"Their deaths served a purpose. Like yours will, Avatar."

Seeing things were back to how they were, Avatar Aila once more got into her stance, ready to fight, preparing to clench her hand.

"If it's what you want." she accepted before thrusting a mighty fist out towards her opponent, prepared to put to use what earthbending Toph had taught her...

... and yet nothing happened.

Noticing that, the young woman was caught by surprise and did it again.

Once more, same outcome.

"Ahhh..." she tried to save face, glancing up at her opponent who just kept watching her, tilting his head at her as even he couldn't make heads or tails about this.

"Is this some sort of joke?"

"Ah, right, sorry, still learning Earthbending, cut me some slack. Hehheh..."

Glancing at the others as she laughed nervously, Aila could see they weren't sure what was happening now, same with the Zaofu soldiers.

"Um, how about some fire, big guy?" she asked, giving a jumping spin kick in place, maybe send out a ring of flames towards the Hunter...

... instead, she just jumped, spun, kicked and landed on her feet, no bending following to her surprise.

THAT wasn't good.

"Why is there a lack of bending happening?" Roaluk had to whisper, needing an answer, only for Yasuko to have a sudden sinking feeling at what she felt in Aila's spirit.

And it was indeed THE WORST POSSIBLE THING to happen at the moment.

"She can't bend, something's blocking her bending."

As soon as they heard that, it was both Honei and Kallah who both yelled out at the same time, both having the same sense of fear in their souls as they looked at Aila.

"AILA, RUN!"

Taking heed, feeling like the biggest idiot ever, Aila turned heel and sprinted away towards her friends and allies, just as the Avatar Hunter followed her lead, not wasting this chance.

It was one thing to screw up earthbending, she was still learning it, even though Earth was her natural element and she was a Beifong, but it was still somewhat of an excuse.

But to fail at firebending so badly, not even a little spark coming out from her foot, THAT was when the Avatar knew something was terribly wrong and now had something made to hunt down and kill those like her rushing after her.

That was until several Zaofu guards sent forth globs of liquid metal, all to try trapping Wolf in place, looking to make some connection.

First, one looked to trap his feet together, causing the black-eyed being to stop in place before the same happened to his wrists, something which served to piss him off more as he screamed out a demand.

"RAGGH! COME HERE!"

At least four guards came towards Wolf, each of them preparing sharp looking pieces of metal in hand as Toph was quick to give the order.

"Go for kill shots, anything that will put that thing down!" she yelled out before taking sight of a panting Aila fell into the arms of Honei and Kuvira.

"What the fuck happened there, Aila?"

"I DON'T KNOW!" The young Avatar yelled back, looking at her hands. "My bending was working fine earlier, but soon as I went to fight that thing... I DUNNO!" she complained, realizing as she clenched her hands that she couldn't even metalbend her bracelets.

While the subject was discussed, both Jun and Kaguya both watched as the Zaofu guards began slamming the metal they bended into Wolf's body, stabbing it relentlessly while it struggled in its bindings. All until the Hunter could finally stop moving.

"Isn't this a little too harsh?" Jun asked, making sure to glance over to Opal as Yasuko tried to give Aila some sort of reason.

"I mean, yeah, that thing's killed a lot of people, but still..."

"Much as I want to see it pay for killing Ka-Kui and our fellow agents, I must agree with them." Kaguya too brought up, turning to the elder Airbender who nodded.

"While us airbenders don't believe in killing any living beings, it IS something that is considered the ABSOLUTE last resort, if all else fails." Opal described, turning her attention to the Hunter still taking all the stabbings, looking to endure punctures to most vital organs.

"With this Hunter, it would seem there is no other method to defeating it. I will not partake, but I won't stop my daughter's order as well."

The words of her mother did ring true to Toph, understanding where she was coming from as her twin brothers believed in it as well.

Just then, one soldier decided to cut to the chase and slammed the metal blade he had right into the Hunter's forehead, right between the eyes...

... and he stopped in place.

Something that caught everyone's attention as Wolf just stood there, propped up by all the metal still in its body before the guards bended them out, letting the human looking body fall to the ground.

The thud it made was sudden, but it made the entire group quiet.

"Woah, holy crap..." Bolin uttered before looking around.

"Is... Was that it?"

The detective's question rang through the other's ears as he stepped towards the body and nudged at the head with his foot, getting no response. "Did we just have to go for a head shot this whole time? Like killing a ghoul in a scary mover?" he asked out loud.

Something that Yasuko had to nod at as Jun approached the body themselves. "I... I guess so... Not sure if anyone's ever thought of that."

"I was going to go for the heart, but figured to go for the brain instead." the soldier who did the deed spoke up.

Trying to put their spirit reading to use, the enby airbender tried to find something, but shook their head.

"Can't read this thing's spirit, but it looks dead. It's not breathing."

"That's good then, Aila's safe. The Avatar Hunter is fucking dead!" Yasunori cheered out, raising a hand. "WOO! BAD GUY- ZERO, TEAM AVATAR- ONE!"

For all the craziness of her bending seeming to be blocked, Aila let a quick breath escape her lips, thankful at least one good thing happened. "Thank the spirits." she muttered, getting a soft pat on the shoulder by Roaluk.

"Indeed, worried that there would have been a big mess to clean, aside from all the blood." he commented in his usual manner, but thankful as well for the young member of his family. "At least you're okay, Aila."

As the others seemed to collect their breaths while the guards loosened the metal bindings around the Hunter's arms and legs, Honei just sat down on the ground and gave a proud smile to Kuvira, who returned it before heading over to Aila.

Before the robot could comment, she closed her eyes, thanking whatever spirit was listening to her prayers from the night before.

Prayers she made after she was tucked in by her grandmother and held onto her boyfriend's body in bed.

Only asking whatever spirit was listening to help give Aila a break.

"Seek the truth..."

Upon hearing the unknown voice, a young woman's to be exact, Honei swiftly opened her jade eyes, only to realize something to her own shock.

She wasn't in Zaofu, her little sister, family, friends or any others were around! Instead, she was at a place she had first gone to by accident two years prior.

"Sweet Rangi!" The black haired robot called out, jumping up onto her feet, realizing she was back in the Spirit World, seeing the colorful environment with spirits all around her.

"Where others be banned from..."

The voice spoke out again, now scaring the human looking robot as she looked around the area, looking for whoever said it before realizing something...

... her entire body was glowing blue as well as being see-through. Meaning only one thing as it registered within an instant in her CPU.

"HOW THE HECK AM I A SPIRIT?!" she yelled out, wondering just how she was in spirit form before a humored laugh ran through her ears.

"Simple; You accidentally meditated, ya' big dope." The voice spoke once more, Honei instantly realized it was coming right from behind her and whipped herself around, only to look down at someone she hadn't expected to meet in her entire life.

"TOPH?!"

The black haired twenty something-year old female in green and tan clothes just smirked, hands behind her toned back as she looked up with light green eyes, giving that famous snort before speaking more.

"Better find out the truth about that Avatar Hunter dick before he kills your little sister and my great great-granddaughter." the young looking spirit of Toph Beifong warned the robotic being who took the form of her descendant.

But Honei had been distracted by the fact that in the Spirit World, the famous bender COULD ACTUALLY SEE, that it took her a bit to realize her words.

"Wait, what about the Hunter?"

Just then, the robot realized her spirit was glowing more, which Toph herself noticed, realizing what was up as she tried to speak once more.

"Shit, you're going back to the human world. FIND THE LIBRARY!"

"Wait, WHAT library?!"

"Library?"

Suddenly Honei's vision had snapped back to where she was, her vision taking in everyone around her as now it was Aila checking up on her big sister, Kuvira at her side.

"Honei, what are you talking about?" her grandmother asked, not getting what just happened.

The tall robot was so confused as well, realizing that, SOMEHOW, she accidentally meditated and ended up in the Spirit World.

The dark skinned girl failed to come up with words as she looked around, including in the direction of where two of the guards picked up the Avatar Hunter's body by its wrists...

... and just noticed his fingers twitching.

"HE'S STILL ALIVE!" she screamed out towards the guards as everyone looked, but it was too late.

The piece of metal still stuck in his forehead, Wolf rose up and headbutted one guard right in the face, in turn stabbing the man with the other sharp end of the metal!

The sudden display of violence caught everyone off-guard as did the other guard holding him up, something which the black-eyed being was quick to resolve by ripping the metal out from its forehead.

As quick as it did that, the bloodied Hunter then slashed its makeshift weapon across the man's neck, able to easily decapitate the guard with one swing, the head plopping on the ground!

That dealt with, the blood covered killer felt the bleeding wound on his forehead heal up, glaring angrily at the frightened Avatar before him.

"Now... where were we, Avatar?"

Before it came forward, a massive circular pillar of stone raised up around the hunter from the ground!

One Toph held her hand out to bend up, turning her head towards the group.

"All of you, get Aila away from here, me and the soldiers will hold him off!" she yelled out, already hearing the stone foundation crack, knowing it would only buy them some time and that's it. "DO IT!"

"Wait, what are you doing, Toph?!" Yasuko cried out, taken aback at what she just heard, only for the commander to grab her wife's collar with her free hand and pull her into a quick kiss.

She followed that up with that famous Beifong smug smile.

"Sorry babe, I'm a Beifong. We only go out on our own terms."

Hearing a chunk of the pillar be punched through, all the accepting lavabender could do was just push her wife back into Kaguya and Bolin's arms before giving a knowing look towards her frightened mother as Aila and Honei stood near her.

"Keep 'em safe, mom."

"TOPH, NO!" Opal screamed out to her only daughter, but it was too late...

... before she or anyone else could act, Toph raised her hand up high, just as the Hunter broke free and the guards came rushing in, causing a huge circular wall to rise up between them!

Protecting those on the other side as it was then superheated into a massive slab of magma.

The heat from the lavabending was so intense, everyone had to back away from the wall, only able to hear the yelling and screams as they knew the Avatar Hunter was fighting off anyone in its path.

As with Toph, her yelling rang out for all those to hear.

"COME ON, MOTHERFUCKER! IS THAT ALL YOU GOT! FUCK YOU! FUCK YOU!"

Aila felt her spirit drop, unable to know just what was happening, only feeling more useless before feeling the hands of both Yasuko and Opal take her hands, able to see as with everyone else how much the selfless act of Toph's meant to them.

"Come on, let's get you out of here..." was all the Beifong woman could tear out as the massive group of eleven had to retreat.

Knowing they had a way to go through the property to get to the stables where the sky-bison were.

Running towards their residence, a loud sound of stone smashing erupted behind them.

Everyone turned back to see the Avatar Hunter had thrown one of those fighting him off through the wall to break through it.

To the dismay of many, that unmoving person was Toph, her large body being enough to be used as a battering ram.

Her forehead bled as she laid on the ground, some of her skin red from the heated contact, many other bodies slew about in various states.

Even worse for her wife and mother to see was that the same piece of metal that was used to stab the Hunter was now embedded below her lower ribs.

Seeing that, Yasuko wanted to go back for the woman she loved, but Roaluk pulled at her, shaking his head.

"'Suko, no, come on, please..."

Feeling powerless, yet knowing it was her wife's choice to make, the ambassador had to do what she was told and kept running.

Wolf himself saw the two benders where she was, figuring that was where the Avatar was headed. He had no idea how to get around the metal palace he was coming towards...

... only to stop briefly, that burning sensation on its chest coming back as did the headache.

Something that the being with the blackest eyes chalked down to getting stabbed in the head, something he just experienced for the first time.

And he didn't like it one little bit.

Able to relax, Wolf resumed his duty and followed their tracks...

Notes:

And the chapter is finished and... didn't go as planned! XD We got Aila with Korra's Spirit checking out the Hall of Beifong's, discussing the Kuvira situation, with the mention of Suyin's passing. (I wrote the original fic around the time Suyin's VA, Anne Heche, passed away and opted to not have the current her have any dialog or re-fancast her out of respect) But things look to be ready with Aila about to do some training finally with Kuvira... with Bolin and Yasuko spotting a little something about her before then...

... but OF COURSE, like established above, THE HUNTER HAS FINALLY ARRIVED IN ZAOFU. First with Team Avatar and those being informed by the guards of Wolf attacking some of their own and leaving a warning. And after some motivation for Aila, Wolf makes quite the entrance and comes face to face with her, ready to kill her... when Wolf has a flashback of his own, where not only does he see through the eyes of a man named Iko and the man's family, but also that he KNEW Ho-Seok somehow. But he pushes that aside and comes to make the attack, only for Toph and the local soldiers to kill him... so it seems.

Yet an unlikely spirit comes to NOT Aila, but Honei... the ORIGINAL Toph Beifong, who's in her "Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender" form, muscles and all as with eyesight, who tries to warn her about something and having to find some library in the Spirit World... before Honei comes back to the Human World and sees Wolf is still alive somehow! And indeed, the Hunter kills off the guards around him as he comes forth, not down yet as Toph and her soldiers force the others to retreat while they deal with Wolf, to Yasuko's concern. Especially upon the last sight of Toph II herself left bleeding on the ground, piece of metal in her. And the chase around the compound begins...

Chapter 15: Chapter Fifteen- Rampage

Notes:

It's the week of "Avatar: Seven Havens" (NO, have not seen or read the leaks, FUCK YOU LEAKER) and it's time to release the new chapter of "Rise of Aila"! Weird to post knowing the canonical sequel will finally be coming out? Sure, but that's fandom for you. But... well, no spoilers per say, but when I get to posting "LOK Book Seven- Eras", I figured out a good way to still bring in Seven Havens.

Until then, you saw the chapter title...

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, strong violence and bloody gore and some PTSD...

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Running down the halls, knowing the Hunter had just slaughtered countless guards, as well as taking Toph out of the picture, Aila felt like she was on edge.

Her breathing kept hitching as she was led along by those who chose to stand with her, unable to speak as so much was going through her mind.

While the group ventured forth, Bolin had to speak up.

"Okay, why are we headed to the stables? Feel like in the middle of that big bastard wrecking shit, we weren't fucking informed why!" he called out, to which Kuvira, Opal and Yasuko all shared glances.

"We were going to throw the idea by you after training before the Hunter came," Kuvira explained, rounding the corner past passing guards and servants who went to hide for cover. "That perhaps we'd bring Aila and you guys somewhere it didn't know about. Hide her away."

Having to stop her tracks upon hearing that, it seemed all too familiar to Aila, who had to look at her grandmother. "Hide me?" she repeated, concerned.

"You mean... hide me away from the world. Like what the White Lotus did with Korra after the Red Lotus tried to kidnap her?"

Hearing that for themselves, Jun spoke up. "Wait, I thought the Grand Lotus was against the idea! They promised that was never going to happen!"

"YOU'RE NOT LOCKING MY SISTER AWAY!" Honei jumped to Aila's defense as did Kallah, who eyed the women with distrust.

"I heard the stories, how the White Lotus kept her-"

"Ret-Kadda..."

All attention was brought to Kuvira who had her eyes closed, speaking more. "It was MY idea to take Aila there, where I've been since leaving Junior and Baatar behind."

Hearing their grandmother speak of her past, all the Avatar and her big sister could do was watch her take a deep breath, worry in her eyes.

"Please Aila, I can't lose you, aside from Honei, you're the only connection I have left to my son." the elder bender begged, looking at the two girls. "I already had to give up being a mother after I killed Guan, I can't bear to lose another."

But before more could be said, a loud crash of metal being broken apart rang out behind the group, realizing the Avatar Hunter had tracked them down by breaking through a door, cracking his neck as he voiced his annoyance.

"I didn't come all the way here for you to just run away, Avatar. Just accept your death with bravery!"

Just before any of the humans could make a move, without fear in her jade eyes, Honei immediately stood in Wolf's way, putting her fists up as she glared at the being.

"You stay THE FUCK AWAY FROM MY LITTLE SISTER!" she cursed out towards him, as Yasunori could only realize what his girlfriend was planning as was Aila.

"HONEI! What are you doing?!" he yelled out, to which the robot just gave a brave look at the stoic being in front of her.

"If The Hunter wants to lay a finger on Aila, he has to earn the right. I got this, Yasunori."

Realizing there was no way to talk her big sister out of this, all Aila could do was give an audible gulp as she felt hands pull her away. "Honei?" she meekly said, forced to leave her sister behind as with Yasunori.

Turning back to the unkillable, the robot just grinned at the dark eyes glaring at her.

"You sure you want to do this? I won't offer mercy." Wolf warned her, making his way towards the taller girl, all while Honei just smirked and responded in kind.

"Funny, I was thinking the same thing."

As soon as she said that, the Avatar Hunter swung its fist right to the side of her face, before feeling that sensation of pain fill its fist, grunting out at what just happened.

"GAH!"

All while Honei just gave a knowing grin as she looked back at him, as she spit out a false back molar and some oil from her mouth.

"Bet you never faced off against someone made of platinum."

The gynoid then drove a piston powered punch right against Wolf's throat, looking to catch him by surprise before driving a knee into its stomach, knocking it back. All while keeping the smile that'd make the Beifong's proud.

"Come on, you're boring me." she sniggered before coming towards the Hunter once more, her powerful strength and fast speed most certainly giving her an edge as she kept at it with her strikes and kicks.

After delivering a rough roundhouse kick, Honei engaged both of her taser hands and grabbed them around the sides of the Hunter's head, letting it feel the jolts coursing through its body.

"RAGGHH!"

Screaming out in pain as what seemed like quick milli-second flashes of... SOMETHING flashed through his eyes, the unkillable fought through the pain, holding his hands out to grab the robot by the waist and rose up onto his feet.

Before she knew it, Honei felt herself being flung through a metal wall, crash landing on the ground!

Trying to refocus itself, Wolf looked to where he threw her, seeing her rise up with ease.

He knew this girl was different from others he fought, but just the amount of power within her frame and what she was capable of did throw him in a loop.

But Wolf wouldn't back down, not from this girl made of platinum, just giving her eyes full of anger.

Knowing brute force wouldn't work here, he had to play smart.

Eyeing that behind the girl was the open door to the kitchen, a few ideas came to mind.

Yelling out, the Hunter charged forth, lowering its head down and tackled Honei right into the next room, both colliding against the counter as utensils clanged around all over.

Trying to get up, the Avatar Hunter arose over Honei, only for a hanging pot to slip off the overhead hook it was on and hit the being right in the forehead.

As soon as it made impact, the angry being cried out in pain.

"AH! DAMMIT!" he barked out, holding his forehead while his chest began to burn once more, backing away while letting out a scream.

"YAAHHHH!"

Unknown to the confused Honei as she watched this, those images flashed through Wolf's mind.

The family was seeing through the man's eyes, how Ho-Seok knew of him.

The horrible images of death, the sounds he heard...

... then feeling himself awaken, seeing hooded figures around him.

With the corpses of the mother and her children laid before Wolf.

Unlike the other times, it actually hurt the Hunter to witness as he tried to breath.

"What are these damn sights I keep seeing?!" he let out.

"Ahh... Hunter?"

Hearing the voice of the robot actually sounded somewhat concerned, Wolf didn't know what to make of things as he went to look at her...

... only for a large thick piece of metal to be shot at his face, sending him to the ground!

Jerking her head towards where the metal came from, Honei saw it was one of the guards who had done the deed near the doorway.

'Ms. Makimura, are you okay?" he asked, rushing in. "Did that thing hurt you?"

The robot wasn't sure what to say, on the count of what she witnessed there and then, shaking her head. "I-I had it handled... but thanks."

The guard, taking off his helmet to show his youthful face, was confused.

"You're welcome. Maybe we should-"

A large shape suddenly came forth at the guard, interrupting his words as Honei jumped back in shock, realizing Wolf had come back up in a fury to grab his attacker.

The robot could only watch as the Avatar Hunter quickly grabbed the poor guy by the forehead and slammed the back of his head against the wall three times, an increasing smudge of blood made each time.

That settled, the violent being dropped the corpse and turned back around to see his opponent was still there, seeing the look of shock in her eyes.

"Do please ignore the interruption."

Realizing things were more concerning than she thought, that left Honei distracted, enough for Wolf to come back at her, ready to fight her once more.

After what seemed like forever, before the group who had been trying to retreat was the stables, where both Junior and Ying-Ling were resting, not knowing as to what was going on.

"Alright, we're here, who do you take?" Kaguya questioned Kuvira, eyeing her sand wolf.

"Junior can run pretty fast, get us a good distance away." she pointed out before looking at the sky-bison. "But Ying-Ling will be able to fly us away from Zaofu with ease."

Both seemed like good choices, the platinum bender turning to her granddaughter, hoping for her opinion.

"Aila, which do you..."

But Kuvira trailed off her words, seeing that her granddaughter was thinking something over. "Aila?"

"We have to go back, we can't leave Honei behind." The Avatar spoke up, knowing how it sounded to everyone, focusing on her granddaughter. "We need to help her."

"She'll be fine, I doubt the Hunter can break platinum. It's you that's in danger."

"What, because I can't bend? You think I can't protect myself?"

"No, it's not that-"

"Are you sure, Nainai? Cause you seemed pretty set on taking me away, even before I couldn't bend."

"Aila, it's not like that!"

Both Grandmother and granddaughter argued, the others seeing how things were, knowing time was only getting shorter the more with Wolf around.

Regardless, Aila had to put her foot down.

"DAMMIT, SHE'S MY BIG SISTER! SHE'S BEEN WITH ME-"

"YOU THINK I WANTED TO LEAVE HER BEHIND!?" Kuvira screamed out, her emotions causing all the metal around the stables to shake around indirectly with her bending.

The Avatar was caught off guard by the outburst as was everyone else.

"You don't think I'm scared for her? I AM! I'M POSITIVELY FRIGHTENED!" Kuvira explained, her heart hurting as she explained herself. "Aila, I saw Honei, the first one, die before my very eyes inside that hospital room thirteen years ago. I saw how horrible of a state she was, wrapped up in those bandages, covering her burns."

The memory was one of the many still haunting her.

"I still blame myself for not being there to protect my family. The one I had to give up, just like my parents did with me!"

No one expected the platinum bender to bring up her parents. It was very known that the woman disowned them and never liked to talk about them, watching her get more emotional toward a silent Aila, her voice rising more as she spoke.

"You want to know the worst part? Seeing your sister awaken while in so much pain, speaking only one word to me, 'Grandma'." she described, putting on a saddened smile. "For the first time in my life, I felt THE JOY of being someone's grandmother..."

Shaking her head, tears coming down her face, Kuvira felt her heart pound more and more as she remembered it all crashing down.

"And then, IT WAS RIPPED AWAY FROM ME, THE SECOND SHE PASSED AWAY BEFORE MY EYES! ALL BECAUSE OF THE FUCKING RED LOTUS!" she screamed out, remembering how she found and murdered the bomber for what he did to her.

"So YES, I am scared for the Honei we know. But I know she can survive because of what she is. But you're different, you're only flesh and blood and you're that thing's target, unable to bend to protect yourself if- No, WHEN that thing goes through us to get you..."

And for the first time since they met, Aila realized how deep the mental wounds of the woman before her were, seeing her look so scared as her grandmother screamed out her vow.

"I will NOT WATCH ANOTHER GRANDDAUGHTER OF MINE DIE BEFORE MY EYES AGAIN!"

Letting that all out of her system, Kuvira just kept breathing out, the only sound heard among the stables as Aila just looked on in sheer concern...

... but before she could try calming down and assuring her grandmother, the Avatar noticed one arm of Kuvira's go slack, as did the bender herself as well as an odd chest pain.

"Huh... That's... concerning."

That was all the white haired woman commented on in-between breaths before falling down to her knees, the others rushing to herself.

"SHIT! What's happening to her?" Jun called out, Roaluk realizing what was up within an instant.

"She's having a heart attack!"

Feeling everything starting to fall apart, Aila quickly took hold of her grandmother, trying to keep talking to her as Jun, Yasuko and Opal kept giving her air through airbending.

"Nainai, NAINAI, don't die on me, DON'T DIE ON ME!" she cried out as both Kallah and Roaluk took out some water from their waterskin's to try helping.

As this was quite the dour moment, Bolin couldn't help but realize something as he looked around.

"Wait, where the fuck is Yasunori?"

Honei had felt herself crashing down through two levels of flooring, landing hard as she groaned out as any normal person would do. She didn't feel pain, but it still wasn't fun.

After Wolf took back control, it seemed the anger he held towards her sister was now being transferred to her and it was not going as planned, already taking their fight up through two levels.

Letting herself get back up, seeing part of the outer layer of false skin be scraped off of her right elbow, Honei saw the circuits exposed while standing in the middle of the Hall of Beifong's, parts of the displays being knocked over from the fall.

Hearing footsteps behind her, she knew the Hunter was close and went to send out another hard punch.

But the black-eyed being saw it coming and caught it with one hand.

Being quick on the draw, Wolf reached forth at the exposed circuits and pulled them out, letting go of her while pushing her back.

Confused, Honei tried to move her right arm, only to see it wasn't working, her green eyes going wide at this as he commented on this.

"You're not human, but you still share some of their weaknesses."

Realizing her right arm and hand were useless, the robot tried to fight back with her other hand, only for Wolf to grasp her by the throat and rush her against a painted portrait of Lao and Poppy Beifong, destroying it while keeping her forced against the wall.

The Hunter sneered in anger, figuring that if it could damage platinum, he could possibly crush her neck if he tried hard enough...

"YAHHH!"

Wolf let out a mighty scream of pain as something thin and metal had shot out the right side of its chest, passing by the side of Honei's head.

To her own surprise, she realized that it was the blade of some sword. One that was blackened as the Avatar Hunter let go of her in his pain.

All while Yasunori let go of the handle to the Hanzo-Beifong original katana he had used to impale the Hunter with, trapping him against the metal wall with it.

"GET YOUR FUCKING HANDS OFF MY GIRLFRIEND!" he screamed out, letting go of the weapon and taking Honei's hand, helping her up while getting away from the area and the struggling Hunter.

"Yasunori?" she said his name out loud, the human boy she loved leading her along.

"We got to move. Maybe only bought us a few minutes extra while he's distracted."

As they rushed along, Honei had to take a quick moment to look at her disabled arm, which the eye-patch wearing young man noticed. "Oh shit, Aila can fix that, right?"

"Yeah, course."

"NAINAI!"

The eyes of the ninety year-old opened wide as she gasped out, it felt like time just paused before coming back.

Now, Kuvira realized her eyes were looking up at the ceiling of the stable as the others were above her, looking so worried.

"Nainai, you're alive!" she could hear her granddaughter calling out, holding her hand tightly before hugging her. "Spirits, thought we'd lose you."

All the grandmother herself could do was nod, patting her with her right hand, realizing she had gained back some control of her arm as she spotted those with them were too thankful to see she was alright.

"W-Wha... What happened?" Kuvira spoke carefully, Roaluk giving a deep thankful breath.

"Seems like old age tried to put you down for good, You just had a small heart attack."

"A heart attack?" Kuvira repeated in distress, holding her hand over her chest as Opal gave calm words.

"Yes, must have been in the making for awhile, at least that's what Roa and Kallah figured." she explained before placing her hand on her sister-in-law's shoulder. "But they were able to save you."

Realizing how close of a call she had, the elderly bender realized how sudden it was, how quick, looking around. "Thank you all..." she said before looking at Aila, able to see her cheeks were stained with tears.

"Aila..."

"I... I was worried you-"

"Don't worry, Aila..."

The Avatar hushed herself up when Kallah spoke up, the waterbender just giving a sure look at the two.

"Your grandmother, she's a Beifong, a fighter, like you and Honei.." The curly haired girl perfectly put it in words.

Thankful to hear that, both Aila and Kuvira looked at each other, the older platinum bender giving a deep breath, knowing how close of a call she had.

"Aila, I won't stop you from making your choice here-"

"GUYS! GUYS!"

Once more interrupted, the two as with everyone else took notice of Yasunori's voice calling out, witnessing both him and Honei rushing into the stables, everyone taking notice of the disabled arm of the latter.

"Honei, what-" Kaguya tried to begin, only for the robot to shake it off.

"Not important, but this is."

Looking at her little sister, grandmother and Yasuko, Honei recalled everything. "Alright, so me and the Hunter were fighting all over the area, apologizes for any damage to the Hall of Beifong's and some floors, Auntie Opal." she hurriedly added in before continuing.

"But we ended up in the kitchen and in the process, the Hunter got hit in the forehead, right where had been stabbed, but after he healed up, AND hi ya' fluffy animals!" The black haired robot had to stop and wave her good hand at Ying-Ling and Junior, as well as Quy-Mo.

But Bolin had to get her back to reality. "Honei, focus."

"RIGHT!" Honei remembered, looking back at Aila, the most serious look she could give on her face. "After he got hit, he started to freak out. Saying he was seeing things."

"And... what does that have to do with-" Aila tried to ask, the robot having an idea.

"That scroll Yasuko and Kaguya showed off, with how the Hunter was made by the Vaatu cult." She began giving her theory. "It mentioned a family being sacrificed for the ritual, the father's body being used to be the vessel of the Hunter. I think-"

The loud clang of metal hitting metal sputtered out, something wet hitting Aila's face.

Something black, oily.

All a confused Honei could do was look down, realizing a blackened katana blade was sticking out of her chest, the others realizing the weapon was thrown at her.

"Huh, if I had a silver piece every time that's happened."

Everyone's attention whipped towards the entrance of the stables.

Right where Wolf was, having escaped from his predicament and just thrown the Hanzo-Beifong original katana he was stuck with like a javelin at the robot's back.

Lucky for Honei, she was still functioning and aware while stumbling onto her knees, if some of her movement below her ribcage were disabled.

Once more, his attention focused solely on Aila.

"Enough stalling, Avatar! FIGHT ME!"

Before the frightened Avatar, having taken her disabled sister in her arms while Kuvira and Kallah got the sword out of her, could comment, her allies bravely stood in front of her, all at each other's side.

"You come to our home, kill many innocent people, hurt those we care for and seek to harm Aila?" Opal spoke, a flair of anger in her voice.

Having taken the Hanzo-Beifong original sword in hand, stained in the oil of his girlfriend, Yasunori shook his head as he gave a threat.

"We've had enough of your bullcrap."

"And if you fuck with one member of Team Avatar..." Bolin agreed, bending up some blue fire knives in hand as Jun stood by him, letting the air they bended course around their body while finishing his statement.

"... You fuck with all of us."

Disrobing his suit jacket, showing his waist coat while rolling up his shirt sleeves, revealing the set of Water Tribe influenced tattoos on his lower arms, Roaluk kept his waterskin prepared while glancing at Kallah.

"Ms. Adjuk, please stay at their side, Kuvira may still be in need of assistance." he politely requested before glaring at Wolf.

"And I'll be too busy giving this ruffian twenty cc's of beating the shite out of him."

"OH, medical based insult." Kaguya cheekily commented as Yasuko was prepared to fight as well, glaring at it with fierce eyes, that of both her mother's.

"Your hunt ends here."

And for the first time for each of them, Wolf just glared at those before it...

... before a knowing smile formed on his lips, as if interested.

"Alright then, who's first?"

Kaguya was the first to come at him, her feet light and fast enough to allow herself to get close enough and strike pressure points on the being's left arm.

The sudden loss of sensation and control in its muscles did catch the Hunter by surprise, trying to swing its good hand at the half-spirit agent, only for her to duck and deliver a rapid set of punches to its kidney and liver.

Pain was most certainly felt, but Wolf was able to fight through it, preparing to slam the palm of its hand down...

... only to feel a burst of freezing cold overcome it before feeling the whole thing freeze over.

The curious being brought its hand down to see it was encased in ice, courteously of Roaluk who wouldn't let up, thrusting and swinging his hands out as Kaguya got away from the Hunter.

All to allow the waterbender to send out thin, but punishing water lashes against him, making Wolf stumble back on his feet before a sharp ice spike was jabbed close to its kidneys!

Not one to feel left out, Bolin let loose some fire bolts, the blue flames hitting right where the stubborn being was stabbed before delivering a spin kick, allowing a large wave of flames to come towards the Hunter.

The amount of contact made was enough to ignite the bloodied torn remains of the black eyed thing's jacket and shirt in flames.

A distraction which Yasunori wouldn't let go as he came forth and slashed away the sword in his hands across the burning Wolf's stomach and chest as he was too distracted trying to get the clothing off.

With the non-bender getting out of the way, the three airbenders each stood side-by-side, Jun, Opal and Yasuko each waving their hands in a synchronized pattern before thrusting their palms out towards their opponent.

The combined might of the powerful airbenders were enough to send forth a gust of wind that actually took the Avatar Hunter off its feet, sending him flying through the wooden stable wall and out into the nearby empty training field for soldiers.

Knowing that obviously wouldn't be enough, Yasuko turned to the other four watching the scene.

"We'll deal with him. If we don't come back in the next couple minutes, get out of here!" she insisted, seeing her Anaana reborn just give a concerned nod.

Seeing that, the daughter of Korra and Asami, as with those who can fight, rushed towards Wolf to combat him, leaving Aila to think things over, unable to shake the feeling of being useless to protect her friends and family.

"Aila..."

The young Avatar turned to Kallah helping Kuvira up to her feet. "Can you get Honei up, get her up on Ying-Ling?" she asked before feeling herself grimace. "Just in case..."

The young woman got what her girlfriend was implying, not wanting things to end up going that path, but she nodded.

"Yeah, course."

Getting the two out of commission family members over to the sky-bison's saddle, Aila glanced at how concerned both Kuvira and Honei looked, able to see they were feeling just as useless at the moment because of what they endured.

But the Avatar had an idea to take their mind off of things.

"Nainai, can you still bend?" she asked, her grandmother nodding.

"Can't see why not, shouldn't be an issue in my current state."

That was just the answer Aila was hoping to hear, giving a thankful smile as she held Honei's hand, seeing the oil still leak out of her exposed metal chest.

"That's good. If I guide you, you can use your bending to repair Honei, give her proper movement."

"What about the others?" the robot asked, worried not just for her boyfriend, but the others she cared for, her jade eyes moving towards the group seeming to fight the Hunter off.

Everyone's glances turned to the group, seeing that they seemed to have things handled for now.

But Aila knew sooner or later, the Hunter would get the advantage and...

NO, she didn't want to think of the thought.

"You heard Yasuko... we give them at most six minutes, if not..."

Even just saying that hurt Aila's own spirit to say, lowering her head, trying to hold back her tears before looking up at their knowing grandmother, needing to take hold of Kallah's hand just in case.

"Alright, Nainai, it's not as hard as it seems, but still not easy to work around Honei's components..." she began, the bad thoughts simmering in the back of her mind while starting to go over the instructions.

The blackened blade swung diagonally across the Hunter's chest, Yasunori having tried to swing hard enough to get a deep enough cut in.

But being new with this sort of weapon, the damage he did was only minor, the wound across the now bare-chested Wolf healing almost instantly.

A tattooed arm wrapped around the larger man's throat before a blue fire knife was repeatedly stabbed into its stomach, chest and neck, Bolin yelling out as he kept at it.

"COME ON, YOU BIG BASTARD! GO DOWN ALREADY!"

Following his cue, Yasunori let go of the Hanzo-Beifong original sword and took out his shark tooth knife to join in on stabbing the Hunter, trying to get some damage in.

Wolf tried to throw and push the two away, but they were rather relentless.

Deciding to go for a straightforward kill shot, Yasunori decided to go for the heart, right where the branding of the Hunter's marking was. The specially made blade made skin contact...

... only to stop itself in place, a hard thud heard, catching the one-eyed young man by surprise.

That surprise was all Wolf needed to backhand Yasunori down to the ground with the back of his hand, the sand shark tooth knife still in its chest.

Seeing his friend hit the ground hard, rolling along it, Bolin shouted out to him mid-stabbing.

"Oh, FUCK! Yasunori!"

Next thing the firebender knew, he felt himself being flung over the Hunter's shoulder, landing roughly on the ground before feeling his whole body being kicked away.

Having gotten the troublesome detective off of his back, Wolf took the special looking knife out of its chest, briefly watching the new wound heal up where his heart was.

Once healed up fully, the Hunter then took brief attention to what the blade was made from. "This is a weird looking knife." he commented before deciding to go stab one of the two.

An idea cut short upon the hard smack of a collapsible staff swung against its face, sending it reeling!

An attack thanks to Jun themselves, the airbender easily swung their weapon around, creating waves of air blades to keep the being at bay.

Enough to send Wolf backwards, right into the continuing onslaught by the fighting Beifong's, Kaguya and Yasuko.

"Ahhh..."

Seeing their friend groaning out in pain, Jun got to Bolin's side to help him up.

"Woah, how are you feeling?"

"Aside from my stomach feeling like a kick ball, same ol'." the detective tried to joke through the pain, glancing in the direction of Yasunori. "What about you, bud?"

"Pretty sure my movement feels pretty delayed... my head's aching... Oh boy..."

Gritting in pain as the eye-patch wearing teenager passed out from the pain, all Bolin could do was glance at his ex. "Yeah, you might wanna get him some aid." he insisted, rising up to his feet, not out of it yet. "I'll focus on the asskicking."

The brave and selfless side of him coming out did get Jun to put on a knowing smile.

"You're not worried about dying?"

"Me? OH, I'm more worried about that dick." Bolin deadpanned back in pain, both watching the Hunter having to deal with avoiding both waves of air and water expertly bended by both Yasuko and Roaluk.

But then he managed to get in a trusting look of his own towards Jun, slipping in a quick wink of the eye.

"Besides, you have an excuse for taking it easy."

That little reminder did get the airbender to give an unintended blush on their cheeks, hiding it as they went to check on Yasunori.

The combined effort of the two Beifong's and White Lotus members certainly brought a challenge to the Avatar Hunter, itself feeling the pressure of constantly losing its footing with each gust of wind thrown at it.

It was seeing the waterbender lash forth tentacles of water from the waterskin that did give the stubborn Hunter an idea, charging towards Roaluk.

Tanking through whatever lashes of water came at it, the Hunter got close enough and kicked dirt towards the airbenders' direction before slashing at the pouch with the sand shark knife still in its possession.

Seeing his source of waterbending about to spill out, Roaluk tried holding an open hand out to keep bending it and not run out.

EXACTLY what the cunning being knew would happen for he then drove the blade of the special knife right into his shoulder!

"AAAUGGGHHH!"

But such a loud response was short-lived when for a hard foot to drive itself right into the Hunter's face from mid-air, Bolin managing to make the save by knocking the being back as he landed on his feet with ease.

"ROALUK!" The detective heard Opal yell out to her cousin, coming to his aid as with Yasuko and Kaguya while he got ready in his fighting stance to keep fighting.

"I'll get him to the healers!"

While the Hunter got back to his feet, it was Bolin's turn to properly take the blackened-eyed man on, kicking rings of fire around, making sure the hits landed by advancing towards the burning enemy, knowing this would draw the Hunter away from the group.

Even if it wouldn't really kill him, the descendant of Avatar Hiromi wouldn't let up.

Letting his firebending loose, Bolin raised both hands to raise a pillar of blue flames before punching his fists at them, sending forth fireballs bit-by-bit

Yet that blocked his sight for a small moment...

... all Wolf needed to charge forth through the burning flames and tackle himself right into the surprised firebender, bringing him to the ground.

"ACHK!"

Starting to feel those powerful hands start grasping around his throat, Bolin gasped out before bending a flame in one free hand and shoved it right into the Hunter's face.

But the trick wouldn't work as Wolf didn't let go, his burns healing.

More annoyed at this, the unkillable was quick to deliver two quick punches to his face before then taking the hand that burned him, before jerking it just enough to break a bone in the lower wrist.

"YAAGGGHHHH!"

"BOLIN!" Jun yelled out from where they were at Yasunori's side, watching in horror as Bolin let out the scream of agony at his arm being broken.

While that was a little petty of him, Wolf then got up and placed a single foot onto the injured's throat.

"I could have done much worse to you. And I'm very much considering it." he hissed out, seeing that even with the broken limb, the firebender was STILL trying to pull his leg off with his one good hand.

"Tell you what, I'll make an offer. Give me ONE good reason why I shouldn't kill you, despite all the trouble you've given me, and I'll spare you." Wolf however offered, doing his little head tilt once more.

"If not, I'll crush your throat like-"

"HE'S GOING TO BECOME A FATHER!"

Those six words being cried out seemed to just silence everyone still in the vicinity, not explaining such a claim.

None more than the Hunter and Bolin, both speaking up at the same time.

"What?"

"WHAT?!"

The two witnessed Jun leaving Yasunori in Kaguya's care, so they could rush over to be at the injured side while looking up with pleading eyes.

"PLEASE, don't kill him, Bolin still-"

"Wait, you said... That I'm... not-" Bolin tried to grasp out in utter confusion, only to see those scared blue eyes look down at him.

And Jun, they only shook their head, their emotions pushing them to do this as they cried out, not wanting this to happen. "I lied. You ARE the father, I'm carrying your child..."

For his part, Wolf hearing such a reason did seem rather sudden, as if-

"I'm pregnant, Iko."

Before the Hunter knew it, his vision warped and changed once more as he heard that woman's voice once more, seeing her inside what looked like a hut-like bedroom.

It was the mother he witnessed interacting with her children and Ho-Seok.

But why did she just call him that name?

"You... We're... we're going to have another child, Li-Bing?"

"Yes, our third child."

"A third?"

"Yes..."

WAIT, Li-Bing?! Wolf recalled that name, hearing himself sound so happy to hear the news as it looked like he was about to kiss her...

... only for the sight of a dagger being driven right into the chest of the once-happy woman, her face now screaming out in agony!

"YAAHHH!"

"GAAHHHH!" Wolf screamed out in utter agony as his chest burned intensely, the pain coursing through his brain forcing him away from the taken aback Bolin and Jun as he grasped his head.

"GET OUT OF MY HEAD!"

What was this?! Why did he hear and see these images now?!

For a brief second, a thought came to his mind as his creation came to mind.

Before anymore could be done, right then, the handle of the Hanzo-Beifong original was slammed into the Hunter's face, before a flash of its darkened steel went across his neck, silencing him as his amber eyes froze open...

... before his head fell to the ground before Bolin and Jun, the body following after nearby.

For a second, no one said anything as all four looked and turned to see the one who did the deed.

Seeing Avatar Aila hold the infamous sword in both her hands, giving deep breaths as she stood over the headless body.

All she could do was just look at the being that had tracked down her past life and killed him before coming for her.

But she stopped it, the Avatar Hunter was down for the count.

Even worse, Aila remembered the vow she made back in the police station years before as she lowered the weapon, dropping it to the ground and feeling herself kneel on the dirt, tearing up at what she had done.

Right then, able to snap out of her senses, Yasuko Sato began to approach her Anaana reborn, only for another to have their hands take the crying girl in and hug her tightly as she could.

"It's okay, Aila, it's alright."

Toph Beifong II, herself having recovered from being stabbed, spoke as softly as she could, her wife and the others shocked to see her.

"Toph! You're-"

Hearing the cry of happiness from the woman she loved, the lavabender did have to hold up a hand to quiet her down with a grimacing, yet still pleased smile.

"It'll take more than a poke to the ribs to put down this old bitch." She tried to joke briefly before moving her hand through the still crying Aila's hair.

"But let's not focus on me now, just Aila."

Her wife agreed as Yasuko joined in on the hug, making sure to slip her fingers into those strong, but soft ones as the couple held the girl who was part of their family, letting her keep sobbing into their arms.

From the stables, both a still being repaired Honei and Kallah watched the girl they cared for breaking down in the couple's arms in sadness, despite finally seeming to end the Hunter.

But both knew the injured would get the help they needed.

For Kuvira however, she knew exactly how her granddaughter felt, more than the others.

That would be yet another thing she and Aila would now share.

Notes:

Alright, not what you expected with things to turn out, eh? Well, just leave you all to stew over the surprises, big moments and that ending...
