Chapter 22: Chapter Twenty Two- Springs, a Catfox and a Cranky Spirit

Notes:

Hello dear readers, with another batch of "Seven Havens" episodes coming this Friday, so many theories already, gotta also get to releasing more of "Rise of Aila", so here's a new chapter!

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, including some slurs, some sexual content/nudity and some violence.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

What each of the three girls were seeing as they were led by Kuvira and Redbear was unlike anything they had ever seen before.

After training was done for the day, both adults figured it was best to finally show Aila, as well as Honei and Kallah, the springs that the waterbender kept an eye on before the young couple made their way to Zarah's place.

Walking up to the small pile of stone, which they realized upon getting closer was at least the same height as Redbear, they saw there was an entryway that led down to a dark area, a set of old steps already formed.

After following the adults with their heads down, each holding flashlights and seeing what was before them, to say they were completely in awe would be an understatement.

"WOAH, look at this place..." Kallah said as her girlfriend held onto her as they carefully made it down the steps, seeing the more they walked down, the more they saw how beautiful the cavern they entered was.

Even more so when they saw the relaxing pools of water resting there, looking at most five feet deep, all sourced thanks to a waterfall constantly falling on one side.

Neither of the three girls believed such a place like this existed when they heard of what locale they were going to, but here it was.

"This place is... it's something." Aila spoke up, bending up a flame for more light while looking at Kuvira and Redbear, who were looking around it.

The platinum bender had looked around the cavern, seeing how the formation was. "Yeah, I never knew this place was here when I first arrived in town. Kind of wish I did in hindsight."

The glasses-wearing man agreed, watching how easily the water fell from the falls, knowing its source and how much power it held.

"The town elders were aware of these springs, what the spirits blessed it with. But they were respectful enough to not disturb it when the foundation for Ramaal-Hadia was first settled." Redbear described, able to feel its spiritual properties just by standing where he was.

"Ever since moving here, I have devoted most of my time studying and protecting it, learning what the spirits have to offer."

He wasn't the only one feeling how spiritual the area was as both Aila and Kallah felt it in their own way, the Avatar wondering. "How old do you think this place is?"

"Can't say for certain, but Redbear figures it's at least old enough that it goes back a hundred of your lifetimes." Kuvira spoke up, walking next to her granddaughter as the younger waterbender realized something, kneeling herself down to one of the pools with her free hand over it.

"Redbear, you say the Spirits blessed these springs," she said before looking at the group. "You think it's possible the water here can be used as Spirit Water, kinda like over in both the North and South Pole?"

That was something even Redbear never thought of, not being a water healer like the fire nun was, but he did consider the thought.

"It is quite possible. If these springs can clear and relax one's mind, then healing wounds shouldn't be an issue in the slightest." he answered, wondering himself.

As the group talked more, the only one left out of her own free will was Honei, the robot scanning her eyes all over the cavern, making sure to scan and save every single inch of it, in her memory bank.

Yet something else was yearning out to her, over near one pool of water.

Stepping up to it and looking inside, an unfamiliar voice spoke in her head.

"Clear your mind, Honei, let it engulf you..."

"Honei?

The voice was replaced by that of Aila's own, the eyes of the robot looking back at her little sister, attention back on her and the other three.

"Hey, we were going to grab mine and Kallah's luggage, so we could head over to Zarah's place to check in, wanna come along?" the Avatar asked politely.

Of course, what big sister wouldn't want to help out those she cared for...

... yet the voice that spoke kept nagging at the robot, who put on a friendly smile.

"Yeah, course silly." she accepted, getting back up on her feet, slinking over to the group, following them out.

The way Honei saw it anyway, she could wait until everyone's asleep before coming back here...

At the same time...

Having finally regrouped, those who had meditated their way to the Spirit World finally had the chance to talk to Toph's spirit, relaxing themselves in the field of grass as she spoke.

"So, first off, I heard about little Bo and Jun having their own rugrat. Good on 'em, I'm sure all your families will be overjoyed at the news." she chose to begin with, giving her approval before beginning to pick at her teeth with a fingernail. "Bolin still has to have two more kids to tie with Su's record."

Flicking away whatever was on her finger, the iconic bender's spirit just patted her hands on her knees. "So, you all wanna know what's up with Honei?" she asked, Yasunori having to give a respectful nod, awestruck to be meeting the spirit of such a legendary figure.

"Yeah, ah, that's what we're here for, Ms. Beifong."

"Fucks sake kid, just call me Toph. You're already dating my great-great granddaughter." she called him out, glancing at him. "That said, you must really find her special considering what she is."

Hearing that, Yasuko and Opal looked his way because unlike those close to him, they didn't know the whole story of how they met.

Giving a bashful rub of the back of his head, he explained as briefly as he could.

"Yeah... to be blunt, when we first met, I was kind of a stupid shithead who was about to pay for a bad mistake... and Honei was the first one who gave me a second chance to redeem myself." he admitted, thinking back to that day back at the police station.

It was so surreal for Yasunori to remember back when he thought he was metaphorically screwed, only for the human-looking gynoid to come save him.

"If it wasn't for her convincing Aila to lie to the police that day, I'd still be in jail right now, or more than likely dead. I didn't know she was a robot at the time, I just thought Honei was a very sweet, innocent and friendly girl who I instantly fell for."

Giving a crook of a smile, the non-bender just shrugged. "And yet, even after I found out the truth... I didn't care, I didn't see a robot made in the image of a dead girl, I just saw Honei. So yeah, I do find her special enough to love her."

Saying all of that earned him a quick nudge of a fist against his shoulder by Toph, who just snorted along with a smirk. "Little too sappy sounding, but I'm glad you see her for her spirit, not for what she is." she happily said before looking at the others.

"And speaking of her spirit, that's why I came to her about Aila, it's growing."

The three took in her words, Yasuko having to raise up their hand to speak up. "Growing?"

"Yes, growing."

"Like, more than before?"

"About the gist of it."

"How much so?"

"Oh my- come on!" Now Toph was getting annoyed that the airbender, nor the others were getting it. "Honei's spirit is growing from that of a regular one to something more... mercyful Raava, this is going to sound corny..." she muttered the last part to herself.

"Something more human, more and more until finally..."

Yet she realized she may have been giving away too much, what she found out by reading the robot's spirit. Toph had to stop herself and focus on matters.

"With her increased spiritual properties, who knows what that tall bundle of joy is capable of." the spirit went in a different direction, pacing around her guests. "But what I do know is that I needed her because she's the only one I know who can help Aila by finding the library."

Hearing that last part, Opal was curious, approaching her grandmother. "Grandma, which library do you speak of?"

"Come on, hasn't your gal pal Jinora told you?" Toph asked, looking around. "Any of you?"

She didn't get any responses, least none of what she wanted upon seeing the group shake their heads. Not that Toph was really surprised.

"Can't say I blame ya', Jinora rarely talks about her visit. Considering WHAT happened."

That mention however got the attention of the two airbenders, the both of them speaking up at the same time. "THE WAN SHI TONG LIBRARY?!"

Just mentioning the name of the library got Yasunori's attention as well.

"You mean that one joint with the owl spirit Aang and the others met?" he began to ask, approaching the formerly blind spirit. "Because from what I know of, the only way to get there is through the Spirit World."

"I'm WELL AWARE, remember that I was there over a hundred years ago, back when the physical entrance sunk into the sands of that spirits-forsaken desert." Toph snarked, but nodded, thankful to know the non-bender wasn't dumb, all while Yasuko approached her.

"While that makes sense, and there's plenty of evidence Honei's been able to meditate and come here on her own-"

"She has?" Opal had to interrupt, which her daughter-in-law sighed, resuming what she was saying.

"That's right. But even if she does find it, there lies an issue once she gets inside."

"Wan Shi Tong himself." Opal revealed, all looking at her as she spoke up. "I remember many years ago, sometime after the Universe War, of Korra and Jinora telling me, Tenzin and the other airbenders about having to avoid going inside the library if they ever encounter it in the Spirit World. That Wan Shi himself forbade anyone from ever entering it again."

"Wait, seriously?" Yasunori had to call out, not getting it as he was just as curious at the elder woman's story. "What for?"

"We don't know, Korra and Jinora never explained what happened during their visit. Just that they were honoring and respecting Wan Shi's wishes."

"But what is known is that some airbenders, as well as others who came into the Spirit World through other means, tried to sneak into the library." Yasuko brought up. "And each time, Wan Shi attacked them, said to be ranting and raving each time someone came in." she revealed, thinking back to one researcher who looked like he had been thrown through the Flames of the Spirit World, scared of his encounter with the large owl spirit.

"Thankfully, he's never killed anyone, but from what eyewitness reports gave us, Wan Shi's mental state has worsened overtime."

"No doubt influenced by his past actions involving Unalaq." Opal made sure to bring that factoid up.

Yet just hearing all of that was enough for Yasunori himself to glare angrily at Toph's spirit, who had been sitting off to the side.

"AND YOU THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO SEND YOUR GREAT-GREAT GRANDDAUGHTER IN THERE ON HER OWN?! THE FUCK'S WRONG WITH YOU?!"

Before he knew it, the stern face of Toph suddenly came right into his, suddenly watching the spirit change from her young teenage self to the more authoritative woman who became police captain and gave birth to her three children.

"YES, I think it's a good one. And nothing is wrong with me, jackass." she shot back, seeing the fear of Raava come into those choco chip brown-eyes of the young man. "I don't care if you're dating Honei, you even so much as mouth off to me again, and I'll shove stone pillars up that tight ass of yours. YOU GOT THAT?!"

All Yasunori could do was just give a scared nod of the head.

Something that pleased Toph who then rubbed her hand through his hair, giving an amusing snicker.

"There we go..."

Still, the plan of the spirit did sound insane, with Yasuko having to try speaking more respectfully.

"Toph, not to sound disrespectful, but if you knew how Wan Shi's been, then why would you even think of sending Honei in there?" she asked, to which the police uniformed spirit turned to the daughter of Korra and Asami, giving her a more calm, restrained look.

"Because even though I've only met Honei twice, I can tell she's different. She's not like the others who were being morons going into where they shouldn't belong. She's selfless, kind, full of heart, she's going there to help Aila against the Hunter."

The second the Hunter was mentioned, the mood grew grim.

"The... Hunter? The Avatar Hunter?" Opal had to ask her grandmother, getting a nod back before Yasuko had to speak, more concerned herself.

"Toph, Aila killed the Avatar Hunter. Took its head clean off with Hattori's katana. That thing is DEAD."

"Is it?"

The ominous tone of Toph's voice sent a nervous chill down Yasuko's spine, enough so the second she blinked, the Grand Lotus was back in her meditation room back in her home, seeing the other two suddenly get out of their meditation, Yasunori back to his injured self.

And like her, they were all confused by what they were just told, all glancing at her.

Before the powerful airbender could try speaking, the door to the room opened and her wife came rushing in as best as she could with her bandages, Varri-phone in hand as both Bolin, Jun and Ryoko followed.

As with one young man who had finally arrived in the area, having finally gotten the chance to come back home.

This was Koji Beifong-Sato, the only son of both Yasuko and Toph, whom he shared the former's eyes and black hair, though he got his lightly tanned skin and height from the anonymous donor used for the artificial insemination process to conceive him, it only known the donor was from the Foggy Swamp.

"Ah, hey, sorry to interrupt, first up, Koji's here. Second, phone call for you, 'Suko." Toph II had to speak up, realizing they had walked onto something important.

"Uh, did we miss something, gang? Also, hello, Koji here to those new around here." Koji himself had to question, dressed in a rather relaxed and casual unbuttoned up shirt, t-shirt, shorts and sneakers.

All Yasuko could do was quickly take the device in hand and kiss her wife's cheek before giving a quick hug to her son, looking at the cautious others.

"Do excuse me." was all she could give in a hurried tone before rushing out of the room, going down the hall, making sure no one was eavesdropping, placing it up to her ear.

"Speak."

"Grand Lotus, it's Agent Kaguya."

The daughter of Korra and Asami felt herself concerned upon hearing her allies' voices, but spoke. "What's up?"

"I got bad news, I'm at a scene pretty far out from Zaofu, almost three hours out. Some hikers stumbled on some bodies, the two agents of ours who took the Hunter's corpse away."

Remembering days before the two agents she, Kaguya and Jun met, the Grand Lotus began dreading for the worst. "And the Hunter?"

"Gone, so's the van."

Feeling pale at the face, the Sato woman began to worry more and more, turning to see Toph and Koji peeking her head out from behind a corner.

But it seemed that her wife's namesake may have been right.

"There's... one other thing that you need to know." Kaguya's voice spoke through the phone as Yasuko listened, giving a small gulp.

"What?"

Far off from the area, the half-spirit agent was at the crime scene, another agent with her checking out the bodies of the two at the scene while cops and other members of law enforcement were trying to keep the media out of sight.

"Word is we have another two murder victims, miles away, found half-naked. A male and a female." she revealed, looking at the one Fire Bender who looked to have had something thrust through his mouth, laying on the ground. "We ID'ed them as Oshii and Luska, both of the Order of The White Lotus."

Kneeling down, now looking at the female whose bones looked to have been broken, blood having pooled out from her mouth, Kaguya saw something pointed out to her silently by the other agent that made her grimace.

"Names that the two bodies in front of me gave us back in Zaofu..."

It was a tattoo on the lower back of the female, that of a red lotus flower.

"They're Red Lotus, aren't they?"

"Card carrying members..." Kaguya answered, not surprised Yasuko already realized it, having heard the fear in her voice, spotting something among the dirt filled space.

"But even stranger, there's four sets of footprints and two sets of tire tracks. Which means a fourth person was here at the same time for sure."

Back in Zaofu, all Yasuko could do was try keeping it in, her fear, not wanting the others to hear it, praying to the spirits for help at this time, hearing Toph come up to her.

"Thank you, Kaguya. I'll check up on this, keep me in contact with any developments."

With that, Yasuko hung up, unable to keep herself up and began shaking her head, realizing the truth.

The hunt was still on, the Red Lotus having an active hand in it.

The Hunter was still after Aila.

"'Suko?"

Before she knew it, Toph felt the arms of Yasuko come around her, starting to tear up once more, realizing something horrible was going on. Leaving Koji to join in to try comforting whom he called his anaana, like his mother did with his grandmother.

At that moment, they didn't know that her wife was scared that she could fail Korra...

... nor know what she was thinking as the leader of the White Lotus wondered something else to herself.

As the sun set by the time the four had gotten back to the village while on the back of Ying-Ling, things were calming down with the businesses, some closing down for the night while others kept open.

From what it looked like with the bordello named The Catfox's Den, it looked to be always open. And business looked to pick up once dusk fell.

Up on top of the sky-bison's saddle, Kuvira watched as the three youngsters got off and began carrying the luggage, just in time for the owner of the establishment to stroll on out.

"Ladies, pleasure to see you come around. I can get some of my workers to carry your luggage to your room, Avatar Aila, Kallah." Zarah offered, ready to snap her fingers to get one of the guards to help out.

The offer was nice, but Kallah herself shook her head. "Oh, it's no problem. Besides, we let Honei do all the heavy lifting."

"It's no problem!" Honei cheerfully called out, easily holding up the two massive suitcases belonging to the two. A sight that amused the glassbender.

"Sweet, cute and strong, the boys must be lining up for you."

"Oh, no one is lining up for me. Besides, I already got a boyfriend." The robot laughed along with the compliment, which the older woman found funny.

Glancing up at Kuvira, the owner put on a smile for her. "Don't worry, Pai. I promise they'll be given the best service... I mean-" Zarah began to correct herself at how that sounded, but the platinum bender got it from where she was.

"I get it, I get it, Zarah."

Saying that, the grandmother looked down at Aila and Kallah, giving a wise smirk. "You two be on your best behavior, I ain't bailing either of you out if you somehow get arrested."

"We'll be fine, Pai, don't worry." Aila promised, Kallah nodding along.

"Yeah, and tomorrow, Aila can resume her training." she added in, which served to make Kuvira happy to hear.

"See you two then." she said before looking at Honei, who now had Quy-Mo resting on her shoulders as she easily carried the luggage in both hands. "I'll be waiting here, Honei."

With that, the grandmother watched the three girls and the crococat be led inside by Zarah the building, leaving her alone with Ying-Ling, Kuvira made sure to rub the sky-bison's head.

She remembered how Honei told her two days prior of being in contact with the original Toph about finding the Wan Shi Library and that something wasn't over.

Also remembering her granddaughter asking Redbear about the springs, as well as seeming pretty focused on it before heading out earlier, Kuvira figured that maybe the underground spot could help her out.

As the platinum bender kept to herself with Ying-Ling for company, Aila, Honei and Kallah were shown around the Catfox's Den by its owner, who made sure to give the girls quite the tour.

"Welcome to the main area, where you can unwind, grab some food, get liquored up and chit-chat." Zarah explained, undoing her hijab to reveal her long, flowing locks of ebony black hair falling down her back. "Do get a good eye of the area..."

The three visitors were surprised at how... orderly and clean the main part looked, with the series of tables, chairs in the middle, a big record player jukebox playing some fun poppy rock music, and a full bar stacked to the brim with many bottles of alcohol.

Even all the customers, both local and out-of-towners who were mostly male with the few female exceptions, were relaxing and taking in the environment, drinking, eating, playing cards, talking it up with some girls.

The workers themselves were certainly eye-catching as there were all sorts of them from different ethnicities and body sizes, none of them being the expected ragged or worn out types you'd associate with their profession.

Something both Aila and Kallah took careful notice of, such as a Fire Nation dancer performing a teasing act on a stage, purposely avoiding showing nudity while firebending at the same time. Something that was kind of alluring to the couple.

"Huh, this is a new kind of fashion..." Honei noted at the sight of one customer being led along by one of the girls wearing pants and a top looking to be made of a see through fabric, exposing her nipples and underwear as gold pieces dangled around the waist.

"Wonder if Yasunori would be into me wearing that."

"Ahh, I don't know if that's your thing or not..." Aila herself commented, trying not to sound condescending before they and Kallah realized the worker was leading her man up some sets of stairs to the second floor.

Something the fire nun had to ask Zarah about.

"That's where the Brothel part happens, right?"

All the glassbender could do was laugh, finding this all too funny. "You'd be correct, my girls conduct their business of the flesh in their rooms." she explained. "But, that's not where you and your Avatar love are staying." she revealed, pointing behind them, showing an entryway leading to a set of stairs going down behind her.

"The rooms for guests only looking for a place to sleep are a floor down, please follow me."

Before they could move, an interesting animal sound came from below, a sweet little yelp as the four looked down.

"Yeap..."

Rubbing against the slipper wearing feet of Zarah was a special looking animal, one that none of her guests had ever seen, Aila the most surprised. 'OHH, what kind of animal is them?" she asked in awe.

The older woman smiled, picking up the lovely pet of hers in her arms, petting its black, orange and white furred head.

"This is my catfox, Sadira. Little beauties like her are actually popular pets around these parts. The hot sun doesn't bother 'em."

Just then, the sound of loud purring was heard, coming from Honei's shoulder, everyone seeing Quy-Mo eyeing the other feline-mix with wide blue eyes.

What none knew was that he remembered seeing the local animal earlier in the day, the same one who caught his attention.

And it seemed that Sadira herself remembered him as well, giving a small yelp of her own, if not as loud.

"Yeap-Yeap?"

Aila couldn't help but find this too cute, taking him into her arms. "Looks like Quy-Mo may have himself a new playmate."

Both the crococat and the catfox were placed on the ground, with the two of them keeping their eyes on each other as they got close.

The scruffy and scaled Quy-Mo was sensing something in the more prim and sleek-looking Sadira, who returned the favor as the two circled around each other, making sounds.

"Mreeow..."

"Yeap-Yeap-Yeap..."

Before anyone knew it, the catfox swiftly ran off, scurrying along the floor past the legs of customers and the girls, going into a small sized hole in the wall. But not without giving the other animal an unknown look with her yellow eyes, giving another small yelp in his direction.

"Yeap-Yeap!"

"That's Sadira's little hiding hole, she likes to play hide and seek." Zarah explained, glancing down at Quy-Mo, who while still watching Sadira slip away, allowed her to get her hand close and pet under his chin, giving a playful tease.

"Good luck, lover boy."

Laughing at the image of her animal companion finding love, Aila was about to request Zarah about resuming the tour, only for a loud ruckus to get everyone's attention.

"Come on, babe, I'm willing to pay."

"I told you, Yasir, I'm just a waitress. And Zarah already barred you from being with any of the girls."

The four looked to see at the front door a waitress, a quite tall and bald headed young woman from one of the Water Tribes, being pestered by four men, one of whom having held some yuan in hand.

The man, a rough looking fellow with freckles and messy black hair, looked rather insulted at the words.

"Hey, in my defense, that broad hit me in the balls, what else was I supposed to do?" he tried to defend himself, which the girl wasn't taking.

"Yeah, after you got too rough with her!"

A sudden hand went across the back of her head hard, the jerk's buddies laughing at what their leader just did to the poor girl. "That rough, huh bitch?" he mockingly asked the hurt worker.

"HEY!"

Just turning in the direction where the loud voice came from, a small mini-tornado had slammed precisely into Yasir's chest, sending him and one of his boys right out the entrance and into the village streets!

Something which Kuvira and Ying-Ling took notice of where they were.

Two of those still inside and the bald girl looked to see it was Aila herself who airbended the troublesome duo out, ready to defend her honor.

"The fuck you do that for?" one called out, only to suddenly realize another girl he didn't know had quickly rushed right in front of him, giving a toothy grin.

"Because your friend was being mean." Honei simply answered before quickly poking both of the guy's eyes with her fingers.

"OWW!"

With the quick distraction, the robot let loose one of her taser hands and pressed it down on the guy's shoulder, shocking him in place as the other patrons watched in surprise.

The fourth remaining guy attempted to use his sandbending to fight back, his hand held out towards the outside of the establishment.

But someone interrupted by a hand grabbing his, one with a greyish colored bracelet around her wrist.

Seeing the look of bewilderment form over his face put a smile on Kuvira's face, the platinum bender easily swinging the punk around to the streets before pointing and waving her hands from her right to the left.

The idiot didn't even take notice of the giant wave of sand she bended coming right at him until it was too late, colliding into him, dropping him down onto his neck!

"Spirits, what did you girls just get into?!" she called out, seeing Aila and Honei come rushing out, the Avatar answering with a sly smirk.

"Just dealing with some jerks, no big deal."

Kallah, having followed them, checked up on the Water Tribe worker's head as did Zarah. "Just a little red, but nothing to worry your pretty little head over." she assured her with a smile.

Something the bald girl returned one with. "Thank you." She kindly spoke, her boss annoyed at those responsible.

"Sweet mother of Kyoshi, why can't that dumb arsehole catch the hint?" Zarah groaned out before patting the girl's shoulder in a motherly manner. "Least you're alright, Lusa."

The man who started this, Yasir, growled in annoyance as he and his last remaining ally both got up, seeing who was responsible. "Oh, well take a look at this! The Avatar and her friends." he complained, a description Honei felt the need to correct.

"Actually, it's the Avatar, her big sister, her girlfriend AND old lady friend!" Honei came up with that last part to hide their relation to Kuvira, who stood by them.

Not caring, both Yasir and his buddy came at the four, only for the latter to suddenly be splashed with water that instantly froze, stopping the freckled man in place.

The others saw it was Kallah who was responsible, having used her waterbending to help out, giving a wise little smirk as she held her water skin at her side.

"Sorry, couldn't help but want in on the fun."

Furious at the realization of being the last one standing, Yasir didn't care who he was coming for, instead coming towards Aila, using his sandbending to give him a boost.

Something the Avatar saw coming, easily using her airbending to allow her to move along the air and dodge a sand slash attack as the others got out of the way.

Seeing her opponent land and glare at her, the great-granddaughter of Suyin Beifong had to grin.

"Gotta say, for my first sandbending opponent, not that impressive."

Hearing the mockful comment only served to enrage the rowdy man who then held out both hands, swirling them around as he created a sand-nado, a large one in the middle of the street that put some civilians on edge as they ran.

Seeing this, Aila should have been concerned and just a bit scared.

But after training with Kuvira and seeing her sandbending in action, she wasn't in the slightest as the sand-nado moved towards her.

Holding her wrist up, the Avatar bended her platinum bracelet into a makeshift shield to cover her face as she braced herself for impact. While feeling the coarse grains of sand hit her exposed skin did sting just a bit, Aila wasn't showing weakness as she moved her free hand around.

Doing so allowed her to bend a small gust of wind to blow away the sand hitting her, causing it to pelt the still incapacitated frozen thug who yelled out in pain.

"OWW! OW! KNOCK IT OFF!"

As the fight went on, Kuvira made sure to get Honei and Kallah back inside from the craziness, getting near both Zarah and Lusa, the owner of the catfox's den having to glance at the older woman.

"Avatar Aila looks to be playing with her food."

"Somewhat," the platinum bender commented, looking at her. "Her bending was blocked for a bit, she's trying to get back into the groove of things."

Before she could turn away, something caught Kuvira's attention about the brothel owner, only noticeable because her hijab wasn't on.

As her hair moved along, it revealed a black inked tattoo on the back of Zarah's sun kissed neck.

It was small, but she knew the image of a lotus flower from anywhere.

As for Aila, she was more focused on messing with the increasingly angry Yasir, using her bending to avoid and block his attacks instead of trying to hurt him.

The more she did so, the more furious the sandbender was getting until he had enough.

"DAMN IT, JUST FIGHT ME, YOU SMUG BITCH!"

Landing in place from using her firebending as a boost to jump over a big wave of sand, Aila just gave a smirk worthy of Korra herself.

"You wanted me to fight you? Why didn't you say so?"

With the greatest of ease, Aila held her wrists out, shooting forth both kinds of metal from her bracelets, wrapping around the guy's waist like tentacles to his confusion.

Then with a quick tug and pull, she brought him in close enough for her to jump up and deliver a quick roundhouse kick to the face.

In turn, the force of the kick sent Yasir flying right towards where a nearby truck was, the back cab being filled with manure that was to be sold to local farmers...

... and it was right into the foul smelling material that the thug landed face first in, knocking him out.

Seeing this, Aila just smiled as the other women came up to her, seeing her clap her hands at the job well done. "Honestly, I wasn't aiming for him to land there, it just happened." she bragged while hearing two of the other thugs all groaning out in pain.

"Looks like all that training has been paying off." Kuvira commented, putting aside what she saw about Zarah, pleased to finally see her granddaughter properly fight as Kallah hugged and kissed her love.

"And then some."

"It's funny because he got thrown into manure." Honei laughed about, which did some chuckles from the others, turning to her grandma.

"How do you feel after bending?"

That got her a calm ruffle of her hair from Kuvira, who was happy to see the robot care for her well being, seeing that Aila was thinking the same thing as well. "Relax, I'm fine. The ol' ticker's working how it should be."

As soon as she said that, she and the others all heard some hurried footsteps coming at them.

It was the one whom Honei used her taser hand on, back on his feet and rushing at the group with a wooden chair in hand as a weapon.

A gesture that was swiftly put on hold as he tried to stop and pump the brakes upon realizing something that the others just took notice of.

That he was about to run neck first into a thin glass needle that Zarah bended and held in her hand, seeing him stop just shy of skin contact as she eyed him with those alluring green eyes in a rather angry manner.

"Good boy. Now tell Yasir and the rest of your buddies that you four are now officially BANNED from my establishment." she ordered, seeing him drop his weapon in fear at needle point.

"And if I even so much see any of you stand near the front door, I swear to fucking Raava, I'll jam a few of these up some VERY uncomfortable places. Kay?"

Taking heed, the thug ran off, leaving the brothel owner to snigger to herself, looking at the others as she unbended her weapon, feeling embarrassed.

"All these interruptions." she let out, bending and superheating the glass away as she tried getting back to business.

"Now, let me finally show the Avatar and her girl their room."

Notes:

How was this chapter, kiddies? Another one focused mostly on Aila, Kuvira and their group's end as they check out Redbear's spirit-blessed springs, which does get Honei's attention, as with them meeting back up with Zarah at her establishment where we get ourselves a fight between our heroes and some jerkass costumers, with Zarah herself showing she's just as deadly as well with her glassbending. And Quy-Mo and the others get to properly meet the catfox he spotted, Sadira, who happens to be owned by Zarah... who's not fooled by the way Quy-Mo looks at Sadira.

Though we do also get into more of what Toph has to share with Yasuko, Yasunori and Opal. About not just Honei's own growing and increasingly powerful Spirit, but needing her to go into Wan Shi Tong's library to try finding something there to help Aila against Wolf. Of course, there's still the issues of Wan Shi Tong himself since... well, LOK Book Two and how he's closed off the library from any visitors due to reasons relating to him siding with Unalaq. And YES, I know in the Avatar Legends RPG, he's more open to people and its technically canon, I'm not counting anything from the tabletop RPG as a part of these fics, which are clearly non-canon anyway. Less to look up and add in, if anything.

But back to Wolf, as the trio come back from the Spirit World, they, Yasuko especially, finds out that Wolf is back on the loose... but also, another visitor has arrived, KOJI BEIFONG-SATO, Yasuko and Toph's son as well as the grandson of Korra and Asami as with Bolin and Opal! While he's part isn't the biggest, he does have some role in this Book and the next, being inspired by Val Kilmer's character from "Real Genius", a super genius a couple years older than Aila who's more lax and free-spirited.

As for next chapter, half is focused back on Wolf interacting with Sun, Meiying and Fung back at their place, having his little break from hunting Aila down and Honei herself deciding to make a visit to the library...

Chapter 23: Chapter Twenty Three- Alone in the Library

Notes:

Hello dear readers, another new batch of "Seven Havens" episodes tomorrow, what will happen? And what wlll happen this chapter of "Rise of Aila"? Who's to say, let's find out!

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words and some brief partial nudity.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

"I hope you like this dish, Mr. Wolf..."

Hearing that said to him, Wolf sat at the dinner table, seeing the bowl of noodles in front of him, as were smaller ones of veggies, what looked like fried breaded pieces of fish and fried eggs, complete with a set of chopsticks.

Sun smiled as she set down the bowl as well as three more, all while both Meiying and Fung all sat at the table, awaiting the meal.

"Trust me when I say our cook is really good." The aide spoke highly, which the ten-year old smiled at where she sat with her stuffed animal in hand, speaking to him.

"Rabbit, rabbit."

"Yes, you are quite the cook."

Wolf looked up from the rather good smelling food to look at the three. "Your daughter made this?" he asked Sun, who gave a friendly look as she sat down next to it.

"Yes, with my help of course." she proudly said, looking at her daughter proudly. "Princess Meiying is an amazing chef, she can give even some of the best ones in town a run for their yuan."

"Kitty..."

She spoke the animal's name to her guest, seeing him look at her, holding up her chopsticks. "Kitty... t... th... tha..."

"Come on, you can do it." Fung encouraged Meiying, who kept trying to speak, which Wolf watched her put in the effort.

"... Tha... Kitty!"

Somehow, the being was figuring the girl was trying to thank him, seeing her seem annoyed at herself for being unable to speak.

So instead, he just nodded along, speaking back with a smile that came rather easily this time around.

"You're welcome, Meiying."

Seeing how Wolf seemed to get what her daughter was trying to say, Sun took a small bottle of soy sauce in hand, pouring some in Meiying's dish after putting some meat and veggies in. "Surprised you picked up on her so easily." she pointed out, the Hunter nodding along.

"Does she... have issues with speaking?" he asked, if a little forward.

Not that Meiying herself cared as her mother and aide listened, Fung nodding as he stirred the contents of his bowl. "Yes and no, but she's been getting better." he answered as respectfully as he could. "Meiying, with the way she was born-"

"Autistic?"

"Yes, her brain operates in its own way, different from others. There's different spectrum's to it, some higher than others, if you will." Fung described, having been working with others like his young friend, who was eating up her dinner, acting out giving some to Yippy.

Still, to Sun, it didn't matter as Meiying was her daughter. "Far as I'm concerned, regardless of what others say, I see nothing wrong with her. She's my little princess and I love her." she smiled, laughing at her daughter eating as the two watched her.

Wolf himself was actually amazed to know how this child was mentally, thinking back more to the two men he punched for their cruel words.

She didn't seem stupid or whatever hurtful word they said to insult her, Meiying was just different than others.

Getting a good look at her, the unkillable did take note of how Meiying looked to be a year or two older than the daughter of Iko's.

"Kitty?" said young girl seemed to ask Wolf, who looked at Fung, the man knowing very well what she meant.

"With Meiying's limited speech, she refers to everyone by the names of animals that she thinks suits them. I'm Rabbit, her mother is Dove. And you're... uh, Kitty. A rather odd one if I may say so."

Realizing where this could possibly go, especially upon seeing the looks both adults were giving, as well as the curious one the child gave, Wolf remembered how he acted with that Toad guy...

... before remembering the kind catdeer he encountered, freeing it of the pain inflicted by those hunters.

"I like cats. Including catdeers." the Hunter offered as a possible excuse.

"So, why exactly are you referred to as Wolf?" Fung politely asked. "Is that some sort of nickname, like you're embarrassed of your first name."

Much as he tried to offer some answer, thoughts of all those fought and killed in the name of Vaatu then filled Wolf's head, to get at both Avatar's Ho-Seok and Aila...

... before the sights of his host's family being slaughtered.

"I'd rather not talk about it." the long-living man simply answered with.

For some reason, an unfamiliar feeling surged through Wolf's mind, right as the burning in his heart began to surge...

... but it all stopped upon feeling its hand be grabbed by a smaller one.

Not expecting that, Wolf saw that, as well as Sun and Fung, Meiying having gotten out of her chair, came up to him and grabbed one of his hands.

For some reason, feeling his hand be held, as well as the focused look of the ten-year old seemed to make the burning go away.

Just like when Meiying first grabbed it.

"Kitty..." she spoke once more, before pointing at the chest

Right where his heart was, not knowing of the marking hidden under the shirt.

"... Kitty."

Sun and Fung looked to understand what Wolf was trying to get at, the mother speaking. "I think she believes that you're like a big ol' stray cat, going from place to place." she softly spoke at what she figured was proven right, holding Wolf's other hand as well.

That too sent another sensation along its body, one that the being knew was the same as earlier.

"Just trying to find a good way to live."

"And if you don't wish to go into details, that's fine." Fung assured who he saw as someone with a bad past. "We're just all thankful you two helped us earlier."

Hearing that, Wolf seemed to feel like his mind was at ease, wondering what this feeling was...

This good feeling.

"You're free to spend the night here, if you don't already have a place to stay I mean. Maybe longer if you so wish, we don't mind having another helping hand around the house." Sun offered, which...

... Wolf actually seemed to consider it.

Even more so when it's need to hunt down Avatar Aila kept fading away.

"Thank you..."

Saying that seemed to please the three humans as they all went back to their dinners, the oddly relaxed Hunter chose to finally eat the meal before him.

And Wolf had to admit, noodles with Elephant Koi and vegetables were actually quite tasty, especially with soy sauce.

Once more, it was almost midnight.

After helping get the luggage for Aila, Kallah and Quy-Mo set at that nice Zarah's place, Honei ventured back to their grandmother's home with her and Ying-Ling.

After getting her sky-bison friend settled down for the night, saying she loved her, as well as remembering she already called Yasunori in the morning before hearing into the village, the robot spent some time listening to the radio with Kuvira as they both snacked on some treats and had some tea.

Even with all the craziness within the past few days as well as what happened with those punks, the kind-hearted robot found simply listening to the local music station relaxing.

This was truly a time for Honei to be happy, knowing that she had another grandmother who loved her as much as her mother's own parents.

Once Kuvira was sound asleep however, Honei knew she had to get to business, sneaking out without making a sound as best as she could.

Passing by a resting Ying-Ling while with a dry towel in hand, she ventured forth towards Redbear's property, making sure the nice old man was also asleep.

Seeing her chance, she ventured towards the rock covered entry into the underground springs, hearing with each step, the sounds of water running and moving growing louder.

Making it inside, the beautiful location before her seemed almost vast compared to last time, on the count of being alone.

Still, Honei knew she had to try this out.

"Alright Honei, remember what Aunt Lin told you. Just let my mind, body and soul clear up on its own." she whispered to herself, whispering as to not alert anyone.

Thinking of how Redbear mentioned using the springs helped clear his thoughts of anything bad in him, the robot began to undo what pajama attire she had on.

Once in what would be considered the nude, the human-looking creation decided it was now or never, slowly tipping her toes in the water.

Shockingly, the water wasn't cold or freezing, but warm and soothing.

The fact that she knew it was quite the surprise, the sense of touch growing on her.

The way the temperature was plenty surprised her as well, seeing as there didn't look to be a source of heat. Least not one that was noticeable to the naked eye.

Still, it was welcoming as Honei began entering the pool before her, letting herself sink in until she was laying against the side of the water filled space, enough that it was up to her nose.

Thankfully, being what she was and how she was made, she didn't have to worry about drowning or her circuits getting hit by the water going through her mouth.

Once mostly submerged, that was when a wonderful sensation began to fill herself, something relaxing and familiar, feeling the urge to close her jade eyes.

As she did, that voice the metal girl heard earlier spoke once more in her ears, the words repeating...

"Clear your mind, Honei, let it engulf you..."

The sensation grew in her, growing more and more wonderful before finally, something compelled Honei to open her eyes.

"... Welcome back."

All to see for herself that she had once more traversed into the Spirit World, seeing that she was back where she last spoke with the spirit of Lin Beifong.

With the Wan Shi Library way up ahead, still upside down and covered in vines.

The curious girl looked around, smiling as she saw small flying spirits of different forms buzz around her in wonder.

"It worked, it actually worked. I finally got meditation down!" she cheered, jumping around in place with her hands up. "WOO! I MEDITATED!"

In her cheering of joy, Honei was left distracted from the obvious that the friendly spirits had noticed, a dragonfly bunny spirit having to wave its paw at her, getting her attention

"Wait, what are you trying to tell me?" she asked.

Seeing the small paw seem to point down at her, the robot looked down and felt her entire face go red upon realizing she was completely in the nude, giving an embarrassed scream.

"AAHHH!"

Trying to use her hands and arms to cover up her modesty, the nervous girl felt so awkward, especially upon realizing that since she had stripped off her clothes and entered the pool of water back in the spring's nude.

So by extension, that meant the spirit form her soul had taken was just as in the buff as she was.

Looking around, all Honei could do was look at the friendly glowing spirit. "Please tell me there's a place that can lend me some clothes, yes?" she asked, getting a chirp and shrug back in return.

"Chirp..."

"Here's some..."

A lightly tanned hand then held out what seemed like nicely folded green and silver clothes to the tall girl, who accepted them without much complaint.

"OH, thank you..." Honei began smiling only to realize the figure who just helped spoke with the same voice that she kept hearing.

Turning, Honei couldn't believe it, realizing who she was in the presence of, yet another familiar face from her family's past.

But it wasn't Lin nor Toph, but someone more closer, her young face smiling with her tanned skin tone just a bit more lighter than hers.

There before the robot was the spirit of her great-grandmother, looking to be around the young adult age that Honei passed off as.

"You're welcome, Honei. Now you may wanna put those on." Suyin Beifong tried to hold in her bemused laugh, seeing the girl who was made in the image of her late descendant realize she was still naked and hurriedly put the clothes on.

After a quick moment, Honei's spirit was now clad in a simple, but cute green sleeveless dress with silver outlines that looked to fit her nicely, as with some underwear.

That done with, the robot glanced back at the spirit of the woman who had found her family's home, was her grandfather's mother, took her grandmother in and so many other things that the robot had read about.

"Great-Grandma Suyin?"

"I also accept Grandma Su." the smiling spirit offered, looking Honei over, seeing her in the clothes that were like those she wore back in her younger years. "Amazing to see how close you are to your human self."

Just being told that caught the amazed robotic girl by surprise. "Wait, you've met the original Honei?" she had to ask, getting that sly smile everyone knew of from the co-founder of Zaofu.

"Of course, she's family. I've got to meet my grandson Bataar again, your mother. Everyone in our family who has passed on, I've met."

This was just so amazing for Honei to learn, having not given this encounter a possibility as Suyin took her hand into her own.

"Heck, you two actually resemble me back in my teenage years."

And now that she heard that, Honei realized it for herself.

"WOAH, no kidding... wonder if my mother realized that while making me." she commented before hearing the sounds of small footsteps come close to the two.

Looking down, Honei felt whatever resembled her heart melt in pure happiness upon who she saw was coming up to her.

"MR. FUZZY!"

Indeed, the stuffed sky-bison toy of hers that was given spiritual life years before wanted to see his friend again, giving a small wave, to which got him picked up, being given a big hug from his friend.

"It's been so long, how've you been?"

"Fine, Honei. I see you've finally gotten down meditation like you wanted." he spoke in the same exact gruff voice Honei used to make whenever she made him speak.

"I have. It took me a bit, had let my mind relax and calm down in this nice man's springs."

"Sounds lovely..."

"It is. The guy, Redbear, is also a friend of Grandma Kuvira."

"We know, that's why she told you to use it, so we can meet up with you here." Mr. Fuzzy revealed, which caught Honei by surprise, something Suyin noted.

"Yes, you're close to heading to Wan Shi Tong's library and we knew if anything could help you..."

The implication did make a whole lot of sense to the awestruck robot as her great-grandmother's spirit took the stuffed animal spirit into her arms.

"And we're here to make sure you get there to find something to help your little sister out against the Hunter." she explained, which Honei now felt confusion towards.

"But she killed him, we all saw it happen." she pointed out.

But the looks of friendliness turned to that of somber worry.

Mr. Fuzzy had to break the news, feeling bad. "No it's not, the Hunter still lives and is still tracking Aila down." he revealed, seeing the look of worry form on the robot's face.

"That's why my mother had come to you, to try warning you and Aila." Suyin had to tell her, feeling bad for not telling her sooner. "But you kept being dragged back to your world cause you didn't get meditation right."

All of this was quite revealing, Honei feeling nervousness in her spirit and soul as she listened, taking it in.

Even then, something still didn't make sense.

"But why me? Why didn't any of you tell Aila? Opal, Yasuko? Any of them..." she tried to offer what she saw as better options, seeing them better than herself that is.

"... I'm... I'm just a robot, one who only now managed to figure out meditation."

"You're more than that."

The words of Mr. Fuzzy got her attention, seeing her friend move his little fuzzy arms around as he kept speaking.

"Honei, when we first met, you didn't just see me as a prize you won at a videobox arcade, you saw me as a living being. Someone you cared for so much for only a couple days, as much as your mother and Aila care for you. As well as your friends and family."

"Not just that, but when you placed Mr. Fuzzy in your mother's casket to protect her, your love and care for him gave him life here in the Spirit World." Suyin spoke fondly, wanting her to hear what she had to say.

"Because you hold more spiritual prowess than you realize, almost as much as Aila and Yasuko. Making you practically human in your own way. And it's your love and care for everything that will help Aila against the Hunter, to find its weakness in the library."

Honei couldn't believe how much was being rested on her, that what she was happened to be the key.

Looking at herself, she wondered as she tried to press the spot behind her ears to open her metal skull up, only for nothing to happen, as with trying to engage her taser hands.

Still, she had to ask another thing.

"Are you positive that I got this?"

"Of course we do..."

That familiar voice made Honei realize the three weren't alone, looking around to see watching the scene wasn't just the spirits of her mother, father and her human self, but also Bataar Jr., Toph, Lin, Hattori and the rest of the Beifong clan who had passed away at this point.

All here to give the robot's spirit their support.

"You're a Beifong, as well as a Makimura..." Asuka kept speaking highly of her daughter, with her husband standing proudly at her side, with the spirit of her birth daughter approaching her second life.

"...We know you have this."

Having to give a smile, the brave robot turned to the direction which led to the massive building ahead of her and began running her way towards it.

As the spirits of the Beifong's and Mr. Fuzzy vanished from the area, the only ones left were that of Suyin, Bachu, Asuka and the first Honei...

"You sure it'll happen? Nothing will go wrong for her, grandma?" Bachu had to ask the young spirit form of his grandmother, who nodded with a sure look.

"Once she goes in and does her deed, it'll be time. She's earned it."

Something the two, as well as the mother and daughter all knew was bound to happen.

It took this long, it was bound to happen.

After what seemed like ten minutes of walking, the robot stopped and looked her jade eyes up.

From what she saw of drawings in the Western Air Temple, she was looking at the Wan Shi Tong library.

The place looked to be in not the best of condition, seeing the cracks on the foundation, as well as patches of vines and plants looking to overgrow it over the years.

Thinking to herself, Honei tried to come up with an idea how to get up there. "How Jinora managed to get up there on her own, I don't know..." she spoke to herself before trying to think of an idea.

Looking at her hands, one idea began to form as she ran up to one of the tree's seeming to hold it up and felt it's wood with her fingertips.

Praying it'd work, the tan skinned gynoid pressed her fingers against it, suddenly feeling her fingers stab into the old wood.

Realizing that she still carried some of her robotic strength in the Spirit World, Honei grinned, pleased with this outcome.

Reaching up her other hand to stab her fingers in tightly, she steadied herself with her feet that she pressed against it.

Her plan set, she began to climb up the tree at a slow, but brisk pace, being careful of what was on it or lived on its branches.

The more she climbed, the closer the library was getting, as well as the sight of the property damage from what looked like years of not being kept in check.

As she kept climbing, Honei began singing a small tune to herself to keep herself in check, especially upon feeling a sense of nervousness with getting closer to the building.

"When I first laid my eyes on you, I felt something special… The one who draws my soul, with a special smile like a deja vu..." ("Starry eyes" Na'Mon from Outlanders)

Seeing for herself a small gap to a thick branch with one of the oversized vines in the middle of it, Honei knew what she had to do next as she pulled one of her hands out and reached out to the vine.

Grasping a handful of it, she carefully moved herself onto it, gripping onto it for dear life, but not too much to break it, leaving her hanging up in the air.

Yet she still had to get to the branch, which upon closer inspection, she saw would lead her to a window opening in one of the towers.

Remembering the old movers she and Yasunori watched alongside Aila and Kallah for a double date night, one popped up from her database of the guy who was raised by the animals of jungles into a jungle man, swinging around by the vines, traversing the trees with ease.

Having to motivate herself into swinging the vine around back and forth, Honei kept singing to herself as she did so...

"Please hold me, I'll kiss you sweetly…"

The more she swung the vine, the faster the speed was picking up, ready to give her more distance.

Feeling this was going great, Honei sang louder, prepared to let go at the right time, to land on the branch.

"... Love me forever, tonight tonight tonight!"

Swinging herself back enough, the robot felt the momentum as she swung towards the branch, choosing then to let go, ready to grab on and land on the branch...

... only to realize as she flung herself through the air that she misjudged it and saw the branch pass by below her, all while her eyes went wide as she looked to see herself begin to fall.

Even more so when Honei saw herself about to collide into the brick wall of the tallest upside tower of the library.

"Ohh SHIT!" she screamed out, only able to hold her arms over her face as defense as she slammed against the old stone, feeling herself smash through it!

Something the robot certainly felt the pain of due to her spirit form, but that was swiftly pushed to the side when in mid-air, she felt herself spin about in place due to being inside.

Another realization came forth when Honei instantly felt herself drop down due to the topsy-turvy gravity, falling straight down towards the ground from the high height.

The floor was coming closer and closer as she screamed louder...

"AAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!"

... only to suddenly feel nothing.

"AAAAaaaahhhh…"

Still screaming out, even as she opened her eyes, Honei slowly calmed down upon seeing she had stopped only two feet up in the air.

"Ah?"

Looking around, seeing herself hover in place, that confused the robot before suddenly feeling herself drop that last two feet, only now feeling the slight pain.

"... ow..."

Giving a deep breath, Honei slowly got up and gave a look around, seeing the vast space before her.

There was no doubt about it, she was within the Wan Shi Tong library now.

Looking on with awe on her face, she got up on her feet, brushing the spirit dirt off her arms, seeing how huge the place looked with the extensive tile work all over, the owl theme of the pillars obvious from the walk ways she was on, seeing how deep the place went.

What got her attention however was...

... how wrong it looked.

The place looked less like somewhere that held so much knowledge and wonder, and more like a haunted house now.

Barely any light shined in the area and whatever did only served to show how grim and lifeless the place looked now, cobwebs and vines adorning the inside of the place all over.

The robot was not aware of what happened after Unalaq and Vaatu's defeat, nor had knowledge of what the library protector was up to since, but there was a sense of eeriness Honei felt in her spirit form.

Still, she had to look for whatever held the Hunter's weakness, or maybe why she was becoming more and more human. Whichever came first really.

Either way, Honei began to walk along the dark library by herself, keeping her eyes and ears out as she began to call out to anyone listening.

"Hello? Wan Shi? Anyone here?... Yello?"

Her questions were only met with the echoes of her voice traveling through the emptiness, seeming to fade out more and more.

That however didn't worry the robot, who knew regardless if she could find the owl spirit or not, she had to find what she was looking for.

Even then, it would surely take an unknown amount of time shifting through the long rows of shelves that held so much information.

Time she really didn't have, not just because of the Hunter still tracking her sister down, but because Honei knew from experience what would happen if her soul was separated from her body in the real world.

Approaching one stack of scrolls laid about on a table, all the robot could do was give a loud sigh.

"Why couldn't Wan Shi have cleaned up this mess?" she commented before looking at similar looking spots with just as much clutter.

"Or at least alphabetize things."

Going over towards the first shelf she saw, Honei went to reach forth at the first scroll handle she saw.

As she went to grab it, her finger tips close to it, something breezed by her leg.

On instinct, the human looking robot turned around as quickly as she could, looking around for whatever did that. But she saw nothing, which was weird.

Even more so when she swore whatever it felt furry.

Choosing to ignore it, Honei went back to grab the scroll, only for a new sound to be heard.

"Yelp-yelp?"

One that sounded out of place as she was quicker to turn around this time, able to see having been behind her was a brown furred fox looking creature with a patch of lighter fur on its belly.

It's bright blue eyes shined on without any pupils, giving Honei it's full attention as she smiled out in delight.

"OHH, you are so cute!" she beamed out, kneeling in front of the spirit and holding a closed fist out, as to not provoke it. And to her joy, the animal gave a small yelp of curiosity, licking her hand with its tongue.

"Yelp!"

And to even more of her surprise, the robot felt the wetness of each lick, it feeling funny and making her chuckle.

Just then, it registered in her memory bank just what she was interacting with. "OH, I know. You're a Knowledge Seeker spirit, aren't you little buddy?" Honei asked, getting another kind yelp in return.

"YELP!"

"Oh man, this is so awesome! Can't wait to tell Aila I met one of you." she beamed back, being able to pet the fuzzy ears of the spirit. "I'm sorry I don't have any treats on me, kind of didn't cross my mind truth be told."

Even though she considered it amazing to meet such a spirit, Honei had to get back to business. "Hey, maybe you can find me something on the Avatar Hunter?" she asked politely.

Before the spirit could respond, something else was heard. It was far off, but the robot was able to pick up on it, the sound of movement.

As did the knowledge seeker whose ears perked up, looking in one direction before giving a small whine. But Honei wasn't scared.

"Oh, wonder if that's Wan Shi Tong himself... Hum, well, if he finds me, then I can talk to him." she shrugged off, standing back up and looking back at the scroll. "Till then, you can-"

The paws of the knowledge seeker began to be held up and pressed against her side, the spirit's whining growing louder as was its yelping.

"Yelp! Yelp-yelp!"

"Hey, it's okay, I'm not here for anything evil or mean." Honei tried to assure the concerned spirit and get him to relax. "I'm just-"

"Who dares enter my library?"

The voice was loud and booming, enough to echo all over the library all at once, catching both Honei and the knowledge seeker's attention before what sounded like hopping was heard.

It was hard to pinpoint where it was coming from.

Before the kind robotic being could ask if it was who she thought it was, the knowledge seeker gave a frightened whimper and ran off, leaving her alone.

"Hey, little buddy! Come back!" she called out, confused as to why the spirit was scared. "He's your boss, it should be cool!"

The second she spoke those words, the flapping of wings was heard, big ones.

Following that was the loud landing made right behind Honei, causing her to turn around to see the spirit she had been looking for...

... or something that ONCE resembled the majestic looking owl spirit that was keeping his blackened eyes focused right at who he was seeing was another human.

"Yet another human, correct?" Wan Shi Tong himself asked of his unwanted guest, she herself seeing how mangy and dirty he looked, feathers constantly shedding with each move he made, his head crooking as he leaned closer with those black eyes.

Getting close enough to where the amazed Honei's face was to his old beak, the owl spirit uncrooked.

He knew something was different about this visitor.

"No, you're not human. But not spirit either... Something in-between?"

Somehow not afraid, the robot nodded. "You are correct, Mr. Wan Shi Tong, sir. I'm... I'm not human, I'm a robot."

"A robot?"

"Yes, a being made of metal, wires and a lot of computer parts, giving me life. You can also call me a gynoid if you want."

"Are you like a radio?"

Unable to keep in a laugh at being compared to a radio, of all things, Honei had to snigger at that. "I mean, if you wanna be funny about it." she played along, only to see the owl spirit wasn't laughing, instead just moving on.

"But yeah, I'm a robot, ta-da..."

The large spirit moved around the girl to look her over, his neck turning in a hundred and eighty degree way, keeping his face pointed at her. "Must admit, I never heard of such a thing throughout my existence."

That observation did get the tall girl curious. "Really? What about the platinum colossus my grandmother helped get made? You know, Kuvira?"

"How could a being not of flesh and blood have family?" Wan Shi questioned back, his mind focused elsewhere.

Something the robotic girl felt a little nervous to talk about, rubbing her arm. "It's... a long story. But I have a mommy, a daddy and two sisters, one of whom is the Avatar."

"I wasn't aware Korra had a sibling."

Okay, that was starting to raise some flags for Honei, who looked around the area.

"Ah, no. I'm not related to Korra, I'm talking about Avatar Aila. The one after Korra." she had to correct the owl spirit before looking back at him, curious.

"Wan Shi, what year do you think it is?"

Before he could answer, something was heard falling into the ground, catching the owl spirits' ears as he swiftly turned in the direction, letting his large wings out.

"WHO'S THERE?! WHO DARE INTRUDES!?" he growled out, the look of anger quickly forming through its eyes and brows.

Honei, trying to calm him down, went in front of him. "Wan Shi, relax! It's just a book that fell on the ground, look!" she pointed out, holding her hand towards where indeed a book fell on the stone ground.

Watching Wan Shi relax, if on edge, the girl was realizing she had to be careful. "Wan Shi, I'm in need of your library's help, I was sent-"

"NO NO NO!" The spirit yelled out, the look of madness clear in his eyes, looking to actually scare the robot.

"I KNEW IT, I KNEW IT! Your real self was masked by another spiritbender, to hide your humanity! THAT'S WHY I COULDN'T FIGURE YOU OUT AT FIRST!"

Holding her hands up, Honei was now growing more and more concerned as she tried to be as peaceful as she could.

"Mr. Wan Shi, please, I mean no harm!" she tried to convince him, slowly backing away. "You have to understand, my sister is in danger and I was told to come here!"

Yet her pleas were going unheard, the size of the owl spirit growing larger as his mind was growing more unhinged as Wan Shi hopped towards her.

"BY THIEVES! THOSE WHO SEEK TO USE ME, WHAT MY LIBRARY HOLDS, PLAY ME LIKE A FOOL LIKE THAT BASTARD UNALAQ! YOU CAN'T FOOL ME, HUMAN!" he ranted out loudly, turning his head all over his library. "ALL YOU HUMANS ARE THE SAME, USING MY KNOWLEDGE AND BEING SELFISH WITH IT, USING IT FOR YOUR OWN GAIN!"

The more scared Honei grew, the more she noticed some more knowledge seekers seeming to hide away from their mad master behind shelves as he kept calling out.

"THAT'S WHY I HAVEN'T HAD MY SEEKERS FIND KNOWLEDGE FROM YOUR WORLD, BECAUSE YOU ALL WILL JUST USE IT FOR YOUR TWISTED FANTASIES ANYWAY!"

The robot tried to be brave, to convince the spirit of the truth. "But you're wrong, I'm-"

"I already told Avatar Korra and Jinora that humans are banned from my library, even if they offer something new in return, I won't allow it!" Wan Shi revealed, shaking his head before giving an unnerving laugh.

"Hehehe... But OF COURSE, no one listens, I've had many try sneaking in, to steal the contents of this library..."

That being said, he then looked back at who he saw was another lying human, now giving a low, disturbing cackle before making things crystal clear.

"... and like so many trespassers before you, I'll personally escort you out myself."

His words were the only warning Wan Shi Tong gave Honei before thrusting his open beak out at her as he roared out, trying to attack her.

Yet the scared robot was able to be quick on her feet, jumping out of the way, seeing the mad spirit snap his head towards her.

"GET OUT OF MY LIBRARY!" he screamed out, rushing towards her, his massive wingspan out for her to see as she began turning tail and ran for dear life, hearing the tapping of his talons following her.

"NOW!"

Notes:

And the chapter be done! Yes, a mixture of calm breather with Wolf getting to know Sun and Meiying as well as Fung. Obviously this is a new situation for him... but Wolf looks to be getting along with them, able to understand Meiying's limited way of speaking. Of course, he gives just enough false stories when they ask about him, but Wolf seems to... enjoy their company and vice versa. And obviously, this time around, its just Wolf in control, this "Iko" doesn't take over and talk to them... which does lead to some interesting ideas...

And then there's Honei who's on her own adventure into the Spirit World, to that of Wan Shi Tong's library to find the weakness of the Avatar Hunter. And she gets there via bathing in the Spirit Springs that Redbear protects... and has a brief awkward nude moment before she gets new clothes... thanks to the young looking spirit of Suyin Beifong, her great-grandmother, amazed to meet her and reunite with the Spirit Mr. Fuzzy. All to help give her motivation for her quest as other members of her late family abd the Beifong clan is there for her as she heads forth...

... and she DOES manage to find and get inside the library which has... seen better days. Like I said last chapter, I'm not taking the tabletop RPG and anything with Wan Shi Tong in it as Canon here, so things be concerning when Honei encounters not just the spirit seekers, but also Wan Shi himself. Again, hes seen better day, with his long standing paranoia due to his knowledge being used by bad guys warping his cracked mind... and now Honei has to deal with an spirit who sees her as a threat.

Asuka Makimura- Grey Griffin
