Chapter 27: Chapter Twenty Seven- Five Days

Notes:

Got ourselves an anthology chapter of sorts of Rise of Aila, so give it a good read!

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, including some slurs as well as some implied sex.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Monday...

"So, dreaming when I sleep is weird."

"How so?"

"It's like mover's in your mind where you feel like you're acting stuff out, but then it goes all weird and wonky..." Honei described as she laid down on the couch in Kuvira's hut, her head against a pillow as she held her Varri-Phone to her ear.

She was alone while Aila, Kallah and Kuvira were at the local produce marketplace.

"... but also real at the same time, they can either go good or bad. And then, suddenly, you wake up and realize none of it was real."

The laughter she heard from the other line filled her ears, then hearing her boyfriend's voice speak up.

"Dreams are pretty crazy. Sometimes, I'd have a cool one where all of us are somehow back during Korra's time and kicking ass alongside her, and then I have nightmares where I'm at school and stuck only in my boxers."

Now it was the young woman's turn to find that funny, give a cute giggle at what Yasunori described, finding it humorous.

"Can't say I've had a dream like any of those yet." Honei snickered, before smiling. "But it is fun, though I'm still getting used to actually trying to sleep. Have to get, at best, eight hours of sleep."

"But sometimes, it's fun to sleep in, even if it's like ten in the morning?" she heard her boyfriend ask, laughing along.

"OH, totally."

Thinking to herself, all of this seemed so fantastic to the now-human as she rolled to her side, watching Quy-Mo chase around a stray sand rat all over the floor of the hut, intent on having lunch.

One thing came to mind.

"I remember reading something at the Fire Sanctuary's library about how it's theorized that dreams are like visions into other universes. Seeing what other versions of yourself are doing at the same time." she brought up, giving it thought.

"Thinking that, makes me wonder if what I saw in my dreams are happening in other universes."

'WOAH... That's pretty mind blowing." Yasunori spoke up, realizing how insightful that sounded. "And considering the Universe War, that makes so much sense."

"Yeah..." Honei said, now wondering if there was a universe where she had never been created, that the girl she was made after never died, nor her father. Maybe Kuvira could have connected with her son sooner, protected them, the world would know sooner they were Beifong's...

... and possibly, she would have never met Yasunori or any of the rest of her friends.

"Honei, you there?"

Hearing her boyfriend ask that, the possibilities just stuck with Honei as she answered. "Yeah, still here. Just spaced out."

All the way back in Zaofu, the eyepatch-wearing young man walked around the Hall of Beifongs, at least what parts weren't closed off for repair, seeing so much of Honei and Aila's family history from all of the items on display.

Yasunori kept the call going, keeping his Varri-phone to his ear. "Man, I'm looking at the hall right now and it still is crazy how you and Aila have been related to the Beifong's."

"Yeah. But enough of my family, how's yours going? You checked up on 'em?" he heard Honei ask while glancing at the old metalbending police uniform of Lin Beifong on display.

"They're doing good. I called them up after you guys left for Kuvira's place."

Seeing how in neat condition the uniform was, Yasunori couldn't believe how old it was. "Checked up with my mom and step-dad first, since we were supposed to meet up with them and my little brother."

"OH, how's little Eiji doing? Any updates?"

"Yeah, Gon already told me my mom's been letting her friends coo over Eiji like crazy." he brought up, finding the mental image funny of his little half-brother's baby cheeks being tickled by a bunch of older ladies. "Did tell them what happened with the concussion."

"Were they freaked out?" Honei asked, which the damaged-eyed young man had to laugh at.

"I mean, YEAH, but it was actually my dad, step-mom and Olla who were more concerned when I told them about it. Well, mostly Kenna and Olla I mean. My dad was more annoyed if anything..." he made sure to correct himself as he walked down the hall, checking out more items on display.

Hearing the girl he loved laugh at that last part, Yasunori was thankful to know regardless of her being a robot or human, Honei still had that wonderful laugh that always warmed his heart.

"Just wait until you tell him you're going out with a Beifong."

Just the idea of telling both his birth and step parents, as well as his siblings, that did get Yasunori to laugh along. "Honestly, I think my dad would actually consider that more dangerous." he joked, the laughter infectious between the two.

Even with being separated a state apart, the two's love for each other made them feel like their significant other was there with them.

"Hey, think if you can try meditating into the Spirit World? I got it down pretty well with Aila's help, for the most part, and we can meet up." Honei offered, which did get her boyfriend's attention.

"I mean, I can try. Though I had Opal and Yasuko helping me out." he admitted.

Back in Ramaal-Hadia, the tall black-haired girl had remembered what was told about the journey to meet up with her Great-Great Grandmother's spirit.

Just the idea of seeing the Spirit World with her boyfriend at her side made Honei giddy to the core, giving a calm smile as she spoke fondly. "I can't wait to see you again, for real once everything with the Hunter is dealt with. Have you see me as human, Yasunori. Be able to finally feel the touch of your hand."

The newly turned human was practically almost eager to experience it.

"Haven't you already been able to?" she listened to Yasunori asking that, which was true. Honei's growing humanity had allowed her to feel his warmth, the hairs on his head, his lips in the past...

... but now, things were much different with her.

"Yeah, but that was with my outer robot shell, replicating skin. Now that I'm fully human, I want to experience your kisses for real... your hugs, spend a single day with you as a real girl."

Now that she said that, Honei realized that there may be... other stuff she could try out that just now came to mind.

Stuff she would do with Yasunori alone.

Before her mind can process what those things were, her brain quickly pushed that to the side for now. Deal with those things when the time comes.

It seemed as though Yasunori himself didn't seem to notice as he spoke, the jade-eyed girl wasn't sure to be honest.

"Honei, you've always been a real girl to me, and I can't wait to see you again too. Not just because you're human, more that I just miss you." His voice sounded so full of care as he spoke into her ear. "Phone calls can only do so much."

That Honei had to agree with, hoping Wan Shi Tong would come with the scroll and the Hunter not long after.

Once things were in the clear and the day was saved, she would fly Ying-Ling right straight back to Zaofu, run up to her boyfriend and give him the biggest hug and kiss she could give.

"Tell me about it, my darling." she smiled before seeing Quy-Mo climbing up onto the arm rest her feet were near, spotting a sand rat tail in his mouth before he swallowed it up, having to give a burp shortly afterwards.

That too got a laugh from Honei, now having another thing to tell Yasunori.

Tuesday...

Standing with stern feet on the ground, the Avatar stood in the stances of earthbending called out by her grandmother, getting them down while in her training attire.

The sun's rays hit her as she had been training for the past three hours.

"Alright, now tiger!" Kuvira called out, watching Aila get into that stance out of the horse stance. Standing next to her as always was Kallah, Honei having been asked by Redbear to assist him in grabbing some gardening supplies in town.

The platinum bender watched with her hands behind her back, like the old days.

"Now, THINK FAST!" she yelled out, swiftly holding her hands out to the side and moved them close like a massive clap.

And think quick Aila had to, realizing both massive thick walls of stone and sand were coming at all angles towards her

To Kallah however, it went by too quickly and the parts of earth collided right into each other, sand and broken stone hitting the ground.

"AILA!" was what she yelled out, concerned for her fiancée's well being, not seeing the knowing look on Kuvira's face as the fire nun ran up to the rubble as quickly as her legs would let her.

The waterbender grabbed as much stone and sand in her hands when she got close enough and threw them to the side, hoping to find some sign of Aila. "Come on, are you in there?" she asked out loud, her worry growing.

"Damn it, Kuvira! I think you might have gone too far!"

"Need any help?"

"No Aila, I got-"

The young woman stopped what she was saying upon realizing who just spoke, turning to see Aila standing behind her, trying to brush some sand out of her hair with her fingers.

"Huh, what?!" Kallah tried to process, looking back at the pile that was where the Avatar just was as Kuvira stepped up to the two, eying her granddaughter.

"Nice reaction."

Nodding along, Aila explained herself. "You told me to think fast, so I used whatever stone that was close enough to form over me and sunk into the sand, then I popped out near the front door..." she tried to explain herself, trying to shake some more sand out from her shorts.

"Guess it wasn't completely sealed, can feel so much sand in my-"

Before she knew it, she felt an attempt at a slap hit her bare arm.

"OW!" the glasses-wearing girl whined a bit, turning to Kallah, seeing how worried and annoyed she looked. "Kallah?"

"First your grandma scares me, now you too. Next, I'm expecting Honei to freak me out in the middle of the night."

Seeing how the waterbender was reacting, Aila instantly felt guilty, taking Kallah by her hands. "Kallah, I'm sorry, I was told to think fast and I did. If this was a real fight, life or death, I'd die if I didn't do anything. And I wasn't in any real danger."

"I know that, but..."

Kallah herself tried to think of all the close calls Aila had in the past.

"... is it wrong to be scared?" she had to ask.

"No, of course not!" The Avatar tried to convince her, making sure to show her entire body as she spun around in place. "But you don't have to worry about me training under Grandma. If anything, I was more scared of learning under Toph... and also Ryoko whenever she generated lightning."

Still, even after all of that, Kallah just threw her hands up and sighed out loud.

"Maybe this is just all my worry with the Hunter coming to kill you boiling over, that any small thing can hurt you." she tried to explain, walking over to where she had the towels and water bottles, grabbing one of the former.

"Let's just try cleaning some of that sand off and you can get back to-"

Before she knew it, Kallah felt herself spin around in place upon stepping on the stand, which twisted around.

Causing her to look to see Aila take her softly by the chin and pressing her lips onto her own.

Once she pulled away, the Avatar smiled. "Kallah, you have nothing to worry about. The Hunter may have his tricks, but so do I. And while I don't have full access to my bending like Ho-Seok, I do have home field advantage. I'm not going to make it easy for him."

That was true, with the waterbender smirking along. "Neither am I, Honei and your grandma."

Before Aila could feel some sense of relief to hear that...

... a small ball of sand hit her in the back.

"AHH, sudden sand!" she whined out before turning to see, as with Kallah, her grandmother sniggering where she stood, her hand up having just bended the sandball.

"You're dang right, Kallah." Kuvira gave her kind words before moving her fingers, in turn bending up with ease some sand into small whips as well as some from the platinum bracelets she wore.

"For now, Aila still has to get back to training..."

Thursday...

"OH, how about Takashi?"

"That is a good one. File that one under 'Possible', Bo."

"Filing, blue eyes."

On a lazy Thursday afternoon, with Ryoko having decided the leave the day before, both Bolin and Jun were relaxing outside the courtyard on some metal chairs, sitting side-by-side, watching as construction was currently being worked on with the Hall of Beifong's, with Opal and Toph leading the workers.

His head finally cleared up after the situation with the Hunter, his broken arm in a sling, the firebender was glad to finally take it easy.

Still, Bolin needed a breather whenever the pain acted up, such as now, to which Jun offered for them to relax where they were now, enjoying the breeze.

Since then, both decided to start thinking of possible baby names.

"What if we have a girl?" Jun wondered, their hands feeling their stomach where new life was growing, to which Bolin had to think.

"OH, what about Mira?"

"Mira?"

"Yeah, I remembered reading about an Earth Avatar WAY FAR BACK from the Si Wong desert. Like, I think she was the thirtieth, thirty first, one of the really old ones." Bolin knew it was one of those, continuing.

"The story goes that she was so badass and stoic, her home was a cave that was next to a buzzard wasp's nest and that she was practically immune to their stingers, making friends with them. Her animal companion was even one."

"Oof, she has more balls than I do to get near those things." Jun joked, which their boyfriend sniggered at.

"More balls than the both of us combined."

The couple laughed along at that, but Jun did take the name under consideration. "Filing that under 'possible' as well." they said, thinking more. "I like Yuri, it's both Fire Nation AND Water Tribe. Gender neutral as well."

"That works." Bolin noted, thinking. "Though Rihn has a nice ring to it."

Jun nodded along, looking up at the sky, getting a thought. "OH, totally an unisex air nomad sounding name. OH, how's about Tsomo?"

Hearing that, Bolin was about to voice his approval when something up in the sky got both his and Jun's attention, trying to focus on it as flapping was heard.

As it got closer, he was able to instantly realize what it was. "Oh SHIT, we have company..."

Something the enby figured out as well, the shape they were seeing looking very familiar.

"Better tell the others."

After carefully getting up, Bolin and Jun made their way over to the entrance area of the compound, catching up with Yasunori who ran out of the stables with Kuvira's sand wolf following him.

"AWUF!"

"Sorry Junior, gotta stay, stay..." he tried to tell the large animal before looking at the couple.

"What's up in the sky? Are we in danger?"

"That depends..."

That was all Bolin left off on, confusing the teenager as, after getting Junior settled, he followed them along until finally they made it to the front entrance of the compound, seeing all the guards, as well as those in charge on standby as before them was a familiar dark green and brown scaled dragon resting itself down, a single figure getting off.

"BOLIN UNXAS HUYNH!"

Knowing there was no backing out now, especially upon hearing his aunt scream out his full name, the detective just groaned out loud as Jun found this funny, Yasunori more surprised at his given middle name.

"OH, you share your middle name with your dad's first?"

"Yes I do, Yasunori Miyoko Miura, COMING!" he briefly commented before yelling out the last word, not even bothering to see the embarrassed reaction of the damaged-eye teenager hearing his middle name as he made his way over.

All Yasunori could do was see Jun trying to hold in a laugh as they followed along, leaving him trying to explain himself.

"Miyoko is a unisex name! It's Old Fire Nation for 'Beautiful child of a beautiful generation', shut up!" he whined out before rushing after them.

Arriving, the three saw that alongside the rest of the Beifong's, Vuong Huynh looked at her nephew while clad in her uniform.

"Bolin, your mother just told me you're gonna be a daddy again because you knocked up Jun. Is that true?"

Feeling put on the spot, the nephew had to nod along to his aunt's question. "Yes, Aunt Vuong. Jun's pregnant. Thank you for-" he tried to speak, only to suddenly feel Vuong give him a big hug at the news.

"AWW, way to go, baby maker! Give me another great-niece or nephew!"

"My arm, Aunt Vuong! WATCH MY ARM!"

As Vuong had to quickly let her nephew go, realizing she hugged a little too hard before turning her attention to the one actually giving birth.

"And you, Jun. I'm so happy to hear that you're expecting. How'd you find out?" The Rangi Tier Kyoshi Warrior gave a warm smile that she was used to giving.

All the attention being given, it was a bit overwhelming for Jun who gave a nervous laugh. "Um, it's, uh, something of a story."

"Say no more. Suddenly reminds me of how I found out I was knocked up with Wong, Bo's cousin." Vuong brought up, remembering how she became a mother before Ryoko at the age of twenty two. "Our mom just up and asked me 'So, when's the little guy popping out?'"

"I was there, you couldn't give a response cause you were stuttering over words like crazy!" Opal laughed out along with her niece, enjoying the story as the Kyoshi Warrior sniggered.

"Boy, are they in for a fun first time! Cramps, feeling lazy, weird cravings."

"OH MY RAAVA, I remember craving noodles and strawberry cold cream all at once and Air Temple Island didn't have any."

"Didn't you force Uncle Bo to grab you some from town, despite the ferry not being around?"

"Or else I'd send him flying in airbending."

"Thank the spirits they're not talking about when I was born." Bolin whispered to Jun, thankful they were talking about a different subject.

"And then when Little Bo was born, he was already firebending as soon as he came out. Burping a little flame into his Uncle Bolin's face when Ryoko first showed him off to you two." Vuong remembered fondly of the first time her uncle met his nephew, in turn causing said firebender to groan out, covering his ears.

"Oh, COME ON!"

Having to walk away from the scene, Bolin was too embarrassed, with Vuong watching Jun follow after him, wanting to know more as the others followed.

Keeping at her aunt's side, the non-bending daughter of Mako and Thuy did have to mention another.

"Ryoko also told me Bolin also finally met his daddy." Vuong also brought up, which Opal nodded at while the two began to follow the others lead while Midori was led to the stables.

"And his younger brother."

"Wait, when did Unxas have another kid?"

Saturday...

Getting dressed up and drinking her tea this early morning, Kuvira knew for today, certain things would have to be done differently, as it had before, knowing today may be easier with all the help she could get.

Once Honei awoke and got ready, as with feeding Ying-Ling, both she and her grandmother went into the village on top of the sky-bison, deciding to hit a candle shop first. One that sold their own homemade stock, giving them different scents and colors as when lit.

The candlestick where it looked like small broken pieces of shells were inside of the candle wax got both's attention. It also had a pleasant palm tree smell, like you were on a beach.

"Oh, that's delightful..." Kuvira had to comment, which Honei agreed on very much. Even if the special scent did make her sneeze, getting a light chuckle from her grandmother.

Both made sure to grab that, as well as some teacup sized candles and incense sticks, paying for them.

With that, both the grandmother and granddaughter made their way over to the Catfox's Den, knowing Aila and Kallah would be up by then, both ready for whatever Kuvira threw at the former.

To their surprise, Kuvira had decided that for today, Aila could have the day off from her earthbending training, figuring she earned it. Instead, she offered the three girls, as well as Quy-Mo, to just spend the day doing errands and maybe having a simple meal under the stars tonight.

"As much as Zarah's cooks know their stuff, sometimes, a home cooked meal hits the spot." the dual-bender figured, which sounded just perfect to the three youngsters.

With the plan set, it was time to get things prepared.

First, the four decided to hit a record shop which catered to those who preferred pre-owned titles as well as newer ones, wondering what to grab. Aila and Honei found one they heard at a dance hall back in Republic City, knowing it had hopping beats and popping bass, deciding they wanted to grab it.

Honei tried to find one connected to 'Girl from the Stars' for Yasunori's collection, able to feel how the different cardboard album sleeves felt on her fingers. While she didn't find what she was looking for, one with a picture comic-inspired cover of the female singer on stage got her attention, the album called 'Red Eyes'.

As for Kuvira, one of the smaller loose records in the singles bin got her eyes, carefully taking it in hand. "OH, I haven't heard this in so long..." she brought up, remembering the last time she heard the song.

Making their purchases, the four, as well as Quy-Mo, then ventured over to the vendor's square, where sellers of all sorts, mainly those of the food sort, sold what they had.

While it was planned to make dinner for the night, it was Honei who gave an idea of what to make and that she could cook it up, seeing what she needed was for sale.

With no complaints from Aila nor Kallah, Kuvira couldn't say no to her granddaughter.

"Then tonight you'll make dinner. Though something like this may take quite some time to make."

Not that it was a problem as the meal was something Honei would make alongside her and Aila's mother back when she was alive.

Walking with the goods in bags towards where Ying-Ling was tied up with water nearby, seeing it was now close to the afternoon, the group was walking towards the sky-bison when the older woman had started to drag behind the others, staying in place.

The three turned to see the platinum bender needing to sit down on a wooden box near one vendor.

Seeing she had set aside her bag and had been taking deep breaths, her hand over her chest, the three knew what was up, quick to check up on her and be at her side.

But Kuvira held her hand up as quick as they came, feeling the pain on her heart fade away, giving a calm smile to those sweet girls as Quy-Mo hopped onto her lap to give her comfort purring.

"I'm alright, girls. Just a minor bit of pain, nothing to worry about." she swore, putting on a smile, despite it hurting very much for the short time she felt it. "Just give me a few minutes, okay?"

Something Aila, Honei and Kallah all understood, choosing to talk about random things to take the older woman's mind off of the situation until she was set.

Afterwards, the group were heading their way to Kuvira's property on Ying-Ling, seeing Redbear fixing up part of his home, choosing to ask for some special teabags of his, explaining their plan for later on.

Understanding why, the tattooed waterbender walked into his home, coming back out a minute later with a tea box, full of honey ginger tea leaves he harvested from his garden.

He told them while also tasting yummy, it'd also do wonders for their immune system and heart.

Thankful, Kuvira just smiled as she bowed to her best friend. "Thank you, Redbear." She spoke kindly of him.

Bringing in all they grabbed from shopping inside her hut, the older woman and the others got the stuff put away before deciding to get a start on getting dinner prepared and cooked.

It took at least five hours, but everyone couldn't believe how wonderful smelling Honei's cooking was, with some assistance from the other three as well. Even with all the dishes that'd have to be cleaned up before nights end, it was going to be so worth it.

The main dish was pad krapow, where picken meat had been diced up and pan fried with various peppers, garlic and basil mixed in, seasoned up with soy sauce to give it a nice brown color. Limes were then sliced up into half pieces, for optional extra flavor.

At the same time, some special rice with a lovely scent was steamed up, with Aila and Kallah using their bending to do so, while Honei made sure to make up four fried eggs, one going on each plate. Each was perfectly cooked and flipped with no issues.

Alongside some fried up buns coated in sugar as a dessert, Kuvira herself couldn't wait to taste the food, being told that she could relax and listen to her music as the three did all the hard work.

A kind gesture that she wasn't going to dispute, relaxing in her chair as the single she listened to played, soothing her ears as she kept petting behind Quy-Mo's ears, hearing him enjoy it.

The song was an older track, from around her time, the trombones, horns and drumming sounding exactly like she was there listening to it at a gala Suyin held, dancing the night away with the man she loved.

Finally, it was time to eat, with the plates of food, as well as utensils, hot teapot and cups brought outside, where under the now calming night sky, a blanket laid on the sandy ground.

It was a perfect sight once the four began to dig in, as well as the animals getting their food and drink.

Of course, the taste of Honei's cooking was to die for, with Redbear's tea also fitting in so well.

By the time they finished, there was nothing left on the plates or in the teapot, the flavors lingering on their tongues as they sat out on the blanket.

Looking up into the night sky, Kuvira just smiled, seeing Yue's light shine from the moon, seeing a few stars out.

This night, it felt different than a similar one the year before, and the one before that, so on...

... but this year, this night would be different for the old woman who looked at her family, seeing them grab some stuff.

"Everything prepared?" she asked.

And each of the girls nodded silently.

Kallah took out with the sticks of incense that had been bought, as with the teacup candles which Honei revealed as well.

Placing them down together on the sand away from the blanket, Aila firebended a small flame from her index finger, using it to light up the wick and sticks.

Seeing that done, it was now time for Kuvira to do her part, taking out of her dress pocket an old photo...

... an old sepia-toned one of her and her husband. Taken way back during their wedding, her baby bump showing through her dress, placing it near the candles and incense.

Her eyes began to water as she gave a sad smile as her granddaughters and her future in-law heard her speak.

"Hey Junior... I know you can visit me whenever from the Spirit World, like the others, like Korra who won't leave me alone..." she spoke, knowing Aila's past life was surely laughing at that comment.

Still, even though it has been so long, the pain Kuvira felt never went away.

"After all these years, I still miss you... I still miss your smiling face, your hand holding mine, your voice..."

The three young women listened to her speak to her late husband, understanding that everything done today was her building up what is most likely her final chance to grieve for Baatar Beifong Jr. on the anniversary of his passing.

"Losing you, it still hurts, always has... but soon, I'll be following you." Kuvira spoke, knowing her husband's spirit was listening, knowing the others were. "I'll be with you, our little Baatar, Asuka, your parents, Huan, Korra, Mako, Bolin, Thuy, all of you guys will be waiting for me..."

Saying that, a bittersweet smile did come forth on her lips.

"... but today, I wasn't alone."

Kuvira looked at the saddened, but thankful girls with her, the three who were kind enough to be there for her. "I have at my side our granddaughters. Our wonderful, brilliant, and powerful Avatar, Aila..." she spoke highly, seeing Aila sniffle hearing that.

"... our sweet, delightful and very spirited Honei."

The tallest of the three gave a silly smile hearing that, wiping her jade eyes.

"And Aila's own love, the kind hearted, adorable Kallah."

The Fire Nun took Aila's hand upon hearing this and kissed it, thankful to be among the Beifong family as Kuvira felt good to have them and Honei with her.

"We may have had our hurdles, but my love for you and our family will always motivate me to live my life to the fullest," She promised. "And when I do finally cross over, I'll be giving you the biggest kiss I can give. Until then..."

The old woman pressed two of her fingers up to her lips, then brought them to where Baatar's head was on the picture.

"... I love you, Baatar."

At that second, the flames of the candles blew thanks to a small gust of wind as the grandmother just sat there, tears in her eyes before feeling the caring arms of her family hug her tightly, letting her be able to finally cry.

Sunday...

Within the past week, the Avatar Hunter named Wolf felt so alive, more so than any previous period in its entire existence.

Instead of focusing his effort on continuing to hunt down and search for the Avatar, he willingly chose to remain in the town that its host, Iko, had lived in. Staying with the three people who had been nothing but kind to him.

From helping out Sun with chores around the house or assisting with shopping, doing fun activities alongside his new friend Meiying, or just spending time talking to Fung, it all helped clear Wolf's mind.

Enough so that not once did the thought of slaying the Avatar ever come to mind. And he rather liked it.

During which Wolf was able to learn more about the future he was in, quite interested at what he found out about.

While some of what he learned was quite disheartening, like finding out what had happened to the Airbenders during Sozin's rule, some warmed his heart like finding out they returned from extinction due to Harmonic Convergence.

One activity he had done was checking up at the local library of what happened with those who bore the title Avatar after Ho-Seok, finding out much about those after him, like Szeto, Yangchen, Kuruk, Kyoshi, Roku, Aang and Korra.

And finally, Wolf had found out about the girl who had been born as the Avatar after her predecessor's passing, Aila Makimura.

Though he didn't have a whole lot to look into about the twenty-year old girl from Republic City compared to the others, the Hunter did find out through his new friends some about the Avatar-in-training.

From her humble beginnings, the events that led to her finding out who she was, what appearances she had in the public alongside certain famous people of the time. He realized that she was caring, kind and willing to help, even if she hadn't fully become the Avatar yet.

Finding out what happened to her family did strike a cord with Wolf, reminding him of the lives taken away to create him. That sounded like it fit with the scared girl who tried to kill him to protect herself.

Then, earlier today after helping Fung get from the local hardware shop some power tools and spools of barbed wire for fencing around the property, an interesting offer was presented to the scarred man.

A dinner out.

Heading to a local eatery that had different kinds of food from all nations, Sun, Meiying and Fung all wanted to show their gratitude for all Wolf had done for them, to let him relax for one night.

The place itself seemed to be busy, but homely as waiters and waitresses served ordered food and drinks, some from the bartender. All the while there were some interesting knick-knacks hanging off the walls.

Certainly didn't have this kind of place during Ho-Seok's era, yet Wolf found himself partially amused. Even as Meiying herself pointed at a funny monkey squirrel stuffed toy on the wall.

"Monkey!"

There was also music playing on a similar jukebox, hopping music similar to that which Sun enjoyed listening to.

All had made their orders of food to try out and eat, along with drinks, including an appetizer of veggie and picken-filled fried wontons, which all four enjoyed, their guest most surprised at how much he liked to dip them into soy sauce.

For the entrees, Meiying had herself a simple bowl of pan-fried picken in sweet and sour sauce, veggies and noodles, with a cup of peach juice.

Both Sun and Fung decided to each go for some butter chicken served over steamed rice, along with pieces of naan bread, with the mother having a glass of red wine while the aide chose some fizzy pop for he was going to be driving tonight.

Which left Wolf, who went for something called 'Braised moo-sow Belly', which came to him as a bowl of sliced pieces of caramelized moo-sow belly meat and two halves of a soy marinated boiled egg over some steamed jasmine rice and pickled mustard greens, along with a glass of rum and another of simple water.

Now THIS was something the marked man rather enjoyed, not stopping eating until there was nothing left in his bowl.

Yet while the food and drink was wonderful, Wolf rather enjoyed the mood and feel of the place, just talking and relaxing among the three he grew to care for.

Needing to use the bathroom quickly one moment, he was exiting it when a local female looked to come out of the ladies room, looking at him.

"Hey, uh, sorry to bother you, but can you grab a roll of toilet paper and hand it along. We're all out in here." she politely asked.

Not seeing any issue, Wolf did as he was asked, grabbing where one roll was from a stall and came back to give it to the thankful woman.

"Thanks a bunch." the brunette offered, giving a wave of her false right hand. One which the Hunter noticed looked to be some sort of plastic and metal prosthetic as he nodded at her.

"Of course, you're welcome."

Once the bill was paid, Wolf, Sun, Meiying and Fung all made their way back to the truck and ventured back to their home, having had a lovely night.

With her daughter put to rest not long after with Fung following, Sun was then led to her bedroom door by Wolf, just smiling.

"That was a fun night, hope you enjoyed yourself."

"Of course, I haven't had this amount of fun since..." Wolf tried to speak before realizing something.

The Hunter hadn't felt this way at all, making it wonder what else it could experience.

"... Huh, don't know."

Still, that was all good with Sun who just giggled, poking his nose with her index finger. "Well, I'll be seeing you in the morning. We were thinking of going on a hike." she promised, which Wolf understood.

"Yeah, sounds good..."

"Good night, Wolf."

"Iko."

Hearing that, Sun didn't quite get what she just heard the kind man say, seeing him give a deep breath.

"Uh, my... who I was before... I became Wolf, that was my name. Iko." Wolf offered, feeling a little nervous, but decided there and then to make his choice.

He was no longer Wolf, the Avatar Hunter. He was just Iko.

A choice in name to ensure the man whose body was his host had a second chance at a good life.

Giving a sincere smile, Iko went to leave when he felt the kind hand of the mother placed on his shoulder to stop him.

"Wait, one last thing..."

Confused, the newly named man wasn't sure what the thing was as he turned around...

... only to then feel the lips of Sun's press against his lips.

She was kissing him.

THAT was surprising to say the least.

Pulling away after a few seconds, Sun just gave a sweet smile.

To her amusement, she saw Iko's face turn completely beet red.

He himself had seen other humans kiss before, even happened to witnessed a couple back during Ho-Seok's era engaged in carnal passion while making an escape.

But this was the first time the marked one truly experienced something close...

... and it... felt good.

And more surprising, Iko felt compelled to kiss Sun back.

Wasn't as on point as her's, but the mother welcomed it as she lightly held onto him and he with her...

... before Sun herself began to bring who she cared for inside her bedroom, shutting the door behind them.

A sight which a still-alive Fung had spotted from his bedroom, knowing it was best to ignore it and let things be.

All while he nor did anyone else on the property know the place was being watched through binoculars from afar, inside a satomobile.

"And they're off to sleep."

"Gold star for you."

Inside, the binoculars were lowered down from the woman's eyesight, keeping her sight towards the brickhouse. "Think we got plenty for Tint to hear about." she described, remembering when she 'innocently' asked Wolf for the toilet paper earlier.

Her one interaction with this mystery fellow who was eating out with her boss's family and their aide seemed simple enough, the guy seemed like the friendly sort.

That much Heera knew, only to hear an annoyed snort from the fat slob in the driver's seat before hearing him chew up those pills for his bad hand before sticking an unlit cigarette in and lighting it up.

"You fuckin' think? We've been watching the jerk-off lure in the whore by playing nice guy with that retard and faggot for a week." Gao crudely said, blowing smoke out the window.

"Tell me you're aware you're talking shit about Tint's wife and daughter, right?" Heera had to point out, not amused by his behavior. Not like the fat toad cared.

"Hey, not like he's here. Plus, you know he's called them way worse."

"Thanks for the reminder."

Still, the Earth States woman, adjusting the straps that kept her prosthetic hand in place, was being paid by her boss to see if Gao's claims about where they've been hiding were true.

And they were.

"Let's get back to the hotel and get some rest. We'll call Tint in the morning," she ordered, to which the driver did as he was told, driving away from the property.

"I'm sure he'd love to meet up with them personally..."

Notes:

And our chapter be done here! Yes, the "One Week" chapter from the original version for the fic, my version of the "Tales of Ba Sing Se" ATLA episode... but trimmed down from seven days to just five cause I wanted to not make the chapters as long. Which meant the segment with Quy-Mo and Sadira going around the village was taken out, but... well, tiss what it is. But I did also add some things in as well, can you tell the changes?

But as you can see this chapter, got some varied fun featured here, of the funny and sweet kind. Like Honei and Yasunori talking over the phone about Honei's newfound humanity, the changes and how things will be different, as with Yasunori's family life, being the dorky teens in love. As with Aila learning more Earthbending from Kuvira, as with having a moment with Kallah about her safety and concern considering the Wolf situation... and Kuvira still being a stern, but playful teacher for her granddaughter. Also shown off as a fun segment of Bolin and Jun going over potential names for their unborn child, ready to be parents together... along with a visit for them and Opal from Vuong Huynh, who heard the good news. Oh and we find out Yasunori's middle name... it's unisex. XD

Then we save the more heartwarming/bittersweet/sad segments for last, of sorts. With one focusing on Kuvira spending a day out with her family, preparing something with their help, as with dealing with her weakened heart. But she pushes through as she, Aila, Kallah and Honei have a nice dinner and listen to some music... before it's revealed it's the anniversary of Baatar Jr.'s passing, finally able to spend a day grieving without being alone. And yes, the segment was written with Kuvira being the only one with dialog. More tricky than it sounds. XD

And then, there's the last day, which focuses on Wolf who, since meeting Sun, Meiying and Fung, has never felt more alive. More... free, more human even than he ever has hunting down any Avatar. Though he does use up them computer internet to look up past Avatar's after Ho-Seok and up to Aila, learning about her. Then Wolf is invited for a dinner out with the nice people he's bonded with, all having a fun time and enjoying good food... and bumps into a random woman with a fake hand. Huh, but later that night, the most important thing for Wolf happens as him and Sun have a private moments together, talking about doing a hike the next day... when Wolf makes a choice. To no longer be the Avatar Hunter, to be Wolf.

Now, he's Iko, taking up the name of the man who's body he's in control of. As a way to give the old Iko a second chance at life, ready to leave things off there... when Sun gives him a kiss. One IKO wasn't expecting, but he returns the kiss as well and... well, you know, stuff happens. Which is all sweet... only for the reveal that the woman Wolf bumped into was the Heera who Tint brought up last chapter, with Gao in the satomobile keeping an eye from afar... and deciding something had to be done. UH-OH...
