Chapter 28: Chapter Twenty Eight- What Death Is

Notes:

Well, this chapter is about to take a turn considering what's been going on with one character, wonder which one... you know who, so let's just get into "Rise of Aila!"

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, including some slurs, spousal/child abuse, strong bloody violence and gore, including a character death and references to past death, including that of children...

... yeah, this is gonna be a dark chapter.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Getting training done for the day, the family of four in Ramaal-Hadia was ready to think of lunch when a guest or two arrived at Kuvira's home, catching them, as well as Redbear, by surprise.

"Zarah, surprised you came over to visit." The protector of the springs welcomed the bordello owner and her catfox, himself having taken a break from working on his home.

Still, the glassbender laughed and smiled upon feeling the older man give her a big friendly hug. "Redbear, you big ol' stuffed animal." she laughed out, knowing him very much since she moved to the village, turning to the others.

"Me and my little queen were hoping we weren't too late to get a front row seat in seeing the Avatar train." she explained while letting Sadira down to play around with Quy-Mo.

"Apologizes Ms. Zarah, but Aila just got done for the day." Honei had to apologize, turning to see her sister drinking from a water bottle given by Kallah.

"Aw, shame. Would have been fun to see Aila bend multiple elements." Zarah gave a faux-pout, to which said bender heard and held her hands out, moving them to allow herself to bend up some little puffs of flames.

All before then moving her hands about before and then blowing her breath towards the older woman, bending some wind her way, blowing part of the local's hijab back.

"Alright, alright, enough playing around." Kuvira purposely spoke up, knowing her granddaughter did it to mess with the glassbender before stepping up to her.

"We just got done, but if you all are willing to wake up bright and early tomorrow morning, you can see Aila in action."

That sounded fine with the local, who nodded. "Of course, perhaps I can teach Aila some glassbending while I'm at it, Pai." she offered with a sly wink, which Aila quickly jumped on, practically holding back her excitement at the idea.

"WOAH, really?!"

As everyone else was focused on the prospect of the Avatar learning a new form of sub-bending, something didn't seem right with Kuvira, how Zarah spoke to her.

Everything seemed fine all the way up to when the younger woman called her by her false name, the former Great Uniter taking notice of the sly way she spoke her false name...

... almost like...

... NO, that couldn't be.

Add that up to the list of things Kuvira wondered about the glassbender.

Deciding to leave the group for a moment, the elderly woman went back inside her home and grabbed Honei's Varri-Phone, needing to make a quick call.

Punching in the numbers, she waited as it rang, hearing a familiar voice pick it up.

"Hello?"

"Hi Op, it's Kuvira."

"Oh hey, Kuvi. What's up?" Opal's voice spoke so calmly, her perkiness not fading away with age.

"Just wanted to check up on Zaofu, see how things are going. How's the expecting parents?" Kuvira had to ask, hearing an amused snigger on the other end.

"Good, my nieces just came by to visit a few days ago. Ryoko and Vuong were so gushing over the little bun in Jun's oven."

Back in Zaofu, the elder airbender was alone in the family room, leaving her to speak on the landline.

"Bolin and Jun are also already talking about names. Came up with some good ones. And Bolin's father and brother came around as well."

"Wait, really? Well, good to hear." She could hear Kuvira's voice sounding pleased to hear that. "What about Junior? Poor pup must be missing me."

Opal nodded along. "He is, but we're making sure he's getting as much care as you'd give him." she assured her sister-in-law. "He's also been loving the food here, seems to have taken a liking to Roaluk and Aiko. And vice versa."

"Good. Hopefully once things are dealt with the Hunter, we can come back and I can give him a big hug."

Listening, Opal was curious about things on Kuvira's end. "What about over at your place? How's the girls?"

"They're fine, Honei's been loving being human, she snores SO LOUDLY." the voice spoke fondly on the other end.

"And the love birds?"

Kuvira remembered fondly the little fun both young women had when they arrived at her hut.

"They're enjoying it here, Aila and Kallah are just enjoying life." she described. "That may be Korra and Asami's influence on them."

"That's an interesting Avatar theory." Opal joked, both older women laughing along.

So many years later, despite the hurdles the two faced, either against each other or together, both benders felt their connection never really faded away.

"I'm happy you're finding your happiness after all this time."

"Have to fit in as much as I can within a year."

"That's right. Remember my mother's last words." Opal made sure to bring up, which Kuvira remembered fondly, even after so long.

"Yeah, 'Blood or not, the bond of my family will always be stronger than any metal in the world'."

A silence filled both ends, knowing the words the matriarch spoke of before she passed away had always stuck by both Kuvira and Opal.

"Thank you for coming back into our lives, Kuvira. Into Aila and Honei's..."

Even without seeing that bright beaming face, the dual-bender knew her foster sister had something in her eye as she spoke those words.

The feeling was mutual.

"And thank you for accepting me back, Opal."

Both give their goodbyes and best wishes before hanging up, ready to move on with the rest of the day...

"Tweet... tweet..."

"Tweet-tweet... tweet..." Meiying repeated the sounds she heard the birds in the trees where she sat on the picnic blanket, Yippy close to her as Fung prepared the simple snacks and drinks from the basket they brought along.

All the while Iko just took in the sights of the land of Yukka from the cliff-side ledge.

The sound of the water coming from the falls hitting the river below sounded pleasant to the ears.

The green lush landscape was lovely to see, even with the graying cloudy sky.

Right at this moment, having enjoyed a nice walk along a nature trail to this checkpoint, Iko felt a peace he had never felt before.

He was ready to experience a new life.

Not as Wolf, the Hunter... but just Iko, who had his own new family of sorts.

There was still the subject of his immortality and healing in the back of his head. How the others would react.

Yet at the moment, the scarred man felt no issue and decided to hold off on it at the moment.

"Iko..."

Speaking his new name, Sun got Iko's attention as he turned around to see her smiling face.

One of the leading reasons why he made his important choice.

The mother glanced at what he was checking out. "Like the view?" she asked, seeing Iko nod along with a thankful smile.

"Yes, it's nice."

"First time seeing something like this."

"Well, not exactly. But here, yeah."

"How so?"

Softly taking the hands of Sun's in his own, Iko did feel a little bashful for what he had to say.

"Uh... Well, you're here... along with the others of course, heh..."

Being reminded of who she thought was just a kind soul, one that she figured was a little rusty in bed the night before, taking it easy with him, Sun just found that sweet.

Especially with how he looked like a big lion-bear when she awoke early in the morning and Iko was still sleeping.

Where he was, Fung just smirked to himself at the lovely sight, whispering over to the young child looking at the birds. "Aw, looks like your friend is crushing on your mommy..."

"Tweet... tweet-tweet-tweet... toad."

"What was that?" The aide had to ask, not quite catching that last part.

"TOAD..."

Just Meiying repeating that familiar term again put everyone on high alert, enough to interrupt the nice moment as they looked to see the scared girl looking in one direction...

... where the disgusting, but familiar, metalbender coming out from the woods with his hand bandaged up, with at least eight others behind him, all shady looking. Maybe more, hard to tell.

"Nice to see she remembers me."

Gao then cast his attention towards Iko, raising up his injured hand for all to see. "And you think I hadn't forgotten about you?"

"Leave us alone already!" Sun yelled out, taking her daughter close to her...

... only to feel, as well as the others, the strong hands of others grab each of them before cuffs of earthly stone were bended around their wrists behind their backs.

All except for Iko himself.

With them restrained, some of the thugs had begun to separate the group by gender, Meiying screaming out in distress as she struggled. "NAAAGGHH! YYAAAGGHH!"

"Two seconds..." Gao groaned before holding a hand out, bending some metal from his waist onto around the screaming girl's mouth, muffling her screams.

"MMRRPH!"

"There we go, don't have listen to the retard's screams."

"DON'T YOU SAY THAT ABOUT-" Fung tried to call out, hating that word more than anyone, but a swift punch from one of the thugs to the gut knocked all the wind out of him, driving him down as Iko watched in shock.

"FUNG!" he yelled before looking at the fat man. "Why are you doing this? These people already suffered enough as it is!"

Hearing him, Gao glanced at the scarred man, curious as he stepped close.

"You know, I've been wondering about you. How your eyes could change, how strong you are." he explained, wondering.

"Here I thought you were some badass-in-hiding. Escaping from the time you served, or some shady shit you did. But I think I got it."

Saying that, the metalbender drove his good fist into the side of Iko's face, hearing the whimpers and cries for him as he fell to the ground.

"IKO!"

"You're one of them half-spirits." he figured, glancing at the other three. "Someone who had contact with a spirit going into their body, warping how they look, giving them nifty abilities." he described for them.

"Little like that Tokuga triad asshole who popped up right after the Earth Empire were fucked over the first time back during that Snow-Ape's time."

"I'm guessing that's a slur against Avatar Korra..." Iko grunted out sarcastically, trying to keep his temper low, which got him a sharp piece of metal being held against his throat by the metalbender, only giving a look back.

"... but you're not wrong about what I am."

Before Sun or Fung could question his words or Gao could try slitting his throat, another voice spoke up.

"Now now, no need for any bloodshed..."

Now, all attention was brought to two figures in suits who were making their presence known. Each important in their own right.

Her prosthetic hand out in the open and her brown hair in a braided ponytail, was the woman whom Iko had interacted with the night before at the eatery. Unlike the night before, she seemed to have more of a focused look at things.

But the second one, the simple looking guy next to her was the one who struck fear into Sun and Meiying's hearts, looking more business casual with his clean cut friendly look with the pale skin of his contrasting his slicked back brown hair.

The man patted Gao's shoulder like he was close friends with him. "Thank you for helping find my dear wife and daughter, have no idea how much I've been worrying about them." he spoke, his friendly tone having the slickest of slime to them.

Something Sun wasn't taking.

"YOU FUCKING LIAR, TINT!" she screamed, trying to struggle her way out of the one thug's grip, to possibly tackle her husband, only to see the one suited female come in front of her.

"Relax, Sun. Don't make things worse than they already are." Heera insisted, having to unstrap her fake hand to replace it with another, holding the appendage up before her.

An appendage made of DIAMOND that she easily bended with ease.

Trying to keep things civil, Tint made sure to speak up, holding his hands up. "Woah, easy Heera. Look girl, I respect you trying to keep the peace, but we're cool, we're cool!" he tried to lighten the mood in his own way, leaning close to his wife who just glared daggers, seeing her short bob of hair.

"You cut your hair, it looks good."

Saying that, the man turned his attention to his daughter. "Hey there, Meiying. Sorry about all of this and the mouth guard." he talked her down, only to hear the muffled response she was giving him.

"SSPPFFF! SPPFFFF!"

Knowing very well what she was saying, Tint only gave a deep breath, shaking his head. "Nice to see you too, honey." he lightly said, hiding his feelings on the matter while seeing Fung be brought back up, coughing from getting punched.

"And Fung, hope my wife is paying you good for your services."

"I'm helping her for free." The aide mocked back, which did elicit an amused reaction from the political pundit, having to laugh while pointing at him.

"Smart, good on you." Tint noted before finally turning his attention towards the last one, the one he was told had been seen spending more time with his wife, the big bad non-bender who hurt one of his supporters.

"And that just leaves you..."

However, it just now became apparent to Sun, Meiying and Fung, that Iko had been in utter silence, his eyes widened in terror at the man before him. No one knew what was going through that mind of his.

The scared look he was getting seemed to bemuse Tint, who kneeled down to look into those amber eyes with his green ones.

"What's wrong?" he began to ask, not knowing images were flashing through Iko's mind.

Those of the cloaked leader of the Vaatu cult giving the order for his family to be murdered, holding the goblet of blood filled with that of the original Iko's children and his wife's carved-out heart in both his hands...

... as well as the similar looking face the hooded man had with those green eyes.

The very same ones he saw of Tint's.

"Looks like you saw a dark spirit."

Giving a good clap, the abusive husband got back onto his feet and looked back at his wife and daughter. "Look, I understand I've been kind of a bastard, won't deny it. Done some shitty things, been under a lot of stress." he tried to explain himself.

That earned him an annoyed scoff from Fung.

"Oh, you mean whining and complaining about Avatar Aila, how you're still cheering for a lost cause, complaining about those who are mean to the so-called 'innocent' Earth Confederacy?" he asked rhetorically before giving special attention to both Gao and Heera.

"The lady with the diamond hand, I don't know what her deal is, so I can't judge her as much. But I'm guessing the fat ass jerks off every night to your voice spouting out your bullshit."

"STUPID QUEER ASS-" The metalbender growled out, ready to hurt him, only for the female bender to stop him in place with her diamond-made prosthetic.

"Don't you move unless Tint tells you to." Heera ordered him before looking back at the captive man that had just been mouthing off. "And for your information, I don't give two fuck's about the Confederacy. Just that Tint signs my paycheck, same as anyone else I've worked for."

"Wow, pretty AND honest. I already like her more than the rest of you." Fung commented back at the others' expense.

"Hey now, I welcome freedom of expression, like from Gao and those who listen to my program." Tint brought up, hands up in defense before looking closer at him. "Not my fault they happen to be right... oh, let's be fair and say at least eighty five percent of the time."

Saying that, the man behind all of this just shook his head, looking at Sun.

"Now, if we can be civilized, I was thinking us two and our daughter can have a private dinner back at your new place, clear the air. I'm willing to let go and forgive... what happened weeks ago, like you stealing some of my savings." Tint offered, while giving a total shit-eating grin.

"Maybe be a family again."

"She already has a family, a real one!" Fung once more spoke up, sticking up for his friend. "One with those who don't insult her or Meiying, smack her around. Doesn't constantly suck the dick of some dead asshole who, let's be honest, deserved death!"

Giving a look towards Iko, seeing the catatonic state he was still in, the aide kept speaking. "That man right there, Iko's been more of a husband and father to them in only a week than you'd ever be in your entire life! And since I'm airing my grievances..."

Still on his roll, Fung made sure to glare angrily at Gao.

"... I'M NOT GAY, YOU STUPID, FUCKING INBRED MORON! I've gotten plenty of girls while you were wasting your time at the buffe-"

A sharp piece of metal shot into his forehead to silence him, bended forth by the metalbender enraged at the insult.

"RRABTHH!"

"FUNG!" Sun screamed out as Meiying gave a muffled one of her own as both watched him fall backwards on the ground as blood began coming out his wound.

Seeing that was what finally broke Iko out of his fright, seeing what befell his friend.

"THE FUCK DID I JUST TELL YOU!?" Heera demanded, not caring for whatever excuse the metalbender was about to give, with Tint realizing how bad this may be.

"You BASTARD!" then came roaring out of Iko, ready to charge forth and kill Gao there and then...

... only to stop upon the piercing pain hitting his chest, any and all anger he felt sinking away as he looked down...

... to see that some metal had been jammed right into the side of his torso.

In fact, it was the same sharp piece of metal that Gao just used on Fung.

Feeling his legs wobble, Iko felt as though all power was going in and out of his body as his chest bled, his heart burning.

Right as the flashes rapidly came forth, of that horrible night when he was created.

Of Iko's family being kidnapped, brought to the altar with Vaatu's marking by the cultists.

Minako and Khan violently hacked apart without mercy.

Li-Bing crying out upon her chest being carved open and her heart removed.

And Iko screaming at the death before him before seeing the leader's face after all that was taken from him.

Making a vow there and then no one would expect.

Not as a non-bender who was raised to follow the Air Nomad philosophy of non-violence along with his parents and siblings...

... but as a grieving, furious father and husband who just witnessed everything he cherished taken from him.

"I'll kill you... I'LL KILL EACH AND EVERY SINGLE LAST FUCKIN' ONE OF YOU!"

Then his throat was slit, his life ending there...

... only for Wolf to be awakened upon the pressing of the brand on his chest.

With the goblet of blood and heart held out to him as the leader spoke.

"Complete it, Hunter..."

Right there and then, without restraint, the Avatar Hunter grabbed the goblet before drinking the red warm liquid.

Then with a blood stained mouth, he grabbed the once-beating heart AND TOOK A LARGE BITE OF IT.

His eyes widened in utter horror upon back in reality, realizing the truth with blood seeping out from his eyelids, Iko began to back-up, unknowingly about to step off the cliff.

"IKO!"

Screaming out the name of the man she fell in love with, Sun watched along with everyone else as the scarred man ended up falling off the cliff side.

All knew the only thing that's stop the fall were some trees and the rocky river at the bottom, the sounds of impact heard plenty of times.

"KIIFFHH! MMMRRPPHHH!"

Seeing this as his wife and daughter were being dragged away, Meiying giving more muffled yelling, Tint saw his bodyguard leave the scene as with some of the others, making sure to stop his metalbending ally.

"Gao, you stay here and recover that body. We can't leave evidence". he whispered, glancing at the larger man. "Already bad enough you lost control, but we can't have anyone know what went down. So get rid of the trash, you'll have some help."

"Will do, come on!" a perfectly willing Gao called out to two of the thugs while their boss went to join up with the others.

Being left alone, the injured metalbender watched as Fung's body was loaded into the back of one of three vans the Empire Confederates arrived in.

"Alright, now find that fucking ash-maker's corpse and bring him here." Gao demanded, getting some sharp glances back.

"Why do we gotta do it?"

"Because I can't grab hold of the ash-skin with just one hand." The devoted lackey of Tint insisted. "Besides, it won't take that long."

Knowing he had a point, the two thugs left Gao be and began heading down a nearby trail, knowing it went near where Iko fell towards.

Deciding to maybe try focusing on the spiritual aspect of being the Avatar at the moment, after eating lunch with Zarah, Aila had asked Redbear if she could check out his springs.

While thankful she asked first, the North Pole man still felt to make things clear for later reference.

"While I thank you for asking, you and the others can enter anytime you want. Just be sure to be mindful and not to make a mess."

Before she entered, she invited Honei to come with her, maybe the two could meditate together. A kind gesture that her big sister was for, agreeing.

Letting Kuvira and Kallah spend some time together, both sisters made their way down the stone steps leading into the springs, finding a nice place to sit down on.

"So, you think we can manage to get inside Wan Shi Tong's library, maybe get some form of update on his search?" Aila asked her sister, who seemed to think it over.

"Yeah, I'm sure. And you can meet him and his cute Knowledge Seekers."

"Well let's meet 'em."

Both got into a meditation position and began to let themselves relax, instantly feeling the properties of the springs they were in sooth their spirits and souls where they sat.

This was their first time meditating together and they wanted it just right.

Feeling that familiar sensation course through, both sisters opened their eyes and saw where they were after seeing the other's spirit.

To Aila, what she saw looked to be a very large and old library, while with Honei, she saw the place she had been to looked to have been cleaned up, no longer looking like an old spooky place.

"And we're here!" the non-bender grinned, getting herself up on her feet before helping her sister do the same, seeing her marvel at everything around her.

"This is the Wan Shi Tong library?"

"Yeppers." Honei confirmed, looking around the place. "Way I see it, since I've been here before and we were meditating at the same time, your spirit was connected to mine and followed me here." she explained before realizing something.

"HUH, surprised I got all of that down the first time."

"It's like I said, Honei..."

The loud voice speaking behind the two gave them a clue as to who just arrived, both looking to see a familiar giant owl spirit before them.

"You have more spirit than any human I have met." Wan Shi Tong spoke fondly of Honei...

... only for it to be followed up by a massive squeak of amazement sourced from the Avatar herself, approaching the spirit.

"EEEEEEEH, SWEET MERCIFUL KYOSHI, Wan Shi Tong himself!" Aila let out before realizing how she was sound, having to quickly cough into her hand, giving a respectful bow.

"I mean, it's an honor to meet you, Wan Shi Tong, I am Avatar Aila Makimura..."

Seeing this, all the owl spirit did was give a flat glance over at Honei.

"She's your sister?"

Hearing the bemused tone, the tall girl still gave a toothy smile and a thumbs up. "The one and only Avatar... at the moment, the newest one."

"Humm," Wan Shi made a pondering sound, looking closer to Aila, tilting his head, seeing her try not to be scared. "I sense both Aang and Korra in you, as well as the others." he spoke before giving a small laugh.

"Pleasure to have you visit again, Avatar."

Holding a wing out to the side of her head, Wan Shi had to bow back as well to her. "I apologize for our previous meeting and my behavior."

Yet Aila only just gave a light wave of her hand upon hearing that. "Honei told me what happened, and it's alright. I'm thankful she helped you out." she assured him, though she did have to ask something.

"She did also tell me you had the weakness for the Avatar Hunter somewhere among the library," she began, looking around once more. "I can tell you and your friends are still looking for it, do you want some assistance?"

Hearing the kind offer, Wan Shi Tong was able to give a look through his eyes that seemed to show he was happily accepting it.

"We'd gladly welcome it, Avatar Aila and Honei Makimura. Please follow me..."

Both girl's spirits followed the larger one's lead, ready to help with the search...

As some thunder rumbled above in the sky, just starting to just drizzle, the two Confederates' had been walking and looking for ten minutes.

But, like they figured, there they found the body of Iko lying against a broken log along the jagged rock covered shoreline near the river, pieces of broken branches and leaves around him.

Both men, non-benders who still followed Guan's ideology, saw the broken bodied-state of the man before them, blood pooled around him.

"Dang, quite the tumble he took."

"No kidding, them bones look to be fucked."

As they went to grab him, both noticed the metal used to stab Iko and Fung was still embedded in the unmoving man's chest.

"Get that thing out, don't wanna cut myself while carrying him." One requested, to which his partner did so, placing the sharp piece on the side near one of Iko's hands.

"What do you think, Gao hit his heart?" The other asked, which got him a scoff.

"Who cares? Let's just bring the body back-"

"... ugghhh..."

Just then, they heard a labored breath, looking down to see Iko now breathing, yet barely moving as they got a closer look.

"Holy SHIT, he's still alive!" One of the two let out, the other having to shake his head in amusement.

"That's one hard to kill firebreather."

"Well, not for-"

TWO HANDS SUDDENLY ROSE UP AND GRASPED THE TWO BY THE SIDES OF THEIR HEADS BEFORE SWIFTLY SLAMMING THEM AGAINST EACH OTHER, CRACKING THEIR SKULLS OPEN LIKE EGGS ON IMPACT!

"ACHK!"

"UAAGHH!"

With the two dropping dead quickly from the sudden brain trauma, the marked man who had killed them didn't even flinch or blink as his own wounds healed.

Hearing the engine of a vehicle just rumble on, not too far out, he slowly turned towards its direction.

In turn making him start having VERY bad thoughts.

Unknowing of what just happened, Gao was waiting for his allies to come back as he sat in the front seat of the turned-on van, trying to light up a cigarette in his mouth with his good hand for a couple minutes, having some issues.

"Damn, wish I was born a lefty." he complained, unbothered by the corpse in the back of the van.

The sounds of mud being stomped on getting closer got his attention. "Finally!" Gao complained, getting out of the van to be able to look over as the footsteps stopped.

"What took you both so..."

But the metalbender stopped where he was, looking on with his mouth open for his smoke to just fall out.

For it wasn't his fellow Earth Confederacy supporters he was looking at, standing in the now increasing rain...

... it was Iko, standing there like he took no damage, his eyes glaring hate towards him as he breathed heavily, blood still coming from his eyelids and onto his cheeks as with what stained his hands.

Having the same exact look of wrath that the metalbender remembered the first time they met.

Swearing this was impossible for he KNEW he went for a killing blow, Gao just shook his head.

"No, I-I just watched you fall off that damn cliff! You should be DEAD!" He yelled out shook his head, only to see the unkillable just give a tilt of his head and speak.

"You're not the first one to say that to me."

In fear, Gao flung another piece of metal from his waist, getting the fuming man in between the shoulder and chest, surely hitting part of his left lung in the process

Yet Iko just glanced at what poked out of him and yanked it out with ease, making sure the fat toad got a good look at his healing factor in action as he commented on this.

"Avatar Aila took my head clean off my shoulders. Yet she couldn't keep me down."

Trying again, horrified at what he was seeing, the metalbender launched another metal spike, this time aimed right at his stomach.

Feeling it blast through the lower half of his torso, Iko looked down at the large open wound, one that you could see right through his stomach.

And like before, that too healed up without delay, scaring Gao more and more as he backed up against the van in fright.

"Even after mastering all four elements AND the Avatar State, Avatar HO-SEOK couldn't kill me!" the increasingly angered man sneered out, getting closer to his prey...

... just before a rough feeling piece of rock came bursting upwards right against his face!

A last means of defense from Gao, having earthbended a projectile right as the undying stopped right before him, his head leaning back.

Only to look on in abject fear and disturbed horror as Iko rose his head back up, showing that despite having a chunk of his skull and eye socket blasted off, it did NOTHING to deter him as he shook his head.

All the while the one amber eye just bore pure hatred back at him.

Next thing he knew, Gao gasped out in complete agony.

"UGGHHH!"

All thanks to Iko swiftly driving the sharp metal right into his stomach! The same piece that had been used on him and Fung.

Not enough that death would be sudden or quick, but more to just drop the fat slob onto the ground, watching him gag and gasp for air.

"What the FUCK makes you think you stand a chance against me?"

Crying out, Gao realized his liver had been punctured, feeling the darkened blood seep out as the pain was agonizing.

"URGAAHH! Oh my... AAHHH!"

Knowing he wasn't going to get up anytime soon in this state, something got Iko's attention from the corner of his good eye through the open door of the van.

There, lying in the back, was Fung's body, his head wound exposed.

"Yahhh!"

Letting his face and head heal up while making his way over and opening the back doors, the now-healed silent man got a better look at the body. What Gao did to him was instant, no suffering.

Still, that painful feeling he felt with the catdeer did come back.

All Iko could do was look on in shame, reaching forth to close Fung's eyelids before patting his shoulder.

"I'm sorry, my friend." he sadly offered his condolences, hoping the kind man was at some peace in the Spirit World.

"Ughhh... AUGH, why does it hurt SO MUCH?!"

Hearing the gasping voice of the toad, Iko calmly just turned his head slowly towards the bleeding man's direction.

"Do you remember?"

Hearing that, a terrified Gao then swiftly felt himself be grabbed by the head up against the van, forced to look at his attacker...

... seeing for himself as, for the first time in over a week, Iko's amber eyes turned into the empty black ones as he spoke.

"I said... do you remember WHAT I promised to do if Tint didn't heed my warning?"

Moments later...

"This is quite the lovely place."

Tint just strolled around the family room connected to the kitchen, where he had his wife preparing something sweet to eat. Some ice cream with a can of whipped cream and chocolate syrup on the side as the rain kept going in and out, putting some used utensils into the pull out dishwasher while Meiying sat at the table, holding Yippy tightly in her hands.

"Cozy, simple, built with bricks, must have been quite the steal."

Of course, to prevent any issues for him, the suited man made sure Heera and plenty of his fellow confederates all hanging out inside.

"Away from town, nice and private. Just get that barbed wired fence set up and I can get used to chilling here." Tint continued observing the area, checking out the record collection of Sun's.

Saying that, the evil man chose to sit down at the table where some cups of water were, making sure to get a spot right close to his daughter. "I'm sorry about Fung, same with... what was his name, Iko?"

"Kitty..."

Having understood his daughter's way of talking since birth, Tint just nodded. "Yes, him. What happened wasn't planned, but they will get proper burials. Alright?"

"Rabbit, rabbit... Kitty... Toad..." Meiying responded back with, making it clear even with her limited vocabulary, she didn't approve of what her father had endorsed or allowed to happen.

Seeing her oldest friend next to her mother being killed like that, she felt much sadness.

But she was also angry with the man before her.

"Hey, Mr. Fung was being super mean to my friends. And Gao made a foolish mistake, I've done so before. And I promise, he will be punished."

"Dove, dove."

"I told your mommy, and call her mommy, I screwed up and I didn't mean to hurt her."

"Dove."

"Yes, but sometimes, you do need to teach certain people respect and manners."

Even after all this time, knowing right from wrong, Meiying knew what her father really was, making sure he knew she wasn't giving him any respect.

"Snake..."

Hearing that, Tint couldn't help but shake his head, a little annoyed. "Come on, Meiying. I told you, I don't like being called that. I'm your daddy, remember?"

"Snake." she repeated however, showing that she wasn't going to be scared of him. "Snake."

"Daddy."

"Snake... Snake."

"I'm your father."

"Snake! SNAKE!" Meiying yelled back, showing the bravery she felt whenever being around Iko as her mother and others watched her keep calling her father out.

Enough to even get out of her seat, stomping her feet on the ground.

"SNAKE! SNAKE! SNAKE SNAKE SNAKE!"

The sound of a loud smack across the face rang through the room.

"Stop calling me that, YOU FUCKING RETARD!" Tint screamed at the top of his lungs, the force of his hand hitting his daughter's cheek causing her to fall onto the ground.

Sun herself rushed over to her daughter's side, seeing she was starting to cry out in pain.

"Eehhhh..."

"I'M NOT SNAKE, SHE'S NOT DOVE! WE'RE YOUR MOTHER AND FATHER, AND YOU WILL REFER TO US AS SUCH!"

Coming closer herself, Heera kept her distance as she saw the discoloration already forming. "That's going to bruise." she commented.

"Do I give a shit? She can put makeup on!" Tint complained, annoyed at his daughter. "Is it too much to ask, for one minute, to have a child who isn't fucked in the head?!"

"NO SHE'S NOT!" Sun yelled back as she got up, furious at what he had done, only for one of the thugs to grab her before she could hit him back. "She's perfectly fine, unlike YOU! AND IT'S YOUR FAULT IKO AND FUNG ARE DEAD!"

Another smack rang out, right against the woman's face as she stumbled against the table.

The hateful man was prepared to give the order to have her held down, so she could take some lessons from him...

... only for a loud noise to ring out from outside.

"HHOOONNNKKKK!"

It was obvious what that sound was, now being repeated.

"HONK-HONK-HOONNKKK!"

"Whose outside?" One thug asked, with Tint letting go of his initial plan for the time being, looking at Heera.

"Make sure neither of 'em go anywhere." he ordered, which the diamond bender only just nodded, keeping her mouth shut.

Going near the front door of the house, Tint saw one of his men look out the window.

"Isn't that her friend's truck?"

It WAS the familiar truck of Fung's, its high beams on and directed right at the front of the house as the rain poured.

"What the?" Tint asked himself before opening the door, trying to block out the lights with his hand. "HEY, ASSHOLE! Turn down those brights!" he demanded.

At his command, the headlights turned down, leaving only the house's front lights on.

Doing so allowed the cruel man to see a figure having just reached through the open window to do so, making its way in front of the lights.

It was still hard to tell who it was at first. "Goh, is that you?" Tint wanted to know, his squinted eyes now adjusting enough to see who was standing there...

... it was Iko, keeping his amber eyes focused solely on the Earth Confederate. A look of pure silent hatred staring right at him as the raindrops poured around him.

"Well, hello there, Iko!" Tint mockingly welcomed, if surprised to see him still alive. "Almost scared me to death there!"

From where they were, both Sun and Meiying heard their friend's name be called out, shocked that he was still alive. Even Heera was a bit interested in this development.

"Look pretty good for a guy who took a big tumble!" Tint called out, expecting some sort of remark.

But none came.

"Look, I must admit you got a lot of balls trying to shack up with my wife and coming back here. But I'm going to have to ask you to leave."

Iko just stood there, unmoving.

Just breathing deeply without speaking a word, not even blinking while Tint kept getting more annoyed by the second.

"Hey, did you hear me? LEAVE ALREADY, YOU HOMEWRECKER!" he yelled out. "Or else I'll have my friends put you down for good!" was what he threatened with next.

"Regardless, tonight, I'm gonna screw my wife and sleep soundly! NOW FUCK OFF, IKO!"

"My name... is Wolf."

What was spoken with cold fury was something Tint didn't expect to hear, watching the lone man go and take the keys out of the ignition, turning the truck off before heading to the back cab.

Not knowing what he was seeing, the commentator was thinking the man may have been grabbing a weapon.

But that wasn't the case for while he wasn't able to see what was directly being taken out, Tint could see it looked big, with something thick attached and dangling from it.

The combination of the shadows, line of sight and rain made it hard to tell what it was.

Stepping forth back in front of the house's lights, Wolf looked down at what he held.

"You said I almost scared you to death..." His voice broke through loud and clear, raising it up.

All to allow Tint to realize what exactly was being shown to him...

... GOH'S TORN OFF HEAD AND SPINAL CORD!

"AAGHH!" the scared man cried out in fright, before seeing another frightening sight.

Seeing for himself the Avatar Hunter's eyes turning black, the light reflecting off of them as he finished what he had to say.

"... YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT DEATH IS."

Notes:

If anyone gets the Halloween II reference, you're cool. XD Anyways, that's our end of the chapter and while we get some heartwarming interactions with Kuvira and Opal over the phone, as with Honei introducing Aila to Wan Shi Tong, things aren't exactly the best on Iko's end with Sun, Meiying and Fung... for Sun's husband and Meiying's father, Tint makes himself know, along with Gao, Heera and the rest of their Earth Confederate buddies, it very much clear these are bad fucking guys. I mean, DUH.

But while Iko is distracted by Tint looking... so familiar, Fung shows who's side he's staying on and shoots from the hip towards these jerks... only for Gao to suddenly kill him to the families shock, Iko snapping out of his funk and is ready to fight back... but takes another stab to the torso, similar to last time, where he sees just what exactly befell to the original Iko and his family... and what the Cult of Vaatu made Wolf do with what was offered before he falls down a cliff, leaving our baddies to take a mourning Sun and Meiying away, leaving Gao behind with some lackey's to find Iko's body and get rid of it as with Fung's.

But, as I'm sure you all recall, it's HARD to put down Iko, who easily kills the two red-shirts with a double head smash, a Jason Goes to Hell/Sleepwalkers reference, before coming for a disturbed Gao, showing just what exactly he really is... before stabbing the fat toad and sees if he remembers what he warned days before. But that's not seen yet as we see how... awkward it is back at Sun and Meiying's place as Tint tries to play caring daddy and husband, but neither are giving him anything, especially Meiying. And that goes as you read, Tint's true colors showing. But before things can get worse, Iko has arrived and gets everyone's attention, including Tint's as one thing is clear...

... much as Iko wanted to be, well, Iko, he's still Wolf, he's still the Avatar Hunter... but these Earth Confederates have fucking pissed him so much, he's made his message clear as to what's going to happen that they can't prevent, holding up Gao's severed head and spine as the only warning that Death is coming for them all. And if you recall the last time I posted the fic, things will get fucking insane.

Chapter 29: Chapter Twenty Nine- Unforgiven

Notes:

HELLOS! For today's "Rise of Aila" chapter, it's one focusing solely on Wolf and what he intends to do to help out Meiying and Sun after last chapter... suffice to say, this one is going to be action filled, dark and gory. And some dark humor involving some kills.

On the plus side, sneak peak of one of the new Seven Havens episodes came out and we got it confirmed, KORRASAMI MARRIAGE... Well, they're already married, but you know what I meant.

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, including some slurs, spousal/child abuse, strong graphic and gruesome violence and references to past character deaths, including that of children.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

"You labeled me, I'll label you
So I dub thee unforgiven
Never free, never me
So I dub thee unforgiven"
-Metallica "The Unforgiven"

"... YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT DEATH IS."

Fear washing over at what he was seeing, the once brave Tint looked back inside the house.

"Lock the doors. LOCK THE FUCKING DOORS AND WINDOWS!" he screamed out, not even trying to keep a brave tone as he did.

He only looked away for a couple seconds, but when he looked back outside, Wolf was gone.

Only Goh's gasping head and spine laid on the gravel driveway.

Like his killer was never there.

All the man could do was slam the door shut and lock it as quickly as he could, Heera rushing up to him, not knowing what was up.

"What happened?"

"He's here, Iko, he..." he tried to explain, making his way over to where a confused Sun and Meiying were.

"... he killed Goh!"

"That's- NO, he couldn't have!" Sun called out, shaking her head. "Iko wouldn't-"

"Apparently I wasn't even talking to him, called himself Wolf!" Tint yelled back before getting an idea, grabbing his wife by the wrist.

"You and Meiying are coming-"

He didn't finish his words since Meiying herself broke free, ran to where the dirty utensils in the open dishwasher were, grabbed a sharp knife before slashing it along the hand of the closest thug, slicing it deep across his palm!

"AAGGHHH! FUCKING SHIT!" he screamed out, holding his wounded hand out in pain.

Seeing everyone distracted, the child ran off, rushing her way out of sight with the knife, the others aghast to have seen this while Heera approached the injured. "Calm down and get some rags to stop the bleeding!" she ordered, losing her grip on Sun.

"MEIYING!" she yelled out, trying to follow her daughter, only for Tint to grab her quickly.

"No you don't!" he called out while Heera looked at the others.

"Make sure no one goes in or out, and if you find his daughter, bring her to Sun's bedroom!"

With that, she and Tint dragged Sun out of the room, to try hiding while leaving the others, all either earthbender's of some sort or non-benders, to make sure the place was locked down.

All of them went to make sure every door or window that could be used to get inside was locked up, making sure there was no way a non-bender could get in.

Every Earth Confederate did as they were told, going to any and all entry points and locking them.

With matters dealt with minutes later, the group of supporters regrouped in the living room. "Alright, that should be all, right?" the lone female member spoke up before another noticed something off.

"Wait, where's Chang?"

"Think he went to close the backdoor." another answered before looking around. "Two of you check."

Giving nods, two of the thugs made their way to where they knew the backdoor was, seeing it was closed and locked. "Well, answers one question." one figured before both heard a wet sound from below...

… just then noticing the muddy footprints on the floor they just stepped on.

Having come from the outside, leading into the slightly-ajar closet near them.

"GUYS!"

The rest rushed over to where the two were in front of the now-open closet.

Where Chang's propped-up corpse was, with what looked like barbed wire tightly wrapped around his neck. Enough to have sliced deeply into his throat!

"Aww, SHIT!" One of the thugs cursed out at seeing the bloodied corpse. "How'd no one hear that?!"

And then the lights to the whole place turned off, followed by... the music of a rock band?

Sourced from a record player was some rock song playing from the vinyl, the jamming instruments and synthesizer of the song ring out, followed by those from keyboards.

This got Tint and Heera confused where they hid themselves and Sun.

With the mother knowing WHO had turned it on.

"We gotta find and waste this guy." One spoke up over the music, with the others in agreement as they all went to do so, giving each other quiet hand signals to try hunting down and killing the intruder as they all separated.

Each went into different parts of the house as the powerful, soulful vocals of the male singer sang out.

"Feeling down 'n' dirty, feeling kinda mean..."

A metalbender ventured towards the open bathroom, ready for anything while a non-bender Confederate followed behind, a good sized hatchet in hand he was about to turn on, his back to another open door as the vocalist sang out the lyrics.

Such a poor move on his part when SOMEONE quickly grabbed him from behind, his mouth covered before being pulled into the room swiftly, the door closing shut as soon as they were in.

"I've been from one to another extreme..."

Inside the bedroom, a silent Wolf was fast to dispatch the struggling muffled man, easily lifting him by the throat into the air and slamming him BACK FIRST ONTO THE RAISED FOOT BOARD!

"ERRUGH!"

THE IMPACT SNAPPING HIM IN TWO, COMPLETE WITH A LOUD BREAKING CRUNCH!

"It's time I had a good time, ain't got time to wait..."

Having not heard that over the music, the metalbender in the bathroom focused on the closed plastic curtains of the shower stall, pushing them along.

Not able to find his target hiding behind them, shaking his head...

"No, too easy..."

... leaving him a sitting turtle-duck for the blade of the hatchet that was then raised up behind him...

"I wanna stick around 'til I can't see straight..."

... before it was brought down upon his shoulder, chopping right into it!

"FAAHHH!"

As if that wasn't bad enough as he fell onto one knee, THE HATCHET WAS PULLED OUT BEFORE COMING BACK DOWN HARD ONTO THE TOP OF HIS HEAD, CHOPPING THE WHOLE THING IN TWO DOWN TO THE NECK!

"Fill my eyes with that double vision..."

All before Wolf threw the corpse and the weapon into the open shower and leaving for another part of the house he knew more than the Confederates, keeping to the shadows.

Another Earth Empire supporter ventured into a walk-in pantry near the kitchen, having a flashlight of his own as he scanned around.

Though there wasn't much room for anything to hide in there really, feeling pretty dumb.

"No disguise for that double vision..."

Something that wouldn't be the case for any longer upon TWO POWERFUL HANDS grasping his neck as he turned around, dropping his flashlight in the process as both struggled along the kitchen!

"UGAHH!" he gasped out in surprise as Wolf now had trying to choke the life out the confederate up against the counter near the open dishwater!

"AUGGH! ACCKK!"

"Ooh, when it gets through to me, it's always new to me..."

As cabinet doors and kitchen appliances were knocked and smashed into during the struggle, the Hunter suddenly then threw and slammed the human down...

... upper back first onto the still exposed open door of the dishwasher, AS WITH ALL OF THE SHARP AND POINTED KITCHEN UTENSILS THAT WERE LEFT BLADES UP!

"AHH! Yahh!"

"My double vision gets the best of me..."

Coughing out blood upon the initial puncture and harsh landing, the man then saw Wolf grab hold of the folded-out door with both hands...

"Huh?"

... BEFORE BELTING OUT A HORRIFIED SCREAM UPON THE HUNTER SLAMMING THE DISHWASHER DOOR SHUT WITH HIM STILL STUCK IN-BETWEEN, PRACTICALLY CRUSHING HIM IN AT THE WAIST UPON THE CRUNCHING IMPACT!

"UAAAHHH!"

Then hearing the sounds of footsteps coming, no doubt from someone having heard the ruckus over the expertly played music, Wolf got himself ready, hiding in a shadowy corner. as the jamming music kept on playing.

Another confederate rushed in, the lone female naturally alerted by the sight of the lower half of a body and a single twitching arm sticking out between the dishwasher and it's door due to the beam of the flashlight's light shining at it.

"Oh, FUCK!"

"Never do more than I, I really need..."

It was actually downright insulting at how easy this was for Wolf as he came up behind the human with the ice cream scooper he grabbed off the table...

Right before he then swiftly brought the base of it down hard onto the top of the confederate's head!

"EEGAAHH!"

The suddenness of the base of her head being hit made the woman gasp out, feeling herself stumble forth against the counter as the back of her head was pounding.

"My mind is racing, but my body's in the lead..."

"Ahhhh!" she whined out, now feeling her head bleed before feeling the hard grip grab hold of the back of her head...

... only for Wolf to slam her EYE SOCKET FIRST ONTO THE TOP OF THE AEROSOL CAN HE NOW HELD DOWN ONTO THE COUNTER, THE FORCE OF THE HIT CAUSING THE NOZZLE TO BURST OUT THE BACK OF HER SKULL WITH EASE, INSTANTLY FOLLOWED BY BRAIN MATTER, BLOOD, BONE AND WHIPPED CREAM!

"Tonight's the night, I'm gonna push it to the limit..."

All before throwing the female Confederate to the floor before the mess in the dishwasher.

Making his way out, the blackened-eyed man switched his weapon with that of a simple thin yellow plastic bag on his way out. The kind that you'd get at a grocery store to carry groceries out with.

For Wolf heard some noise coming from near the bathroom, sneaking over near the open door, knowing no one had found the two bodies in the bedroom or bathroom yet.

Keeping out of sight as he waited by the passageway, he spotted one of the Supremacists shaking his head after having found nothing in Meiying's room, closing the closet door.

"I live all of my years in a single minute..."

The guy looked to have a series of heavy spiked brass knuckles, a strike based fighter...

... and like clockwork, once the idiot got close enough, Wolf quickly slipped the plastic bag over the man's head.

Making sure to keep his grip tight as frantic muffled breathing let loose from the now panicking Earth Supremacist once the suffocation began!

"URRPHH MPPPHH! AAHPP!"

"Fill my eyes with that double vision..."

But the Avatar Hunter had no time to waste, keeping hold of the bag and his target by the neck with one hand as he let loose a flurry of punches to the face with the other fist!

Four in total with each one looking draw blood from the Supremacist's mouth and nose, which began to fill up inside the still-sealed bag!

All done without needing brass knuckles.

"No disguise for that double vision..."

But a broken jaw or drowning in his own blood wouldn't be what killed the suffering man with his gurgling muffled...

"Gurghhh.."

...due to Wolf grabbing him by both sides of the head and TWISTED his head sideways hard, the loud snap of his neck ringing out as the body plopped onto the ground!

Spotting some movement nearby, whoever was behind it not noticing any of what just happened, Wolf narrowed his eyes and moved.

"Ooh, when it gets through to me, it's always new to me..."

In a dark study room, yet another non-bending Earth Confederate had ventured into it, keeping his attention focused as he held a primed crossbow in hand.

He then focused on flicking a switch on the wall to light up the room, surprised to see it actually turn on...

... not realizing his target had just snuck up behind him, suddenly appearing like a dark spirit as the music kept playing.

"My double vision always seems to get the best of me..."

The sound of the floorboard then creaking behind him over the vocalist's singing was the ONLY warning the armed Confederate had before turning around...

... right then seeing an advancing Wolf raise up and slam a closed fist down onto the top of this skull!

A hit hard enough to ACTUALLY DRIVE THE ENTIRE HEAD INTO HIS NECK AND CHEST CAVITY, DOWN TO EYE LEVEL WITH A LOUD WET SQUISH!

"EGGH!"

Like he was playing a game of 'Whack-A-Badgermole' and his fist was the hammer.

"The best of me, yeah-hah, yeah..."

Seeing the frozen open eyes of the man whose body wobbled in place, dropping what he held while now a few inches shorter, a morbidly curious Wolf just poked the bloodied chest to just push it to the ground.

Something that got attention.

"Check out the basement, I got the study room..."

"Keep your eyes out."

Just hearing the whispered voices of the remaining Confederates wondering what the loud noise was over the music, Wolf was prepared to leave, stealth seeming to work so far...

"(Ooh) double vision... (Ooh) I need double vision..."

... when he spotted what the corpse on the ground dropped, guessing how it worked as the outro kept on playing.

By the time another thug, an earthbender, had rushed onto the scene, he only saw the deceased laying on the floor.

Kneeling down to get a closer look, he covered his mouth with his hand at seeing how deep the bashed-in head was in the torso, trying not to vomit.

"Fuck this shit. This ain't worth being killed over." he commented, standing back up...

"(Ooh, double vision) It takes me out of my head, taking me out of my head..."

...not realizing the pointed bolt loaded into the crossbow was aimed RIGHT BEHIND HIM...

... until it was too late when the arrow was shot into the back of his neck and BURST OUT OF THE FRONT OF HIS THROAT, stuck in there!

"URGKK..."

"(Ooh, double vision) I get my double vision, oh..."

The wide eyed man stumbled about out of the room, choking out blood of his mouth, SOMEHOW STILL ALIVE as the lyrics of the song rang out of a ironic soundtrack to his suffering.

Lowering the crossbow he just fired with one hand, Wolf watched him stumble more, struggling to breathe.

"URHHHK..."

"(Ooh, double vision) Seeing double-double..."

Following him into the living room, the Hunter took the bloodied bolt end of the arrow in his free hand and forcibly yanked it out of the man's throat.

With that, the follower fell forth hard, right into the stand where the record player was, crashing on top of it, finally dead.

"(Ooh, double vision) Oh, oh, my double vis-"

The loud screeching scratch of the player's needle sliding along the grooves of the record was the last thing heard from the speakers as the player and vinyl broke under the dead man's weight.

Shame too, because Wolf really liked that song.

Having no further use for the crossbow, the Hunter discarded it and focused on whoever was his wife's room, having been listening to the slaughter, Tint couldn't believe how easy this guy was effortlessly killing his supporters, keeping Sun close with her hands behind her back with stone cuffs he bended up.

But an idea did come to mind as he looked at Heera, her having heard everything. "Heera," he whispered, getting her attention. "That thing comes in here, you have to fight him."

That idea, in of itself, sounded so dumb to the diamond bender.

"Did you hear WHAT'S GOING ON!?" she hissed in a low tone.

"Kill him and I'll double your pay!"

"Not even if you triple it."

"Four times!"

"... Augh, fine."

As the two whispered, Sun herself just sat on her bed, knowing fully well what Wolf had done in the past.

But nothing on this scale just from sound alone.

Down in the basement, there was still another inside the house, trying to think to herself.

Meiying heard the noises upstairs, but wasn't fully aware Wolf was responsible. Regardless, the girl knew she had to get help for her and her mother.

And she saw it was possible through an unlocked basement window she could fit through.

The only problem was that it was up too high, so she had to put down the knife to create a form of makeshift tower made of random boxes, hoping it'd stay nice and study.

Putting the last onto the increasingly tall stack, it was too much and it fell down, disappointing the young girl who pouted to herself, keeping quiet.

Looking at her stuffed animal, Meiying knew Yippy wasn't judging her, knowing Wolf would tell her she was still smart for putting in the effort.

"THERE YOU ARE!"

One of her father's thugs, the one whose hand she cut into, had appeared to taking her by the hand that held Mr. Yippy.

"AAHHH! NEEHHHH! YAAAGGHHH!" Meiying yelled out, realizing she couldn't break free as the mean man kept trying to drag her away.

"Shut up, you stupid brat!"

Realizing pulling away wasn't working and she wasn't close to the knife, the autistic child got another idea and bit down on the man's injured hand, hard enough to draw more blood.

And it worked, feeling herself let go as she fell to the ground, the man recoiling in pain.

"OWW! DAMMIT!"

As she recovered, Meiying realized to her fright that part of the frog squirrel toy's leg was torn in the process, some of it's fluff exposed. "YIPPY!" she whined, her back to the hurt man.

"Little bitch, you're gonna get it!" the hurt man hurled at her, ready to hurt Meiying as she turned around in fear...

... only to see for herself a form come out of the shadows swiftly to grab the Confederate by the coat collar and slam the side of his head against the wall.

"Oww!"

Caught by surprise, having whined out while being held up against the brick wall, the injured man turned to see who did that.

Only for the last thing he'd see was the swung closed fist of the sneering blackened-eyed Wolf come smashing directly into his face!

Swift and hard enough TO CAVE IN THE BASTARD'S HEAD INTO A MESS OF BLOOD AND GORE AGAINST THE WALL UPON IMPACT!

"KITTY!"

Meiying called out in happiness, rushing over to the unkillable being who saw her, his eyes going back to amber as he felt the body go.

All to kneel down and welcome her hug with a soft one of his own. "Kitty, kitty... Rabbit..."

"I know, I know," Wolf understood her pain, wondering while looking at her face. "Where's your mother?"

The autistic girl pointed up to the ceiling, "Dove." she said, not caring that Wolf had just slain someone in front of her. If anything, she was just happy that her friend was there to save her and Sun.

And would avenge Fung's murder.

"Her bedroom, alright."

Just then, Meiying pointed at the window nearby. "Kitty..." she pointed out, with Wolf indeed getting the idea, helping her up as she opened up the window, able to crawl through it.

As she was outside, the rain calming down, Wolf saw the tear on Yippy. "Yippy's hurt." he noted, which got him a nod, knowing it must have been bad for Meiying to see.

"Don't worry, he'll be alright. Like your mother."

"Rabbit?" the girl asked, getting a sad nod back.

"I didn't leave Fung alone, I called the cops to come to the falls before coming here. Now go get help!"

That Meiying made sure to do, running off into the night, leaving Wolf alone.

He knew what had to be done, ready to head back upstairs.

Knowing only two were left in its way of saving Sun, the Hunter decided to speak loudly as it stood at the doorway.

"They're all dead, Tint! Something I can't know of, because no matter what happens, I can't die..."

Making its way down the hall, Wolf kept talking. "Do you know what I was before arriving in town? A weapon made to do Vaatu's bidding. To hunt down the Avatar and kill them, to end the chain..."

Inside the bedroom, the three listened in silence, knowing he was coming, taking his time.

"And while I failed to do that, I DID manage to kill Avatar Ho-Seok in combat oh so long ago. With my bare hands, before being trapped..." they heard Wolf reveal, hearing how honest he sounded, quick to realize he wasn't lying.

Looking at his hands, Wolf felt the regret he felt for doing such a thing, as well as what else he had done.

"But then, I was recently freed to go after Avatar Aila, I had tried to hunt her down and kill her. But what I didn't know was HOW I was made, who had to die so Vaatu and that damn cult could have their weapon." it spoke, knowing another was listening, needing her to know the truth.

"I didn't fully realize Iko and his family were murdered just to create me, an innocent man who had everything he loved TAKEN AWAY! All just so I could come into existence!"

Hearing such information shook Sun to the core, realizing it all made so much sense as she and the other two heard more of Wolf speaking.

"But you want to know something? Being in this new world, meeting kind and caring people... like Sun, Meiying and Fung." he spoke more, his voice getting louder.

"They showed me that I have a choice. That I don't need to be Vaatu's hunter, to be that monster anymore. I can be just as human as them if I allowed myself, learn from them. Let myself get away from the violence, live a life of MY OWN, have my own friends and family! Those I've grown to care for, TO LOVE!"

Wolf then stopped in front of the door, thinking of the wonderful memory of the night of passion he experienced with Sun inside this very room the night before, closing his eyes.

But the anger he felt towards the cruel man filled his heart.

"But YOU won't let me have it, Tint. You hurt those I care for, let a good man DIE..."

Glaring angrily at the door, knowing he was in there, Wolf just grasped his hands tightly.

"... that's why I'm going to kill you." he snarled out, going to reach his hand towards the door handle...

... only for the door itself to break apart, the Hunter just then seeing it was Heera responsible, smashing her way through with her diamond hand and trying to grab at him.

Wolf attempted to grab at the false limb, but to his surprise, the bender was plenty strong herself and the mineral was even harder than expected.

Seeing his chance while the Hunter was distracted, Tint ran out of the bedroom, keeping his grip tight on his wife, who called out to it.

"WOLF!"

Both the Hunter and the diamond bender were in each other's grasps as they struggled along the house, neither seeing one escape outside with his hostage.

Figuring one of the satomobile vans around still had keys, the cruel man was dismayed to see the engines of each one looked to have been wrecked and destroyed beyond repair.

Almost like Wolf had known he would try escaping.

"FUCK!" Tint screamed out at this as Sun turned her attention back to the brawl inside.

At the same time, Meiying had been running down the long driveway, looking to the nearest road ahead...

... but she stopped, having to turn back around.

Looking down at Yippy, making the stuffed toy's head move like he was talking to her, the young girl knew that even though Wolf told her to get help, she couldn't leave her friend and mother behind.

Making her choice, the child ran back in the direction she came from.

Wolf felt the fist of hard diamond smash against his face before it too hit his leg, yelling out as Heera was ready to keep going.

"Rahh!"

Even with a healing factor, those punches still really hurt.

Stranger, it seemed as though none of what the Hunter did could hurt her truly like the rest of the humans he easily killed with his strength.

Which meant either he was getting weaker, or the female was more durable than she looked.

But Wolf wasn't letting some bender with a fake hand get in his way, charging back at her into a wall, in turn both crashed not just through it, but another in the hallway, ending up on the bathroom floor!

Both got up, the human with more ease than expected for Heera was quick to take the cabinet door and swung it open right into her opponent's face, watching the mirror shatter into pieces.

Getting an idea, Wolf quickly took one shard from the sink and jammed it right above her right breast...

... only to see her no-selling the stabbing, shaking her head to his surprise.

"Really, you stabbed me in the boob?" Heera had to comment before she bended her diamond hand into a spike and jabbed it multiple times into the screaming being's stomach.

"AGGHH!"

With enough stabs, Heera then threw Wolf through the doorway and back into the hallway.

Outside, seeing this was taking too long, Tint had a horrible idea, dragging Sun along, over around the back of the property.

He looked where a certain thing was through the kitchen window before bending a stone pillar from the ground to smash the wall open.

Slipping inside, making sure none of the two still fighting noticed him, the earthbender went over to the stove, past the bodies and moved it from the wall to see where the propane line was and pulled at it enough for it to get loose.

With the sound of the gas hissing out, Tint rushed out as quickly as he could, trying to look for something in his jacket as Sun didn't realize what was up.

Right as both the fight ended up in the kitchen, neither caring about the two bodies, Heera smashing a blender on top of Wolf's head to knock him against the sink.

This left the Hunter's right arm left open for the diamond bender to take hold of and, with surprising strength of her own, jerked it down just enough for broken bone to burst through through the skin of his wrist!

"YAAHHH!" Wolf yelled out, that one actually hurting before experiencing himself being made to hit himself in the face with his own exposed bones!

"Gahh! Ahh!"

A quick trick done by Heera before she bended spikes from her diamond hand and inflicted more damage with punches onto his back and chest.

"YAHH! AHH!"

Yelling out in pain, the Hunter wasn't giving up as he grabbed hold of the diamond hand with his good hand and tried to push her away, ignoring the stabbing pain...

... only for both to hear cracking, the sound coming from the diamond appendage as cracks begin to form.

Heera couldn't believe it, but Wolf wasn't arguing, closing his hand tighter.

All before the diamond hand broke apart!

"What the...?!"

Seeing the handicapped woman distracted as she tripped backwards against the counter near the sink, Wolf didn't waste the chance and swung his broken wrist right into the side of her neck like a punch, CAUSING HIS EXPOSED BROKEN WRIST BONES TO PUNCTURE IT DEEPLY!

"GAHCKK! ACCKK!" came choking out of the wide-eyed Heera, coughing up blood as she shook in place.

But having seen her shake things off, the Avatar Hunter wasn't taking any chances as he pulled his broken bone out the bleeding wound BEFORE STABBING HER AGAIN in the same area, CAUSING MORE BLOOD TO SQUIRT OUT!

"URCK... urrg..."

Getting another five quick neck stabbings in before twisting the exposed bones about, Wolf finally saw the life leave those shocked eyes.

Glad that the diamond bender was finally dead., he just noticed an unfamiliar smell filling his nostrils...

... just in time for Tint to find the flip lighter he had been looking for and light it up, throwing it through the hole in the side of the house and rushing as quickly as he could past Sun.

The propane ignited, causing A MASSIVE EXPLOSION TO GO OFF, blowing the brick house into pieces in a fireball, knocking the two off their feet as debris fell everywhere around them!

To Sun as she recovered, she could only look on in dismay at her home being destroyed, as well as presumably Wolf with her hearing somewhat faded...

... and she still didn't know where her daughter was.

"DOVE!"

Both adults saw Meiying rushing towards the burning blaze, shocked at what her father had done.

"Kitty!" the child cried out before seeing Tint was happy at what he had done. "SNAKE! SNAKE!" she yelled out, grabbing a rock and threw it at his back, ready to pound her fists against him.

"OW! DAMNIT!" he yelled, once more smacking his daughter down to the ground the second she got close enough.

"Cut that shit out, you little dumbass!"

But Sun, still cuffed, had it at this point, crawling over to Meiying, seeing for herself that she was knocked out from the hit.

"YOU FUCKING SON OF A BITCH! That's ANOTHER person you got killed, AND hurt your daughter. YOU'RE FUCKING SICK!" she called him out.

"NO, I'm pure! I got rid of one of the many ruining our world!" Tint yelled back, having lost it now. "HE WAS TRYING TO DESTROY OUR FAMILY!"

"NO, YOU'RE THE ONE TO BLAME! YOU KEEP HURTING OUR FAMILY!" Sun shot back, not caring for the enraged look on Tint's face.

"It doesn't matter, WOLF'S FUCKING DEAD! AS SHOULD THE REST OF THOSE NOT PURE LIKE THE EARTH-"

A LARGE THICK METAL SHAPE HAD BEEN FLUNG RIGHT AT HIS BACK, MAKING HIM CRY OUT AS HE HIT THE GROUND!

"YAAGHHH!"

At that moment, all the bravado of his left upon him falling right onto the ground before Sun, who looked up to see a shocking sight.

One that a strained Tint turned to see as well, fear coming forth tenfold...

... for standing among the fiery wreckage was Wolf himself, having risen up like a burnt ghoul from those horror movers. The ones who ate the flesh of the living.

Clad in only burnt pants, the horrible-looking Hunter began to walk through the remains with no issue, having just grabbed and thrown the large broken dishwasher door after it landed near him in the explosion.

Ignoring the amount of pain he should be in from all the massive blackened burns, exposed flesh and bone all over his body, with one glazed over white eye and even part of the skull seen.

Even more disturbing for the two witnesses was that even as Wolf walked through the burning remains, the body was healing every wound it took, even a broken collarbone that he re-adjusted back into place like nothing as he spoke out more.

"I told you, Tint... I CAN'T die..."

The only thing a positively frightened Tint, his spine in so much agonizing pain, could do now as he got closer and closer was gawk in horror.

Before he could attempt to escape, the wounded man then felt a foot harshly planted onto his injured lower back.

"GAHHH!"

Seeing that sight caught Sun by surprise, watching as the man she cared for grabbed her screaming husband's left arm and jerked it up from behind.

"Ugaahhh... Ahh, noooo..."

"How do you like it, Tint?" Wolf rhetorically asked, tilting his head. "How's it feel to be helpless?"

Before he could answer, the most intense pain Tint ever felt up to this point happened upon the unkillable rose his other foot up BEFORE STOMPING IT DOWN ONTO THE MIDDLE OF HIS RAISED ARM, SNAPPING IT IN TWO AT A HORRIBLE ANGLE!

"YAAAGGGGHHHH!"

Not letting up upon the scream of the suffering human ringing out in his ears, the enraged Hunter, seeing flashes of that damned Cult of Vaatu leader in his place, forcibly rolled Tint onto his back and got on top of him to prevent any escape.

All as he began to grasp something off to the side, wanting Tint to see what he grabbed and easily rose up...

"Helpless against someone STRONGER THAN YOU?!"

"No! NOO!"

... FOR WOLF THEN THREW A CLOSED FIST RIGHT DOWN INTO THE DEFENSELESS MAN'S FACE, CAVING TINT'S NOSE IN WITH THE FIRST BLOODY HIT!

"EGHHNNN!"

"TELL ME!"

And the roaring Wolf wouldn't stop as he delivered hit after hit with his fist, ensuring every second was full of pain for Tint while still keeping him alive. For all the pain and suffering he caused.

And all that Wolf saw flashed before his eyes of what Iko and his family endured as blood splattered up onto his face with each punch.

The senseless deaths that came to create him, what that damn cult forced him to do!

TO DRINK THE BLOOD OF IKO'S CHILDREN AND EAT THE HEART OF THE WOMAN HE LOVED!

It truly enraged Wolf to remember what he had done, disgusted at the horrible things he'd do after! All the pain and suffering HE CAUSED!

All the while seeing flashes of the cult leader himself being beaten, sharing the defenseless man's face, the Hunter had one other thing in mind as he gave the STILL barely breathing man something to remember as he reached to grab something.

"... eehhh..."

"This... is for Iko..."

Growling that out, WOLF THEN ROSE UP AND SLAMMED DOWN THE EDGE OF THE DENTED DISHWASHER DOOR ONTO TINT'S RUINED FACE, CONTINUING WITH THE HITS!

WITH EACH ONE CRUSHING THE SKULL MORE AND MORE AS BLOOD AND BRAIN MATTER SPLATTERING UP AND HITTING WOLF'S FACE!

And each time the blunt metal hit Tint's increasingly flattened face and head, the more Wolf kept seeing all those he killed! Those who died because of him!

The good people and the bad.

And after enough hits, WOLF LET OUT A MASSIVE ROAR AS HE WANTED THE SIGHTS TO STOP!

"RWAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!"

Getting one last hit in, 67 in combined total, Tint's head having been rendered into a wet red stain on the grass by the 42nd one, the marked being felt his head clear up, eyes turning back to amber as he threw the dishwasher door to the side...

... only to quickly realize that Sun had just witnessed what he had done, knowing what he really was.

Wiping his face of blood, Wolf began approaching the awestruck woman still restrained.

"Hold still..." he spoke, getting close enough to her to easily break the stone cuffs with his hands, before feeling her arms wrap around tightly.

That was surprising.

"Wolf, you just-"

"Yeah..."

Looking at him all over, giving attention to the marking on his chest, Sun had to know as she looked back into Wolf's weary eyes.

"Is it true, what you said? That you've killed Avatar... a-and Iko? The real one, he's..."

All she got was a quiet nod, starting to understand how he worded things in the past. How he hid the painful truth.

Even still, there was still something good Sun saw in him, bringing her lips to his own, kissing Wolf with as much passion as she could give...

... yet she quickly realized the Hunter didn't make an effort to return the favor, seeing something else was on his mind as he pulled away.

A thought he knew would hurt the woman he loved.

"... I'm sorry, I can't."

And then, the sounds of sirens were heard from afar. The unkillable knew that it meant local authorities weren't far behind, believing it was best to make his leave.

Getting up, seeing Sun not knowing what he was doing, Wolf looked ahead towards the nearby forest.

"I'm sorry about Fung. I made sure to report to the local authorities what Gao did to him on the drive here." he told her, glancing at where Meiying was.

"Tell Meiying I'm sorry. Goodbye, Sun..."

With that, the Avatar Hunter began walking away from the scene, leaving Sun behind to be at her daughter's side.

Even without hearing him explain himself, the mother already could tell Wolf was ashamed of what he had given into and that she had to see it for herself.

Looking back at the burning remains of the home she and the others made, Sun could only think of how the only positive thing out of all of this was that Tint was dead...

... but at the cost of losing a friend and the man she sincerely fell in love with.

A stirring happened next to her, seeing her daughter slowly awaken from being hit. "Meiying, are you okay?" she asked her daughter, seeing her eyes open, looking around.

"Dove? Dove... Snake?"

Hearing her, Sun nodded her head. "Yes... he's gone." she answered, making sure her daughter didn't see her father's remains.

Looking around and hearing the sirens, Meiying was about to cover her ears when she spotted something far off behind her mother that took her attention away.

"Kitty?" she asked, spotting her friend walking away. "Kitty..."

"Meiying, I-"

But Meiying managed to escape Sun's arms as she tried to speak, turning to see her looking out to where Wolf was going.

"Kitty! KITTY!" she kept calling out, wanting her friend to stop and acknowledge her, but it wasn't working.

Willing herself, the ten year old tried as she stuttered.

"Kitty, d-d... do... don... Don't go..."

Sun couldn't believe what she just heard her daughter say for the first real time as Meiying called out as loud as she could.

"WOLF, DON'T GO!"

That did it, Wolf stopping where he was, turning around just enough. Which was all Meiying needed before rushing over to him, getting close enough until she stopped, seeing the shape he was in.

"Hey, you're speaking clearly." he noted, seeing the girl realize it and nodding, seeing the confusion on her face.

"Whe... Wher... Where... you... Go... Where are… you going?" she asked, not knowing what he was doing.

Something Wolf felt she couldn't know, not after everything. But he had to be honest to an extent, kneeling down in front of her with a hand on her shoulder.

"I'm sorry. But I have to leave. I can't stay with you and your mother."

"W... Why?"

"Because I can't forgive myself for what I've done in the past. What I am."

Saying that, Wolf realized the more he answered, the more reality was sinking in.

"People have suffered, both the good and bad. I've hurt so many."

Even more so when Wolf had realized how easy it was to give in back to the violence, what he was made to do.

Glancing over to where Sun was, the Hunter could see the woman look so hurt at not having her feelings returned.

He hoped she understood the reason why.

"As much as I want to stay with you two, and I REALLY DO, this is no place for someone like me. Violence will always be a part of who I am..." Wolf had to make it clear to his friend, feeling horrible saying that, even feeling a bit teary eyed.

"... Fung died on my watch, our friend. I can't let more people I care for share the same fate."

Hearing that, Meiying went to wipe the tears he shed off with her hand.

"But... Y-you.. You're my... Fri-Friend... Our pro-pro... protector..." she teared up herself, not wanting to lose another she cared for and bonded with.

Hearing that stung, but Wolf was sure. "You don't need me to protect you. I saw you fighting to save Yippy, guessing you broke free on your own?" he asked, seeing her remember what she had done, nodding.

That put a faint smile on his face.

"Then you're just as much of a protector as I am. And I'll always be your friend."

Sadly understanding, Meiying gave Wolf a big hug, the biggest she could ever give, not wanting to let go.

Something her friend returned dearly, knowing this was it.

Letting go, Wolf began to stand up, seeing Meiying back up before spotting something.

"Wolf, Your eyes."

Hearing that, the marked being realized more blood was seeping from his eyelids.

Seeing the worry grow on the child's face, Wolf just shook his head, putting on a smile.

"Goodbye, Princess Meiying..."

With that, the Avatar Hunter once more turned around and walked away from the scene as the young girl rushed back to her mother, seeing she was just as saddened to see him go.

Still, Meiying turned to look back at where Wolf was heading, noticing the small stumble in his step as he kept going.

That made the young girl begin to worry as police satomobiles and fire trucks had finally begun pulling up to the property.

Despite knowing it wouldn't work, the young girl had to call out one final time.

"WOLF! COME BACK!"

And it didn't, Wolf just kept walking into the forest, vanishing into the night as his eyes started to water.

Not stopping, nor caring which direction it went, the Hunter just kept walking...

... knowing of the new life he knew he could have, but couldn't.
