Chapter 32: Chapter Thirty Two- Blood, Bone, Metal and Sand

Notes:

Its a new Rise of Aila chapter and... well, a BIG moment will happen this chapter. Not THE big moment of the fic, but close... you'll see.

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, strong violence and fighting as well as gruesome moments, including a distressful one. Again, you'll see.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Once both were close enough, Aila used her airbending to vault herself over the advancing opponent and lashed down some of her platinum right down onto its shoulder.

A whip-like crack was heard quickly as she landed, turning around quickly to see Wolf stop in place, waiting for what was next...

... then something red began to go down its back, down the shoulder blade before it looked like he had been sliced deeply, going through his jacket and shirt, ending around the top of the left lung.

But she wasn't surprised to see her foe still moving, reaching up as she saw for herself the wound heal up until it was back to normal, Wolf turning around to look back at her, glaring annoyed at what she just did.

"Is that it, Avatar?" He spoke back.

Seeing her look somewhat distracted, Wolf then got close enough to grab the Avatar by the throat and threw her off to the side into a food stand, knocking cooking supplies and the stand itself on the ground as she landed hard.

Getting up onto her knees, Aila saw her opponent rush towards her, prepared to raise his foot up high when close enough.

Not wanting to know what would be the outcome of that foot colliding with her jaw, Aila rolled out of the way, punching forth some bursts of fire from her fists, seeing them connect and hit their target.

Growling out at the heat, Wolf looked to where she was, snarling as he came back at her, hand out when it heard another lash crack out in the sky, the platinum she bended striking his wrist.

This time, the right hand instantly fell off the wrist, sliced off, blood squirting out onto the sandy ground.

Once more feeling that slicing lash, all the Hunter could do was just reach down and pick his hand up off the sand, letting Aila get to see him plant the bloody end of the limb to the stump.

Within a few seconds, the hand was reattached with ease, flesh, skin and bone merging together until it was finished.

That done, Wolf then glared back at the Avatar, shaking his head as he then began to wiggle a single finger back and forth.

Kicking up with his foot a stray cutting knife from the food card, the powerful man caught it and then threw it right at Aila's face.

But the Avatar was quick to stop it in mid-air and flung it back with her bending, the blade spinning.

The knife's handle end was what hit Wolf in the face, only serving to make him growl out in annoyance...

"Ow! Alright, that's just insult-"

... all the distraction she needed as Aila made sure to run and jump up in the air, using his chest as a springboard to deliver a spinning roundhouse kick in the air, spinning him back.

As she landed, Aila then waved both of her arms in a X formation, letting forth two air swipes at Wolf, seeing the attack connect.

In turn knocking him back hard enough to crash against a nearby parked Satomobile.

"Come on, is that all you got? You're boring me!" She mocked the big bad hunter of Avatar's, realizing how easy this was.

Hearing the mocking comment however only served to annoy Wolf, the unkillable then turning around at what he collided into.

Getting an idea, the Hunter pulled open the driver's side door of the vehicle and ripped it off its hinges.

All to fling it right towards the cocky Avatar, who on instinct raised up her wrist with the platinum bracelet and bended up a bladed shield...

... one that easily sliced the makeshift metal projectile in two as it collided!

Unharmed, Aila lowered her shield, only to realize to her shock that the stronger man expected that as well, using the chance to shoulder charge her, knocking her straight onto her back.

The impact, even on the coarse sand, was hard.

Enough to knock some sense into the powerful bender as she tried to sit up, trying to shake off the birds that were metaphorically flying around her head.

But like herself, Wolf wasn't playing around anymore, grabbing her by the collar of her shirt and yanking her up, their faces close to each other.

"Enter the Avatar State, NOW!" he demanded of her.

The current Avatar of this era however, a little scuffed up, only just gave a small snort and a grin that'd make her Great-Great Grandmother Toph proud, raising up her left hand.

As well as raising a single middle finger up.

"Blow me."

Brave as her response was, it wasn't without punishment as Wolf only silently snarled before slamming his forehead right into her face, hitting her hard enough to then bust her forehead open as she yelled out!

"YAAAHHH!"

Enraged at the disrespect he was being given, Wolf saw nearby some parked motorcycles near a bar and threw the screaming Avatar into them, watching her collide with one, in turn knocking over the rest like a set of dominoes.

Rolling off one motorcycle, now feeling some blood starting to leak out from a large cut on her forehead, Aila was more on edge.

Giving a deep breath to herself, she wiped some of the blood out of her sight before taking her glasses off, seeing they were busted from the collision, just thankful none of the broken bits got into her eyes.

Hearing the footsteps coming behind her, the Avatar turned to see Wolf making his way towards her, no doubt still fuming mad.

"The fuck is this?!"

Now attention was brought towards the entrance of the bar where a familiar face to Aila had stepped out with his messy black hair and freckles, looking aghast at what he was seeing.

"You knocked over my fucking bike!" Yasir complained about, not towards the young woman he remembered beating him in a fight, but the guy he didn't know of headed towards her.

"Already bad enough I got banned from that whorehouse, and now this shit?!" the Sandbender kept yelling, choosing to approach Wolf without realizing what had been going on, which Aila realized.

"Wait, STOP!"

But Yasir didn't listen, instead stepping in the advancing Hunter's way, an angry finger pointed at it. "You're going to have to pay for repairs! You hear me!?"

Without warning, without even breaking his stride, Wolf thrust his open fingers into the thug's face to dig them in before QUICKLY TEARING OUT WITHOUT ISSUE THE TOP HALF OF HIS SKULL AND SPINAL CORD OUT FROM THE NEWLY EXPOSED HOLE IN THE FRONT OF HIS HEAD!

Not even caring about the stumbling body falling over, or throwing away what he just tore out without a sweat, the marked being was only focused on a now disturbed Aila, growing more impatient.

"Don't you worry, Avatar. You'll get a more dignified death..."

As the fight went on, those Aila told to get cover made their way back to the Catfox's Den, seeing Ying-Ling give a growl, having been sleeping in front of the building this whole time.

"Grahh!"

Having been telling others to get cover or to leave the village as the fight went on, Kallah pointed at the building as she spoke to Lusa and Redbear. "Alright, now we just gotta get to the bottom floors and..." she tried to give an idea of what to do next, only to spot Honei thinking something over.

"Honei?"

"Kallah, we got to go back, help Aila." the tall girl insisted, so concerned which the fire nun understood, but had to shake her head.

"You heard what she said, she didn't want either of us to get hurt."

"I know that, but she's still my little sister, your girlfriend. We're Team Avatar, at least two out of six I mean."

Understanding, Kallah approached her friend. "I know, but WHAT can we do to help?" she asked. "You're only a human and a non-bender. And I can waterbend, but it won't be enough."

"You're right, I am human, but I'm also a Beifong." Honei pointed out to her, those before her seeing the Avatar's sister give a deep breath, the winds in the air blowing her hair as she spoke.

"My sister is one too, and Beifong's NEVER leave their family behind."

"Wait, you and Aila are Beifong's?" Lusa had to speak up, finding these new things about her friends all the more out of nowhere, Redbear approaching her.

"I'll explain when we get some cover." he assured her before looking at Honei. "You are aware that you won't be as lucky as the last time you fought the Hunter," the waterbender began asking, remembering hearing the tale of the fight. "That with your newfound humanity, it will offer new challenges and dangers."

That much was true, the Makimura girl had to agree, but she did slip on a knowing smile.

"Then I'll just have to work around them, fight dirty if I have to."

Saying that, Honei then looked at Kallah, who seemed to be taking in her words. "And Kallah, come on, ain't no way you're letting some mean Hunter hurt your Platinum Spirit, right?"

When Honei was right, she was right. And Kallah knew it, having to get her waterskin ready.

"Let's do it."

"We are getting reports from the village of Ramaal-Hadia, within the Earth State of Ret-Kadda, that a massive fight has broken out on its streets involving the Avatar..."

"Ms. Deka! Come here!"

Catching word within her private office, the Order of the Red Lotus' leader left it, seeing some of her fellow followers listening in on the radio within their hidden base in the nearby training room.

The newscaster's voice was quite in awe, describing what was happening, with the glasses-wearing woman listening closely.

"It seems that Avatar Aila is currently in combat against a non-bender, with both fighting all over the streets of the village." the woman's voice spoke through the speakers. "We can't identify who exactly this man is, but it seems that whoever he is, he's already killed one civilian and the Avatar seems to be having some issues dealing with him..."

"Son of a... that has to be the Avatar Hunter! Sounds like it's kicking her ass." One Red Lotus follower commented, Deka keeping her ears close.

At the same time, she wondered about her theory, keeping quiet...

Many miles away, within the large airship that took off from Zaofu and flew towards its destination, those aboard happened to be listening to the same report in disbelief.

"... I'm saying so as it seems whatever Avatar Aila does to him, he keeps coming, as if not affected."

"SHIT, we need to push this thing to go faster!" Yasuko called out to Toph, who was at the controls, having to shake her head.

"It's already going as fast as it could. Even then, it'd still be faster than you flying there on your own." her wife had to explain, Bolin himself trying to look at the bright side of things.

"They didn't mention anything about the others, maybe they're okay."

"Whatever this man is, Avatar Aila doesn't seem to be letting up, fighting back as much as she could. We'll be keeping you all informed, we won't leave the scene until..." The announcer spoke, leaving everyone on the airship concerned.

Taking all of this in, worried for his friends as well as his girlfriend, Yasunori glanced over at Opal, spotting her trying to relax herself while it seemed Kuvira's sand fox, having been allowed on board since he already rushed in and they were on a time limit, was licking at her hand.

"Opal, are you okay?"

"I can feel their spirits from where we are right now." she spoke, also hoping for the best, knowing Junior was trying his best to comfort her. "Strife, worry, panic, fright. All filling them..."

Even then, something wasn't right.

"Yet one is separate from the others. And I don't mean Aila."

Having been on the ropes, Aila couldn't help but feel some fright fighting the Avatar Hunter, having been throwing everything she knew against this foe.

But whatever she fought back with, Wolf would just ignore and come at her, healing whatever wound he got.

Even worse was that she knew whatever Wolf had to give, he wasn't just trying to kill her, but get her to put on the Avatar State as well.

She figured that the Hunter wanted to end the chain if he killed her while she had it activated.

Still, Aila wouldn't give her opponent that satisfaction as she backed up against the corner of a building, ducking out of the way of a punch that was strong enough to destroy a chunk of stone.

Needing to think outside the box, an idea came to mind, praying more of her grandmother rubbed off on her.

Waving her hands around in a pattern after getting some distance, the Avatar thrust her hands forth, causing the gusts of wind she bended to send it back against another satomobile.

Just what she was hoping for as Aila then focused all her power at what was around her, holding her hands out to her sides as she saw Wolf begin coming back, his blackened eyes back to see.

But just then, as he made another step, something shot out from the sand it walked on, shooting through his foot!

"ARGHH!"

Giving a scream of pain, the Hunter looked down to see what looked like a spike made of condensed sand had stabbed up into his foot.

About to give a tilt of the head at that happening, Wolf then heard an increase of wind, seeing so many grains of sand follow in one direction, moving on their own.

Confused, the marked being looked up to see his target constantly moving her hands around, bending the sand to her whim at her sides, watching him back with focused blue eyes.

"Come ON!"

Letting out a yell of anger, Aila bended forth what sand she was in control of right towards the trapped Hunter, watching him take each grain, trying to shield his eyes.

"ERRHH! Grrhhh..."

That would be the least of Wolf's worries as the more sand that was shot forth, the more that connected and hurt him, yelling out as at this point, the grains of sand were starting to damage its skin and flesh, the damage becoming more and more obvious every second.

"AGHH!"

With the amount of speed and force Aila was making her makeshift sandstorm, it had started to even expose some bone.

Stopping her sandbending, the Avatar saw that even though Wolf had begun to already start healing the damage, he was in rough shape, his rib cage exposed for her to see.

Briefly taking note of the odd layer of bone where the heart was, Aila ignored it and used her platinum bending to fire forth a good flattened sheet of the metal from her bracelet right towards her enemy's face...

... HITTING A SURPRISED WOLF RIGHT AGAINST HIS MOUTH, SLICING HIS HEAD APART HORIZONTALLY INTO TWO HALVES AT THE JAW LINE as the platinum hit against a nearby cabbage car!

To her surprise, the Hunter of the Avatar just fell half of his face first onto the ground, his tongue flapping, unmoving as the top half of the head hit the sand next to him.

Having to give a deep breath at this as she bended the platinum back to her wrist, flicking any gore off, all Aila could do was sit down and groan out in pain in the streets, shaking her head.

"Oh, ugghhh..."

"AILA!"

Turning around to the source of the voice calling her name, the Avatar saw both her sister and love rush onto the scene past the satomobile, looking worried for her. "Honei, Kallah? I thought I told you guys to wait it out!" she called out, getting up to her feet.

But neither arriving girl cared, both hugging the most important girl in their lives tightly, thankful she was alright.

"We decided there was no way we were going to leave you behind." Honei assured her, smiling as Kallah kissed Aila on the lips.

"But it looks like you already had it covered, aside from that cut on your forehead.

Something the brown haired girl had to nod at, pointing above her eyebrows. "I mean, I was-"

A bleeding hand suddenly grasped at Aila's shoulder! Neither Honei nor Kallah were quick enough to stop Aila from being chucked away from them and down the road.

Both were then pushed away by the figure, who then refocused on his target, not caring about the two of them.

Allowing the aching Avatar to realize in horror it was Wolf who had done the deed, standing there and movie with HALF OF HIS HEAD FUCKING MISSING LIKE IT WAS NOTHING!

All she could do was watch in disgust as the partially decapated killer grab the top half of his head off the ground and placed it back onto where it was supposed to be. Right then, the flesh and bone regrew and healed, his head back to normal.

Leaving Wolf annoyed to spit out some sand from his mouth at having to deal with yet ANOTHER decapitation of sorts.

"I've been stabbed, sliced into, hacked and torn apart, burned, drowned, hung, crushed, broken up, properly decapitated, got caught in an explosion, had parts of me blown away. And, just now, had half of my head sliced off!" He sneered out in annoyance, grabbing a broken piece of stone off the ground in hand to use as a weapon as he approached her, shaking his head. "You really haven't figured it out, Avatar... I CAN'T die."

Seeing the disturbed young woman get back onto her feet, clearly feeling pain, the advancing Hunter did have to give credit where it was due.

"But if it's any consolation, that last one REALLY FUCKING HURT..."

Ready to just get close enough to try stabbing at her, the sound of a loud engine turning on got Wolf's attention, as well as Aila and Kallah's, all looking to see a Satomobile suddenly speeding towards them!

As the Hunter was distracted, it was Honei who got the wild idea to run into the nearby cabbage car, which still had the keys in the ignition, and turned it on, all to drive towards the being trying to hurt her sister!

Realizing what was up, Aila quickly rolled out of the pathway as the front of the speeding motor vehicle collided into Wolf, hitting it with enough force to send him flying through a nearby shop wall as the brakes were pumped!

Getting out, the Avatar's big sister rushed over to her as did Kallah. "That won't keep him down for long." she figured, looking at the fire nun. "Patch up Aila, I'll distract the Hunter."

Just that idea scared Aila, who shook her head. "Wait, what? But you're-"

"A Beifong."

The non-bender girl only smiled upon seeing her sister hear that. "And Beifong's only go out on their own terms, little sis."

Able to hear Wolf moving around from where he landed, all Aila could do was nod as Kallah pulled her off to the side for some healing. "Come on, Aila." she said, leaving Honei to deal with the enemy as she walked towards the wreckage, making sure to get low as she did and flow her fingers through the sand.

Inside the shop, the annoyed Hunter rose up from the wreckage he landed in, among the shelves of food and supplies, making sure to pop his arm back into the socket, hearing the pop as it did.

Well, THAT was a new one to add to the list of what Wolf had taken.

All the shopkeeper from behind the counter could do was peek his head carefully, seeing the being stand up.

"Umm... you don't gotta pay for damages?" was all he could muster to say, getting an annoyed glance back from the unkillable, shutting his mouth in return.

Turning back, the next thing Wolf saw was a large piece of wood swung right into its face, sending it back to the ground!

Having grabbed it from the destroyed window, Honei didn't let up, continuing to wail on the grounded enemy.

"Come on, come ON!" she kept saying in-between each swing. "Just stay down and die already! PLEASE, just-"

A hand grabbed and stopped the piece of wood mid-swing, catching the green eyed girl by surprise.

That was before another hand had suddenly gripped the front of her head, covering her eyes.

"AHH!"

Wolf could only shake its head in annoyance. "Have NONE OF YOU been listening? How many times do I have to tell you that you CAN'T kill me!?"

"POCKET SAND!"

The choice of words it heard briefly confused the scarred man.

"Pocket wha-"

Exactly like Honei yelled out, a handful of sand was thrown right into Wolf's open eyes, blinding him for the moment as he let go, yelling out in pain while trying to wiped his eyes clean.

"AHH! Oh DAMMIT! It's in my- AUGH!"

Having been smart enough to indeed pocket some sand from outside before entering the shop to use as a distraction if needed, the Avatar's big sister wasn't stopping there.

Going over the counter, Honei grabbed the big glass tip jar full of yuan bills and pieces and, ignoring the crying out shopkeeper.

"Wait, WAIT!"

But she didn't listen and smashed it right across the back of Wolf's head!

With glass and currency falling all over, the tall girl knew she had to keep going, trying to find a way to keep the enemy down.

Looking around, she got an idea upon spotting a receipt spike still on the counter.

Taking hold of it, Honei jumped onto Wolf's back when it was turned to her, holding on as she stabbed into its chest and stomach with no end!

Killing someone wasn't the first thing the newly turned human would want to do to another as, taking inspiration from the air nomads, she believed all life was sacred and never wanted to kill.

But with Wolf not stopping until her little sister was dead, Honei would have to make one exception as she kept stabbing, yet not hitting where the heart and bone plate was.

Having enough of this, the Hunter jerked back, able with enough power to throw Honei back through the hole in the wall it created, now able to get the last of the sand out of its eyelids.

"UGH! Finally..."

From afar, having just been able to patch Aila enough, Kallah looked up to see her friend sent back into the streets.

"HONEI!" she called out, with her girlfriend looking as well in shock.

Reeling from being thrown and getting back up onto her feet, Honei saw Wolf make its way out as well, pulling the receipt spike out of its chest where it hit the right lung.

Having it with the annoying girl, seeing her surprised, the large man decided to get her out of the way once and for all.

"I've personally had enough of you..." Wolf threatened, prepared to use the spike however he saw fit as he got close enough...

... only for Honei to instantly lower herself down by doing the leg splits before him!

Low enough to be right in front of the Hunter's groin, following that up with the hardest punch she could give as a human, right at the sweet spot.

The strike was SO sudden and direct, the Avatar Hunter felt every single ounce of pain that came from it, giving a wheezing gasp as its eyes turned back to the amber colored ones, revealing how much they were dilating.

"... gaaaahhh..."

Even more offsetting was the sound made upon impact being so loud and visceral, it was VERY obvious to both the cringing Aila and Kallah that SOMETHING had ruptured upon getting hit!

At first, Honei was surprised that she was capable of such a move, but even still, she didn't regret it as she got herself back up on her feet, seeing the gasping Wolf double over in pain, holding his groin with one hand.

"Ugahhh... Aaghhh..."

"Heal those up." she mocked it with a grin.

Her need to insult was what allowed the injured Hunter to gain a window for attack, grabbing her by the shoulder and backhanding her in the face, away onto the street!

An action which got him a lash of water against his back before another, cluing in him as to who exactly was attacking, seeing Kallah now making her way towards the fight, bending whip-like shapes of water around with ease.

"Get away from her, you son of a bitch!" she threatened, ready to join in.

"Kallah, wait!" Aila tried to call out from where her love left her, but her Fire Rose just smirked.

"Why should I let you two have all the fun?"

Saying that, the fire nun then began sending forth water whips, making sure to chill them down enough mid-swing to freeze them, cutting and slashing into Wolf's skin, driving him back.

"Ugh!"

The young woman had told Kuvira about wanting to use her bending to heal wounds, not cause them. But there was a difference between hurting someone and protecting her family.

Holding out her hands, Kallah then bended what water she had in the air into smaller shapes she froze, firing them to riddle up Wolf's back as he turned around, turning him into a makeshift pin cushion.

"AHH! AH!"

Snarling out in pain, the powerful being turned with anger in his heart and rushed towards the waterbender, right hand out to grab her...

"RAAGHHH!"

... which was a screw up on his end as on instinct, Kallah backed away and raised her arm up, causing whatever water she had left to freeze up and shoot upwards as the hand got close.

As she stumbled back onto her rear end, the fire nun saw the ice cut through his four fingers, severing them at an angle, each digit falling on the ground.

That was something the now wounded Wolf was surprised by, getting a closer look as he had to once more tilt his head at, now only having a single thumb on the hand.

But it was still quick enough to kick some sand right towards Kallah's face.

Picking up on Honei's little trick, Wolf used the moment the waterbender was busy avoiding getting the grains of sand in her eyes by rolling away, all to quickly press the sole of his shoe right onto her back!

"AHH!"

Not enough to break bones or anything like that, but enough to trap her in place as she yelled out in pain.

"OWW! AAHHH!" Kallah cried out as Aila realized what was happening, getting to her feet and threw a quick fire bolt, just missing her enemy and hitting some of the wooden debris.

"KALLAH!"

Hearing its target, Wolf made sure to throw the receipt spike he still held onto right towards the Avatar...

... and unlike the last time he threw a metal object, Aila didn't catch it with her bending, the pointed end just passing by her bare arm, cutting it!

"OWW!"

It was only a graze, but enough to distract her as she held onto her cut arm, Wolf coming up with a new idea now.

"I see you care for this girl. No doubt due to her beauty." he observed the struggling female before looking back at his target. "Do as I say, enter the Avatar State! And I'll free her..." he then demanded before applying just a bit more pressure onto the struggling Kallah's back, seeing her gasp out in pain.

"AGH! AAHH!"

"... or else, she dies."

Hearing this, worry and panic filled Aila's face, shaking her head. "I-I told... I told you, I haven't completed my training, I'm not a full Avatar yet!" she pointed out. "Please, just let her go!"

"You're lying, now get in the Avatar State! DO IT!"

"I CAN'T! I DON'T KNOW HOW! IT JUST HAPPENS!"

Realizing what she was saying may be true, Wolf was left with no other choice, growing more and more reckless with his goal.

"Fine, guess I'll just have to do what you said..." Wolf mocked as he then cracked his neck before then moved its foot off of Kallah's ankle...

... and then moved it right over the back of her neck, the eyes of both girls going wide.

"... I'll just have to trigger it the hard way."

Unknown to the three, Honei had tried to recover, her eyebrow bloody as she then saw and heard what the Avatar Hunter was threatening to do.

Willing herself to her knees, she struggled to get up due to being in a light daze and began to wave her hand forward in a horizontal angle, not wanting to see what was next as she screamed out...

"NNOOOOOOO!"

... only to suddenly feel the air around her open hand move to her command.

An air swipe shot forth from where she was and right at Wolf, who only just turned to see the wave shaped compressed air knocked into him!

Seeing the Hunter be flung onto its back, rolling along the ground near the cabbage car that had been used to hit him, Aila wasted no time and rushed over to Kallah's side, checking up on her.

"Kallah, Kallah! ARE YOU OKAY!?"

Hearing the panic in her girlfriend's voice, ignoring the pain she felt on her back and neck, the fire nun just chuckled.

"I'm fine, just a little stomp, I had him. How are you doing, platinum spirit?"

Hearing that, the glasses-wearing girl had to hold back a laugh, only to realize something as did Kallah...

... both looking to see Honei stumble around so confused near another satomobile, looking at her hands before turning to the two.

It was obvious WHAT Aila's big sister had just done.

"Aila, you're the only airbender around. Did I just airbend?"

Neither the Avatar nor her girlfriend could believe what had just happened, let alone considered the tall girl bending air.

All Aila could do was let go of Kallah and begin walking her way over to her big sister. "I... I think..."

But out of the corner of her eye, she saw her foe get back on his feet next to the cabbage car, looking downright PISSED OFF.

And before the Avatar could do anything to stop it, Wolf kicked his foot at the side of the vehicle, sending it skidding towards Honei!

The girl who had just accidentally bended the element of air was just able to see the large machine come zooming towards her, only to feel something bump into her, pushing her away with one hand.

Thankfully, Aila was able to use her own airbending to get a speed boost, quick enough to push her sister out of the way as with herself...

... only to then feel pain instantly fill her lower left arm from the wrist down upon stopping in place, a loud sound of crushing metal and something else heard.

Both sister's eyes were frozen open at what just happened, the two slowly turning to see that Aila's left hand wasn't JUST wedged between the two satomobiles thrown against each other, but was completely crushed in at the wrist.

Before Honei knew it, the Avatar accidentally jerked her arm back out of terrified instinct, causing her to just rip herself free, exposing torn flesh and snapped apart bone.

It was THE worst physical feeling Aila ever felt in her entire life.

"AAAAAGGGHHHH! AAAHHHH! YAAAHHHH!"

Her screams of agony echoed out all over the village as she held her bloody stump of a wrist, panicking too much to try stopping the bleeding, Kallah in utter silenced shock as Honei yelled out in fear.

"Aila, it's alright, it's alright!" She tried to hurriedly assure Aila, tearing off the belt around her waist to use as a tourniquet as Kallah ripped off a part off her shirt to wrap it around the wound and stop the bleeding.

All while the Avatar kept howling out in pain.

"My hand, MY HAND!"

Too distracted by what just happened with his target, Wolf was DONE, prepared to march over and finish the job already...

... only for the the sound of another satomobile to catch his ears, turning right in time to be once again being hit by one!

This time, the Hunter was knocked down onto the ground, in turn ending up getting run over by both sets of wheels!

Seeing it stop quickly, the three girls, including the still freaking out Aila, realized it was both Kuvira and Zarah behind the wheel, the two benders rushing out and running to the wounded girl.

"AILA! SHIT, what happened?!" the grandmother asked out loud, with the glassbender realizing what happened from scanning the scene.

"Her hand, it's..."

"Grandma... grandma?" was all Aila could tear out with her voice croaking, not even caring if Zarah was around to hear her call out to her grandmother. Nor did anyone else.

"She's gonna bleed out if we don't get her medical attention!" Kallah cried out as she came over as well, holding onto her love. "We'll get you help, baby."

But Honei wasn't dumb, shaking her head. "We won't have enough time." she insisted before getting an idea from the debris that Aila had accidentally set on fire. "We got to cauterize the wound, stop the bleeding!"

Getting up, the newly turned airbender went over as Kuvira looked into those wide scared blue-eyes. "Aila, listen to me. We're gonna stop the bleeding, alright? I need you to brace yourself, okay?"

Seeing her granddaughter look so scared, but so trusting as well as she just nodded in gasping silence, the platinum bender felt so awful at not getting there in time to prevent this.

Especially upon seeing the makeshift bandage be undone, seeing how much worse it looked.

"Don't worry, little one, Honei's coming over." Zarah assured her. "Let's count to five, are you ready?" she asked, getting a worried nod back.

"Alright, one-"

Without even giving a heads up, Kuvira pressed down on a neck nerve, instantly making Aila pass out to the others dismay.

"Kuvira, why'd you do that?!" Kallah questioned as Honei arrived with a burning piece of wood in hand, carefully holding it up. But the grandmother shook her head.

"She wouldn't have been able to handle the extra pain in her state. It's better this way." she insisted before looking at her oldest granddaughter.

"Do it, Honei."

Not arguing, she held the burning piece of wood close to the stump on Aila's wrist, the strong smell of burning flesh and bone filling the four's nostrils as the cauterization began.

Moving it all around, the exposed wound began to bleed less and less until finally, it looked to stop.

That much was a relief to those tending to Aila, but there was still the matter of the state she'd be in.

"She's still breathing, thank Hiromi..." Kallah was thankful her prayers to the past Avatar worked, as were Honei, Kuvira and Zarah as they made sure to check the Avatar's pulse.

Still, it was the oldest of the group who felt more needed to be done, instantly getting an idea while looking to see what was in the distance ahead.

"Zarah, help Honei and Kallah get Aila to Redbear's springs." she ordered, taking notice of Ying-Ling coming onto the scene from around the corner, making sure to get the still-passed out Aila on her feet. "Kallah, you're going to use the spring's water to keep healing that wound as best as you could."

The idea did spark something in the fire nun's mind. "Since it's technically Spirit Water?"

"Correct."

"But what about you, Grandma?" Honei had to ask, wondering why she wasn't coming along...

... until the four heard the sound of bones cracking and adjusting, turning to see the damn Avatar Hunter moving where he laid, trying to rework his body back into place.

"Someone has to stay behind and kill that thing for good."

The idea was too much, Honei having to shake her head in fear. "Please, NO. Don't do this, what about your heart?" she asked, holding her grandmother's hands. "We need you!"

"No you don't, just make sure your little sister is safe, Honei."

Saying that, Kuvira just put on a brave smile, pulling her worried granddaughter in for a quick hug. "Besides, I'll be fine. I know exactly how to put that bastard down for good..."

Neither Honei nor Kallah quite got her words, but Zarah was quick to speak on their elder's behalf.

"Your grandmother will be alright, trust her." she insisted, seeing Wolf get better before looking at the platinum bender. "Good luck, Kuvira."

"Thank you, my friend." Kuvira said back with a nod of respect, knowing she could trust Zarah, who began leading the three over to Ying-Ling.

Standing there in the streets, left to see those who lived there must have ran for cover, the platinum bender just gave a deep breath to herself as she began to undo her jacket.

Hearing the bones finish re-adjusting, the powerful bender turned to see the Avatar Hunter getting back onto his feet, taking notice first of his target being led away by sky-bison.

The idea of being delayed from freeing himself from this damn curse served to only enrage Wolf before casting his blackened eyes on the old woman before him.

"Step aside, miss. My business isn't with you, but with the Avatar." he spoke, seeing Kuvira staring him down without breaking eye contact as she finally took her jacket off.

"You're a threat towards my granddaughter, as well as my family..." she shot back, throwing her jacket away, showing her green tank top and both of her platinum bracelets for it to see, showing no fear.

"... you've made yourself MY BUSINESS the second you were freed."

Now just a bit curious at this older woman daring to stand in his way, Wolf wondered, not caring he was missing some fingers.

"Brave words won't save you. What makes you think you even have a chance of survival?" he had to ask, all while those of Ramaal-Hadia who had been hiding in their homes and businesses couldn't help but see what the kind woman they knew as Pai was up to.

But at this moment, Pai Hiau didn't exist anymore.

"I guess you don't know who I am then. Allow me to PROPERLY introduce myself..." Kuvira spoke up, loud and clear for everyone to hear, no longer caring anymore.

"... I am KUVIRA BEIFONG! Former Great Uniter of the Earth Empire, daughter-in-law to Suyin and Baatar Beifong Jr, mother of Baatar Beifong the Third AND THE GRANDMOTHER OF AVATAR AILA MAKIMURA!"

Getting in her best fighting pose, death right in front of her, the platinum bender was ready, those fern green eyes of hers steeling up for combat...

... ready for one final round.

"And I'm going to put a stop to this hunt of yours, here and now."

Notes:

And so, the chapter ends and things... well, don't look so hot. This chapter, aside from details, like Yasir's death and what Wolf manages to survive of has been changed up, but otherwise the same. Aila taking on Wolf in combat, her four elements and training against his strength and healing. And it gets so wild, even Kallah and Honei, even as a human herself, get on the fight, all three putting it their all, even Honei busting out a Johnny Cage nut shot.

But Wolf, though he wants things to end, shows he won't go down and is ready to kill Kallah to force Aila to trigger the Avatar State... ONLY FOR HONEI TO AIRBEND! Something that has been hinted at a few times. But this leaves Honei left defenseless as Wolf pushes a satomobile her way... only for Aila to come make the save... ONLY FOR HER HAND TO BE CRUSHED IN AT THE WRIST... and accidently tears it off.

Left missing a hand, things look bad for Aila... only for Kuvira and Zarah to come around and run Wolf over, giving them time to cauterize the exposed flesh and bone. And as Kallah, Honei and Zarah go to get Aila to Redbear's springs... Kuvira is prepared to deal with Wolf to give them time, publically revealing herself in public.

Chapter 33: Chapter Thirty Three- One Last Dance

Notes:

Well, be ready for, close to the end of "Rise of Aila- Book Two", things will never be the same after this one.

Be sure to comment, bookmark and give kudos!

Trigger and Content Warnings- This chapter does contain some naughty words, strong violence and fighting as well as gruesome moments and character death...

... YEAH.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

The radio she had been listening to, had enthralled all the patrons and workers in the bar she chose to relax herself in, the electronic hiss of the stereo speakers for all to hear.

"I... I don't believe it... It can't be… as Avatar Aila is being led away, having just lost a hand saving her sister from this opponent of hers..." the radio announcer spoke of in complete shock at what he reported on the scene, all the while Aajaan sipped her Kanpari and Citrus Juice through a straw where she sat.

Luckily this was one of those hole-in-the-wall dirtbag bars, so she could take her face mask off and no one would bat an eye at her missing cheek and crooked teeth, seeing as others looked to be in worse conditions. Though her sunglasses had to stay on, just in case.

After her little meeting with the Avatar's Grandmother, the Grand Lotus and one of her agents, the young woman decided to unwind and just relax when news of Aila's fight against the Avatar Hunter took hold.

Still, allowing herself to lose a hand to save her sister, that was a ballsy move Ajaan had to respect. But it would bring somewhat of a disadvantage down the line...

"... This older woman who arrived on the scene, ready to fight... she's claiming to... now, this hasn't been proven..." the announcer kept speaking, clearly sounding like he was in unsure surprise at what he was about to say.

"... but we here at BRYK 205, on the scene, are reporting that she's claiming to be both Kuvira Beifong AND Avatar Aila's grandmother!"

All the patrons and workers of the bar began to react as well as you'd expect upon finding out such heavy news.

But for the ironbender, this was just a fun show to watch, sipping her yummy drink in amusement before hearing her Varri-phone on the table vibrate, picking it up and checking the caller ID.

Seeing who it was, she knew she had to act the part, knowing why it was being made and answered.

"Mother?"

"Aajaan, are you listening to any news reports?"

"Take it you guys just heard the big news?" the Ironbender asked in a shocked voice, trying not to give away anything.

"All ears." she heard Deka report on the other line, sounding more interested than surprised, before hearing what else she had to say. "Where are you?"

"This random bar, at least two towns away from where the Avatar and Wolf are said to be."

"Good. Report back to the base, now. Your part is done."

This was a surprise, with the yellow-eyed girl now more legibly caught off-guard. "Mother, are you sure?"

"Positively, we will let things play out and see what happens. NOW, come back, please."

Nodding, understanding if her mother was telling her to fall back, this was serious.

"Alright, be there as fast as I can. I love you." Aajaan agreed before hanging up and getting her face mask back on, making sure to pay for her drink before she left the establishment.

She herself didn't know who'd win, but the Ironbender hoped Kuvira at least told the Avatar what they found out…

Thirteen years before...

"Just wait here for a moment, Nurse Kehara will check on you after dealing with Padma. Okay, Alia?"

The six-year old, dressed up in a crococat costume as today was Spiritween, just sat in the chair next to the nurse's office in the waiting room, only just able to nod, sniffling as she held some paper towels over her left hand.

The bunched up paper that just happened to be stained in red.

Her teacher, dressed up as a leaf spirit, felt bad for her student who had been using scissors on an art project she was working on, only for a change in Aila's emotions to accidentally cause her to metalbend, resulting in her cutting her hand by mistake in the process.

It had been a month since the death of her father and her older sister was hospitalized and hurt, a lot had still been on the little girl's mind.

"I'm going to call up your mom and once Nurse Kehara helps you out, she can take you home."

"Thank you, Ms. Yeeloh..."

Getting some kind of verbal response after the crying did warm up the teacher's heart, wishing Aila luck as the teacher began walking back to her classroom, leaving the student alone in the waiting room.

Sitting by her lonesome, waiting, the future Avatar just kept crying to herself, removing the paper towel to see the big cut on her hand. Something that bothered her majorly.

She was but a blooming metalbender, having already been showing signs to her parents amazement, her father Bachu being born one as well.

But while she was curious and wondering about it, the accident she had in class began making her give negative thoughts, sniffing.

"I hate metalbending... I hate it..." she teared up, recovering her wound.

"... why me?"

"Why you?"

Aila didn't know the voice that spoke to her, looking up from her hand to spot a rather long set of legs hidden behind a green uniform with big feet.

Looking up, she realized the figure before her looked massive, looming over her in special looking attire, her head almost hitting the ceiling.

Seeing the person kneel down to her level, still keeping her large height, the young girl saw that despite the imposing figure, this lady had a friendly face behind the face paint with pretty dark green eyes.

"Can I see your hand?" she politely asked, only to see how unsure the girl looked. "Oh, let me guess, I'm a stranger and your mother told you not to talk to them?"

"Yes."

That seemed to make the friendly woman in her rather detailed looking costume smile just a bit. "Fair enough, me and my wife told our daughter Koko the same thing." she offered before holding out a gloved hand to Aila's unharmed one.

"I'm actually here to meet up with a good friend of mine, but it looks like you needed some company."

"Do they know what costume you're wearing?" Aila innocently asked, looking it all over. "Because that's a really neat looking Kyoshi Spiritween costume."

Hearing the compliment, realizing the girl didn't realize why she was really there, the spirit of Avatar Kyoshi just gave a light laugh.

"Thank you, I like your crococat one as well."

"My mommy and... daddy picked it out for me awhile ago."

Hearing how sad she sounded upon mentioning her father, the kind spirit got what was on her mind. "Is your daddy not around anymore?" she asked, getting a quiet nod back. "I'm sorry."

"He was a metalbender, like me. I got it from him... but I'm not as good, I cut myself by accident." Aila described to Kyoshi, looking down at her cut hand, able to feel the soft gloved hands take hold of it kindly.

The young girl was also just able to spot some scar tissue peeking through between the uniform sleeve and gloves.

"And you got angry with yourself. Angry with what you were born as, because of him?"

That got the spirit another nod, hearing a sniffle. Yet another thing Kyoshi understood.

"At least you cherish the life of your father, and mother I assume, I never got to have that chance." the former Avatar admitted, feeling she could share some of her own feelings, knowing it could help make her new life understand.

"Me and my parents didn't exactly have the best relationship... can't say we still do, even after they passed away."

Saying that, Kyoshi looked into those curious little sapphire orbs behind those big glasses, putting on a smile. "But I'm able to keep their memory alive in my own little way." she spoke, not going fully into detail, but just enough.

"How so?"

"The same way you can keep your father's memory alive," the spirit offered, looking at the paper towel covered hand. "With the gift he gave you."

Taking in the woman's words, Aila seemed to understand where Kyoshi was getting at, able to give a kind smile back.

"Aila, you can come in now..."

Hearing her name called by the nurse, the girl in the crococat costume got up and bowed to the towering woman, still not knowing she was thanking the spirit of one of her past lives.

"Thank you, Miss."

"You're welcome, little one."

As Aila made her way into the nurse's office, Kyoshi's spirit just vanished, glad to help her new life out...

Present Day...

Her vision slowly began to unblur, voices around her muffled. It felt like she couldn't will herself to get up from how she was laying.

The dream Aila Makimura was having was one of when she, unknowingly at the time, first met Avatar Kyoshi, the powerful and well known Avatar kindly comforting her that day at school.

Even if she didn't know who she was talking to, the young woman still remembered the warm feeling the tall woman gave her, helping her take a step in accepting being a metalbender in memory of her father.

That said, something didn't seem right as her eyesight got clearer, as were the voices she was hearing...

"Wait, you're telling me you airbended?"

"Not on purpose, it just happened as I called out to her."

"And I'm so thankful for you, Honei."

"Thanks Kallah, let's just focus on Aila."

"Alright, it looks to be getting-"

"What happened?"

Her vision clear once more, Aila now realized she was looking up at the faces of Honei, Kallah and Zarah, able to see them look down at her in surprise.

"Aila, you're okay!" her girlfriend couldn't help but smile, that wonderful smile on her lips soothing her soul as the other two gave a collected breath of relaxation.

Still, the Avatar had to tell the truth.

"I feel like shit."

A comment that none of the three were judging her for saying, her big sister giving a thankful kiss on her healed-up forehead. Something that made Aila smile before noticing something about where they were.

"Redbear's springs?" she asked, seeing they were in the familiar stone caverns being lit up with flashlights, which Honei gave a sure look all around.

"Yeah, we were forced to bring you here, figured the spiritual properties would help you out, make you feel... a little better." she explained, trying to hold back the tears of worry she felt.

But hearing those last three words caught the Avatar off-guard, confused.

"'A little better', what do you mean?"

That was when she saw the looks on the three's faces turn somber, reluctant even.

And then there was the bright blue and white light out of the corner of her eye she just then noticed, as well as a wet sensation on her left arm.

"Aila, you may need to..." Zarah tried to ease her in, but it was too late as Aila turned her head to the side and rose up her arm, seeing it had been within one of the pools...

... doing so revealed to her that her left hand, as well as part of the lower arm, was gone. Like it was never there in the first place.

But in much better shape than after she accidentally ripped her ruined limb out from between the two motor vehicles.

Even though she saw that skin and flesh had regrown over most of it, with a part or two still scabbed over, needing some more work.

"My... My hand? Where's my hand!?"

The voice of the Avatar began to crack as she questioned what she was seeing, swearing her mind was playing tricks on her as she touched it with her one good hand.

Doing so revealed that it was very much real, the realization of her now being an amputee a reality flooding Aila's mind.

Tears began to form as memories of how it happened filled her mind, shaking her head as she tightly closed her eyes.

"No, NO NO NO!" she kept yelling, unable to look at the others, only keeping her eyes on the stump as another bad thought entered her mind.

"I'm... I'm ruined, I can't be the Avatar... I'm worthless, useless."

"NO, you are not." Honei's voice filled her ears, the others speaking up to comfort her.

"Don't ever say that about yourself."

"But..." Aila tried to counter argue, only to feel the motherly-like hand of Zarah's rest on her forehead, getting her attention.

"Aila, they told me how the second you saw that cabbage car get flung towards you big sister, you wasted NO TIME in trying to save her. You didn't even take into account your own safety, just that of Honei's."

Saying that, the glassbender had to give a kind look. "Yeah, you lost your hand, but you wouldn't be the first Avatar to lose a limb saving someone or in combat." she described before deciding to throw caution to the wind.

"The Grand Lotus told me and the other agents she believed you to be worthy of the title of the Avatar."

Hearing the title of the mysterious figurehead of the Order caught the attention of the three girls. More so when Zarah took out from her pocket the White Lotus Pai Sho tile to pass over to Honei for the three to see closely.

"I'm happy to see she wasn't wrong." she confirmed, giving a trusting wink.

Much as the three girls were amazed to find out the truth, a more worrying problem came back to mind for the Avatar.

"The Hunter, where is it?"

Once more, the looks on the faces of those around her, from her big sister, her girlfriend and the White Lotus follower, all shared the same worried look.

But it was realizing one other important person was missing that Aila's eyes began to shake in fright as she tried to get up.

"No, no, tell me she's not trying to-"

"Aila, relax, you're still in need of..." Kallah tried to convince her as Honei tried to hold onto her, but the powerful young woman shook her head.

"WHY'S OUR GRANDMOTHER FIGHTING THAT THING?!" she yelled out, the idea of Kuvira, with her heart the way it was, was even attempting to fight.

But Zarah tried to calm her down. "She's found out the Hunter's weakness, his heart, she knows to destroy it!" she tried to convince her. "The reason you guys couldn't find the scroll was because-"

Alas, Aila wasn't listening, managing to slip free, hiding her wrist stump under her good arm as she began to rush out of the springs, the others following her.

"Grandma, GRANDMA!"

Moments earlier...

It had begun.

Once she revealed her real identity not just for the Avatar Hunter, but for those within Ramaal-Hadia who were able to witness the two on the streets, Kuvira was ready for anything that came her way.

Without hearing what was on their minds, the elder woman already knew what each civilian was saying, but she didn't care. Not anymore.

Nor did she care about her heart, all the grandmother cared about was protecting the family she had left.

Interested, having heard her name spoken by Sun the week before, Wolf didn't expect that the same old woman he had briefly seen back in Zaofu was the very same person.

But he knew looks could be deceiving.

The two then made their first moves each, Wolf coming towards her while Kuvira jumped back, punching her fists in the air in front of her, bending her platinum bracelets to fire out into pieces.

She knew it wouldn't be easy to just up and have her first attack aimed for the heart, knowing the bone plate covered it.

So instead, the platinum bender focused on trying to disable his knees.

But unlike before with taking everything the three young women before her thrown, the Hunter was more privy to projectile attacks, forced to be on his toes and roll out of the way.

And Wolf would do the same when she spotted an empty shop and waved her hands from it towards him, sending forth pieces of the stone foundation and metal rebar right at him, which he ducked from.

This would raise up the challenge, yet Kuvira made sure to not waste the platinum pieces, reforming them into a spike and launching it from the ground, into her enemies lower back.

"Yagghh!"

The metal had poked out through his stomach, yet its continued movement made the Hunter that even being stabbed, his opponent wasn't letting up, making the spike begin to slowly move up his gut.

As she bended her metal with ease, it did surprise the platinum bender to see her opponent take the spike in both hands, trying to stop it with just one good hand.

More so when Wolf willingly chose to rip it out of the stomach, letting the wound heal up quickly.

"Augh! Dammit!"

But the powerful man was still holding the metal in hand, which did allow Kuvira to hold her hand out and twist the wrist, causing the spike to elongate the end closest to the Hunter's face, shooting forth into his right eye!

"Aahhh!"

A howl of pain came out, Wolf backing up in pain, if thankful it didn't shoot in far enough to hit its brain as he didn't want to endure regenerating brain matter again.

Deciding to stop messing around upon seeing her rush forth, the Hunter swung the back of its hand right at Kuvira, seeing her duck to avoid the attack.

Something Wolf was betting on, seeing where she was to back up, choosing to kick his foot as high as he could towards her face.

The elderly woman was quick to block it with another flat piece of platinum bent from her bracelet, but it was plenty enough of a distraction for the growling killer to rip the spike out of his eye socket and swing it at her torso!

Another close call, the platinum bender just able to avoid her shirt being cut open.

Still, Kuvira wasn't letting Wolf off the hook, lashing forth with her hands waves of sand, grinding and slicing against the exposed part of its upper body.

"Augh!"

Getting annoyed more and more, the Hunter, his blackened eye healed back up, wasn't letting up, throwing the platinum spike to the ground and thrust his good hand towards the old woman, managing to grab her by the throat.

Feeling no more sand slashing against it, Wolf then moved and smashed the powerful bender back first against the still standing wall of the destroyed shop!

Holding the side of her face against it with both hands, the marked being took notice of something.

As did Kuvira, who saw it was a jagged piece of the foundation that her face was close to, or now was getting closer to as Wolf began advancing her face slowly against the wall.

Realizing what her enemy was trying to do, she struggled and tried to punch him in the face to stop, but it wasn't enough to prevent being deeply cut along the side of her cheek, letting out a yell of pain!

"Aaahhhhhh!"

Not letting up, Wolf kept his hold and swung Kuvira once more against the side of the satomobile, keeping her against it as she tightened her eyes, now feeling the good hand begin to start choking her.

"You're clearly more smarter and skilled than you look. Maybe more than the Avatar, but what gives you the idea that you can stop me?!" The Hunter growled out, wanting to get the persistent woman out of the way.

Even being throttled, feeling the power of the dark spirit coursing through the strong body tightly around her throat, Kuvira reopened her eyes before trying to choke out a response.

"I knooacchh... I know-ach..."

"Speak up..." Wolf demanded, loosing the grip just a bit to give the grandmother enough air to sneak in a grin.

"I know your weakness."

Seeing the look of confused surprise come forth briefly, it was all Kuvira needed to hold her arm and hand out behind the Hunter, bending the platinum spike from the ground towards her.

Noticing that himself, Wolf turned to look, which was what the former Great Uniter was REALLY hoping for, moving her other hand out of sight down towards the sand below them.

All to cause a small condensed batch to slash up right against where Vaatu's marking was on his chest!

"Ugahh!"

Able to cut deep enough to expose the damaged bone plate over the heart as the Hunter yelled out in pain, Kuvira bent the platinum over her hand into a makeshift clawed gauntlet.

One that she was quick enough to thrust right at the layer of bone before its healing abilities could cover it back up, gripping tightly on it!

"Aaahhhh!"

Now it was time for Wolf to scream out in agonizing pain as with the hold the old woman had on it, trying hard to pull it back, the intense sensation was beginning to grow unbearable!

"RAAAGGHHH!"

"Come on, COME ON!" Kuvira grunted, keeping her clawed grip tight as her enemy struggled in place, his screaming growing louder and louder, echoing throughout the entire village!

As she kept going, that familiar feeling began to make itself known to the platinum bender, but she wasn't giving up,

Kuvira Beifong wasn't letting that get in the way of protecting her family, focused on ending things.

It wasn't just the civilians of Ramaal-Hadia who were witnesses to the scene of the infamous woman having the Avatar Hunter at her mercy as an injured young woman was watching.

Avatar Aila had sprinted and ran until she was out of breath.

And even then, the adrenaline she was running on wouldn't stop, making her way towards the battlefield until she was at least a block or two away.

Not helping was the increase of pain where her left hand used to be, hiding it away from prying eyes under her right arm.

Once she found out what Kuvira was up to, she had to run away from the improvised healing session, she needed to know her grandmother would be okay.

Able to stop, she saw the powerful platinum bender now having Wolf in her grasp, the roles now reversed with the odd tug of war going on.

"Grandma?" she quietly asked herself before feeling the air behind her move, turning to see the other three come down on Ying-Ling, having needed the sky-bison's help to try chasing her down.

Honei was the first to get off the saddle, Kallah and Zarah following with the latter helping the former down.

"Aila, you still need- WOAH..."

"Mother of Hiromi..." came slipping out of the fire nun's mouth as now her and the other's attention were just as much on the scene as was Aila's.

"Gegghhh..."

Wolf couldn't believe he was having such an issue throwing this old woman away, as well as experiencing such pain, feeling like someone threw a bucket of salt onto a burn victim's back.

After enough pain and struggling, with one last mighty pull, Kuvira yelled out as she felt the bone plate begin to snap and break away from the Hunter's chest...

"Yaaahhhhhh!"

... before FINALLY RIPPING IT OUT, FINALLY EXPOSING BOTH THE RIBCAGE AND THE BEATING HEART AS BLOOD SPLIT OUT TO THE SAND!

Being let go, Wolf yelled out more, feeling the air hit his beating heart. "AAAGGGHHH!" he kept yelling, the pain being the worst it ever felt.

And yet the second it looked back at Kuvira, another sensation of pain hit it's entire body quickly as the old woman thrust out her platinum gauntlet, bending it out before her into a sharp blade...

... one that embedded itself right into its heart.

No one could believe it, not the Avatar, her sister, her girlfriend, the Black Lotus agent or even the Hunter.

But Kuvira didn't change the emotion on her face, looking at the bloodied bone plate in her one hand before casting her eyes back at Wolf, seeing him stumble around the street, trying to keep his balance.

Still, he looked less imposing, tanking through the pain and more confused and concerned.

The only problem, the Avatar Hunter was still alive, his eyes changing from the two empty black shapes to the known amber before falling to his knees, trying to breathe.

"Ugghhhh... ahhh..."

Seeing this, Kuvira threw the bone plate to the ground before bending up whatever platinum she had left of her bracelet into a thick sized, yet flat piece, moving it right in front of that protruding out of Wolf's chest, a closed hand in behind the metal.

Her opponent knew what she was going to do, looking up to see the focused and ready look in those fern green eyes.

Even having just met her, Wolf could tell she had the face of someone who had done bad things in the past and tried to bury them. To redeem herself, forced to let it out one more time.

Something he knew from personal experience.

"This will be for all the lives you took, the innocents you hurt. The bastards you killed... and most of all..." Kuvira spoke with deep breaths, the fight taking a lot out of her, but she was going to see this through.

"... This is for going after my family."

With that, she then thrust her hand out behind the platinum, Wolf instinctively closing his eyes...

... and yet, nothing happened.

No pain, no more metal damaging its heart, nothing.

Reopening his eyes, the Hunter didn't know what was going through the woman's mind as he looked up at her, seeing the look on her face seem to change.

From an angry and furious grandmother, to a slowly scared and shaking woman.

And then, Kuvira Beifong just fell to the side on the ground, the platinum following suit, her eyes wide open.

From far off where they were watching, both her granddaughter's couldn't believe it, neither could Kallah and Zarah, the four just in utter science as Wolf didn't know what happened.

Curious, the being reached down his hand and pressed its index and middle finger against Kuvira's neck where she laid.

She seemed to have no pulse. Her heart looked to have given out.

Both Aila and Honei began to cry out, shaking their heads as tears fell as they, Kallah and Zarah realized what had happened as well.

Kuvira Beifong fought on until the end, knowing her heart wouldn't take the stress of fighting, but had to do it to protect her granddaughter...

... but it wasn't enough.

Seeing this, in a form of respect, Wolf simply moved his fingers down along the elderly woman's eyelids, closing them and nothing else, looking to the side and seeing a stray piece of rebar.

Taking it in hand by his good one, the Avatar Hunter then resumed his objective, looking back where he heard Honei crying from, seeing all attention be brought back towards him.

Getting back onto his feet, even with the metal sticking out of its chest, Wolf began making its way towards them, towards the Avatar.

Now, much as he wanted to die and almost could have gotten even that, he had to rework his plans.

Realizing this, Zarah turned to the others. "He's coming, we gotta get her out of here!" she ordered, trying to tug at Aila, only to notice as with the other two the look of pure fear had frozen her still.

"Aila, Aila, come on... COME ON!" she yelled out, but the Avatar wasn't budging.

The sight of seeing her Grandmother drop dead was enough to make her in a sense catatonic.

Realizing they couldn't move her, the best course of action was to try finishing what Kuvira started with. "The heart." Honei spoke up, ready to protect her little sister once more from the advancing Hunter, willing to do anything to stop it.

Bending some water from a nearby troth, Kallah rushed in and tried to freeze up and shoot forth more ice spikes at the chest.

But Wolf saw that coming, managing to avoid them by moving out of the way, leaving Kallah to be pushed back hard with a thrust of his fingerless hand, sending her skitting along and rolling back near the three.

It was Honei's turn next, coming forth and scooping up more sand in her hand to throw in his eyes, already guessing she couldn't airbend again if she wanted to.

But yet again, the attack was blocked by the enemy raising his arm before the Hunter grabbed and threw the newly turned human onto the hood of a parked satomobile.

That just left Zarah who stood in front of Aila, holding her hands out to the sand before her, bending some up in the air before superheating them into flat sheets of cooled-off glass.

Flinging them towards Wolf, the glassbender was hoping to slice it up into pieces. So it soured her expression to see it easily smash any incoming sheet with the rebar, shattering them to pieces before ducking the last one.

Close enough now, the Hunter was quick to roll forth towards the Black Lotus agent and jab the piece of rebar down, right on top of her foot!

"AHHH!" Zarah yelled out quickly at being stabbed before being simply grabbed and thrown off to the side against a shop wall.

With the three out of the way, there was no one left stopping Wolf from now being in front of the Avatar, seeing her look straight up at it with frightened eyes, unable to move.

She was more or less defenseless now, too scared to even activate the Avatar State, that much seemed obvious.

"Pity it has to end like this, I was REALLY hoping to just end the chain with you." The powerful man spoke of, sounding as if he was disappointed.

And he was, both at still being alive AND things turning out like this.

Still...

"Guess I'll just have to make sure the next Avatar born gives me what I want." he continued speaking before raising up the piece of rebar in the air, ready to stab it down.

"In the Fire Nation, yes?"

"PLEASE, STOP! DON'T KILL HER!"

Both of their attention turned to Kallah, the waterbender trying to get back up to her feet and rushed over to her girlfriend's side.

"Please, I'm begging you." she indeed begged, not wanting things to be like this, keeping in front of Aila while looking up at Wolf.

"Don't kill Aila, please. She still has so much to live for, me and her!"

Hearing this, the marked being just listened, not seeming to react as Kallah kept trying to plead with it. "I want to get married, have our own batch of children, maybe some grandkids, grow old with her, help make the world a better place! PLEASE DON'T TAKE HER AWAY FROM ME OR THE OTHERS! I LOVE HER, PLEASE!"

Even hearing all of that...

... Wolf was still ready to raise the rebar higher, ready to strike down this girl in its way, seeing her tightly hug the Avatar, covering their faces.

"No, please, don't… please, I'm begging you…"

Now hearing the voice he had grown used to cry out, the Hunter began seeing the images through Iko's eyes of him begging for his family's life, seeing them slain as he screamed out once more.

"Well, what are you waiting for?"

Hearing his voice speak clearer now, Wolf could now suddenly see himself kneeling next to the girls, giving them a look before looking back up at it.

All with the most judgmental face one could give.

EXACTLY like how the man in the mirror on the train glared at him.

"You got your chance, kill her, she isn't fighting back. Kill the waterbender while you're at it, she's in the way. What's another body to add to the tally of the Hunter?" he was outright daring Wolf now.

Getting up, being only seen through those blackened eyes, the copy of the Hunter could see both Honei and Zarah struggling to get up, watching this scene.

"You were already just thinking of killing Aila, THEN going after the next one." he spoke, seeing the powerful being taking in his words. "Who, might I add, will be born upon her death. Which, if I'm correct, you'd then be going after A NEWBORN CHILD."

But the figure just shrugged, walking up to Wolf, seeing him look back at him still speaking.

"But hey, as long as it activates the state before you kill it, it should be fine, RIGHT? We'll be freed, no more living forever, am I right? We can die peacefully?" he asked sarcastically, throwing back the words said to him back on the train. "Come on, do it! Do what YOU choose to do, like leaving Sun and Meiying behind. Don't do what that cult wanted, but what YOU WANT..."

Being confronted, Wolf refocused its eyes back at the two, the rebar still up in the air, his hand starting to shake.

All while hearing the voice of Iko, the man whose body he was in control of, screaming out.

"Do it, Wolf... DO IT. KILL THE FUCKING AVATAR!"

It's right there for the taking, everything that was spoken was true, Wolf could kill Aila and then move onto the next one. It was so ready to make the choice...

... only to hear another, more innocent voice speak in its ears.

"Kitty..."

Neither Aila, Kallah or the others on the scene knew what was going through Wolf's mind, just waiting for things to happen...

... the Avatar however did uncover her eyes, as did the fire nun, both looking to see the looming man still looking them down, looking so very conflicted with its choice, the hand holding the rebar shaking badly.

This wasn't what they were expecting from the persistent Avatar Hunter, to see it hesitate.

Even more so when it looked like, just for a second, it began to look like Wolf was lowering his weapon...

... BEFORE A LOUD LASH WHIPPED OUT INTO THE AIR!

Suddenly and quickly, a grayish-white colored metal suddenly shooting forth like a cord, now wrapping and forming around Wolf's wrist!

It came out of nowhere, even for the Avatar Hunter, as everyone went to look at the source of the bending.

There it came from a kneeling and heavily breathing Kuvira, back on one knee, keeping herself as stable as she could.

"You... You get away... from THEM..." she demanded in-between breaths as those watching thought she had died, watching her begin to bend and pull the platinum lash towards her.

All to fling and throw the armed man away from the two girls, watching him land hard down the road, able to keep yelling out at him.

"I'm not... FUCKING DEAD YET!"

Recovering enough, the platinum bender had all eyes on her, shaking her head as she knew her family and Zarah thought she fell to her heart giving out.

Which at first, that was the case, but something within gave her enough strength to jump-start her heart and come back for one last stand, seeing Wolf look to struggle to get up.

"And as far... as I'm... concerned... If he wants to touch my granddaughter..." Kuvira made it clear, ready to get back to fighting however she could, giving a sly grin as she turned to look at where Aila and Kallah were.

"... he's going to have to properly kill me first."

Looking her way back towards her enemy, Kuvira was ready to thrust her hand right towards the platinum still stuck in Wolf's chest to end things...

... only to stop as she suddenly felt pain fill up her whole chest, all sense of protection vanishing as her eyes went wide upon feeling it.

As a loud piercing sound silenced all around the area.

Confused, the elderly woman then looked down, able to see the piece of rebar that had been thrown at her now sticking out of her chest.

Right where her heart was.

"Fine..." the Hunter spoke up where he stood, wanting to be sure.

As the platinum being bended just fell onto the ground, everyone witnessing this were horrified.

"GRANDMA!" Honei's voice echoed all over the village as she, her sister and friend watched Kuvira drop to her knees...

... before falling on her side, the damage done as she laid there.

No longer moving or breathing.

At the very same time, the airship with those coming from Zaofu was only twenty minutes out, everyone focused on how close they were when one spoke...

"... please, no..."

It was low, but everyone else on the ship was concerned how heartbroken Opal sounded as she spoke, giving their full attention.

Fast to react, Toph passed over control of the wheel to Jun, just to rush to her mother's side as Yasuko followed.

"Mother, what's wrong?" she asked, holding her hands.

And by making skin contact, Toph instantly felt exactly what her mother was sensing through her spiritual abilities, all the sad emotions course through, with Yasuko wondering. "What? What is it?"

The look on Toph's face showed a sadness only a select few on the ship ever seen up to this point.

"Aunt Kuvira..."

It was all the lavabender could say, the truth becoming more clear to everyone else on-board as they kept quiet, all except the sobbing of Opal...

Notes:

And so, our chapter ends after... well, quite the fight, and a flashback to when Aila met Kyoshi's spirit... with the death of Kuvira, dying while protecting her granddaughter.

What else can I say here? :Shrugs:
